Title Sales Associate
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile
Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Group Company: Marks and Spencer Reliance India Private Limited

Designation: Commercial Manager

Office Location:

Position description: As a Commercial Manager, your main goal is to lead your team, drive sales, and manage the store's overall performance. Your key responsibilities include:

Primary Responsibilities:
1. Team Leadership:

? Build a Strong Team: Develop a motivated and high-performing team that is committed to achieving goals.

? Lead by Example: Encourage your team and create opportunities to boost sales through positive leadership.

? Manage Performance: Oversee Section Managers and store staff, offering guidance and coaching to improve performance.

2. Sales Store Operations:

? Drive Sales: Promote sales growth by analyzing trends like footfall, customer conversion rates, and average purchase value (UPT).

? Achieve Sales Targets: Ensure the store meets its sales targets and adjust strategies when needed to stay on track.

? Seasonal Planning: Make sure the store is prepared for seasonal events and has the right staffing levels in place.

3. Store Presentation Competition:

? Implement Brand Guidelines: Follow and enforce guidelines for visual merchandising (VM) and marketing to maintain the brand image.

? Stay Competitive: Keep an eye on local competitors and take steps to gain an advantage in your market.

4. Customer Experience:

? Connect with Customers: Build strong relationships with customers by understanding their needs and preferences.

? Respond to Feedback: Listen to feedback from both customers and staff, and share valuable insights with relevant departments for improvement.



5. Stock Management Operations:

? Efficient Stock Management: Ensure smooth and accurate stock processes to keep the store well-organized and prepared.

6. Staff Engagement Communication:

? Regular Briefings: Keep your team updated with regular meetings, sharing important information and recognizing their achievements.

? Employee Development: Provide timely feedback to help your team improve and conduct performance appraisals to track growth.

Description:
About us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:
QR & Soundbox is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us:
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:
Graduate/Post Graduate.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
Position: Area Sales Manager (Depot In-charge)
Function: Retail
Location: Guwahati (Lower Assam)
Department: Sales

Role Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Area Sales Manager (ASM) to lead and manage the sales operations of a dedicated Depot within a specified territory. The ASM will be responsible for driving the sales volume, value, and growth targets by leading and motivating a team of frontline sales personnel. You will be instrumental in expanding the retail distribution network, tracking competitive activities, and monitoring local market trends to identify opportunities for growth and improvement. The ASM will also have full accountability for the performance of the Depot and will oversee its day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities:
Sales Performance & Target Achievement:
Lead and manage the sales operations of a single Depot, ensuring the achievement of monthly and annual sales targets (volume and value).
Develop and implement effective sales strategies and action plans to drive growth in the territory.
Monitor sales performance against targets and take corrective actions as necessary to meet business goals.
Foster a high-performance culture within the sales team, setting clear objectives and expectations.
Team Management & Development:
Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of frontline sales personnel, ensuring optimal performance and development of team members.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching and training to improve sales effectiveness.
Build a strong, cohesive team with a focus on collaboration and achieving sales targets.
Market Analysis & Competitor Tracking:
Continuously monitor the local market landscape and competitor activities to identify trends and business opportunities.
Provide insights to senior management regarding market changes and competitive strategies.
Analyze sales data and market trends to adjust sales strategies accordingly.
Distribution Network Expansion & Management:
Identify opportunities for expanding the retail distribution network within the territory.
Develop and implement effective distribution management schemes to maximize coverage and penetration.
Ensure the optimal allocation and management of resources within the Depot.
Customer Relationship Management:
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty.
Act as a liaison between customers and the organization, addressing their needs and concerns proactively.

Professional Qualifications:
Essential:
Bachelors degree (Graduate)/MBA (Marketing)

Experience Requirements:
10-12 years of hands-on experience in sales management through a channel network, preferably within the paints, building materials, tyre or related industries.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets in a highly competitive market.
Strong experience in managing a sales team and Depot operations independently.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Age Range: 30-35 years

Personality Traits:
Dynamic and Goal-Oriented: Able to work in a fast-paced environment with a focus on results and business growth.
Strong Leadership and Managerial Skills: A natural leader with the ability to inspire and manage teams effectively.
Customer-Centric: Excellent interpersonal skills with a customer-first approach to sales and service.
Analytical Thinker: Strong ability to analyze sales data and market trends to drive informed decisions.
Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally with various departments.

Account Manager Wireline Services

Do you want to be part of a diverse Account team, and propel growth across our Baker Hughes Wireline Business

Are you excited to win business and develop strategies
Join our Baker Hughes Wireline Account team!
Our Wireline division, a Baker Hughes business, has been supporting industries for over 100 years, celebrating many successes and first to market innovations along the way. Our Account team ensures our innovative products perform safely and efficiently, for all our customers. We deliver state of the art solutions time and time again that provide exemplary functionality and high-level technical support.

In Baker Hughes Wireline we strive to change energy, meeting the world s growing demand for energy, and the world s demands for energy to be cleaner, safer and more efficient. Our Wireline technologies help industry advance on the path to net-zero and to a sustainable energy future.
Partner with the best
Job Title: Account Manager, Wireline Services
The Account Manager will be a customer facing role, responsible for winning business within the end user and projects space in India.
They will develop a customer interface roadmap with a short, medium, and long-term perspective but also with the intensity of turning leads into actual orders. This is a unique role to contribute to real opportunities, with real solutions and real equipment.
As the Account Manager, you will be reporting to Country Sales Manager- India, and will be responsible for:
Growing Wireline Business in Northeastern part of India.
Positioning the Baker Hughes Wireline business as a critical Wireline partner for all customer present in region.
Leading account (End Users, EPCs, OEMs, Licensors) engagement and strategy.
Leading Billing and collection to ensure cash flow.
Managing and developing a solid pipeline of end user and project opportunities.
Executing on assigned Account targets and driving Account growth.
Providing regional market intelligence, competitive intelligence, and customer intelligence within the designated area.
Reporting on all regional activities related to market awareness and new project updates.
Negotiating contracts in collaboration with the commercial operations and risk management teams, and proactively leading negotiations on the most significant aspects of the assigned opportunities.
Demonstrating commercial and technical expertise in the Wireline market and maintaining knowledge of the market trends and product needs.
Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:
Have a degree in an engineering discipline or similar, with work experience in the wireline business.
Have excellent technical knowledge of Wireline Services across all industry sectors.
Have excellent interpersonal and presentation skills.
Be able to communicate at all levels within the organization and effectively influence others without authority.
Have the ability to coordinate and negotiate across several projects
simultaneously with varying complexity.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills and be fluent in English.
This role requires on-site presence.
Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive
Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect.
Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
Comprehensive private medical care options
Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
Tailored financial programs
Additional elected or voluntary benefits

Job Summary
Lead Poisoning Surveillance Coordinator, Guwahati, Assam
The Lead Poisoning Surveillance Coordinator, seconded into the local state health departments or related health agency located in Guwahati, Assam, will closely work with the state health department to design, support, and monitor state-wide blood lead surveillance and related activities. This position will provide programmatic and operational support, maintain partnerships with key stakeholders, and plan and organize state workshops.
Responsibilities
Serve as a liaison between the government/state health department and Vital Strategies, facilitating communication and collaboration.
Work with appropriate authorities to support the formation of a state technical working group.
Coordinate with all key stakeholders to ensure regular and timely communication and progress of the project.
Provide technical support for the state technical working group and other key stakeholders to develop a statewide blood lead surveillance framework.
Seek and incorporate technical input from key stakeholders on the surveillance framework and support the standardization of surveillance procedures.
Provide technical assistance to district-level health officials and frontline workers.
Assist in developing state-level strategies and action plans for reducing lead poisoning.
Coordinate and conduct training sessions for health staff, laboratory staff, and field teams on blood lead surveillance procedures.
Monitor and oversee district and field surveillance teams, track data collection progress, and identify challenges for efficient implementation.
Conduct field visits for on-ground supervision and to ensure data quality.
Conduct data analysis and prepare presentations, technical and non-technical reports for routine review and decision-making.
Coordinate state and district-level meetings and events (e.g., workshops, webinars).
Support dissemination of surveillance findings to key stakeholders.
Manage program-related operations by assisting with project start-up, logistics, contracting, expense and activity monitoring and reporting, and procurement activities with support from the associate.
Line reporting through the State Program Manager with technical guidance and direction from Vital Strategies.
Assist with other duties assigned by the supervisor.
Qualifications
Education: Master s degree in public health, Environmental Health Science, Epidemiology, and Health policy, or a related field, or MBBS will be preferred.
Candidates with a Bachelor s degree in dental science, Life sciences, or Environmental science with prior experience working in public health programs, government health systems, or environmental health projects.

Description:
Role:

Sterling & Wilson is looking for an experienced Storekeeper to manage site stores and material inventory for an industrial EPC project at AVFCCL, Namrup, Assam. The candidate will be responsible for material receipt, storage, issuance, stock reconciliation, documentation, and coordination with project and procurement teams.

Responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day store operations at the industrial EPC project site.
Ensure compliance with site store procedures, documentation standards, and safety requirements.
Monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment of materials.
Ensuring proper storage and timely availability of materials as per company requirements.
Track material movement, receipts, and dispatches.
Prevent material loss, damage, and unauthorized usage.
Verify invoices, delivery challans, and other material-related documents.
Receive, inspect, and verify incoming materials against purchase orders and delivery challans.
Ensure proper storage, labelling, and identification of materials.
Coordinate with the purchase and project teams regarding material requirements.

Required Skills:

4-5 years of relevant experience in storekeeping or material management, preferably in industrial EPC, construction, or project-site environments.
Proficiency in MS Office, particularly MS Excel.
Working knowledge of SAP, including relevant inventory or material management transactions.
Strong skills in inventory control, stock reconciliation, and material documentation.
Ability to work at a project site in Namrup, Assam.


Interested candidates with relevant industrial EPC project experience may share their updated resumes at:

Email: krishna.singh@sterlingwilson.com

Please mention Storekeeper Namrup, Assam in the email subject line.

Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers. Backed by IDG Ventures, Unilazer Ventures and TPG Capital, Lenskart has grown its array of services exponentially.

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling
services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a
conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of Spare Parts by increasing penetration in assigned territory. It involve ensuring the availability of genuine parts throughout designated territories and by closely working with retail network. It also involves creating awareness and educating the channel on benefits of genuine spare parts.
Job Responsibility
Sales Execution and Planning
Drive sales strategy through innovative activities and relationship building to garner maximum market share of Tata Genuine Parts.
Drive achievement of retail sales, institutional sales, product range and total sales targets by demand generating schemes and initiatives
Achieve distributor targets for primary and secondary sales by driving order generation activites
Develop and plan appropriate stock levels with distributers and execute plans for order generations. Monitor fulfilment of orders to ensure targets are achieved. Ensure distributers have the proper funding to support sales
Ensure the timely handling of channel partners and customer complaints including resolving payment issues, claims settlements and product availability
Actively coordinate with channel partner and procurement, warehouse & finance team to achieve high fill rates
Actively explore growth opportunities to increase market share and expanded the network to meet business objectives
Develop a deep understanding of the market and competition in assigned territory and use insights on competition pricing and distribution strategies to help improve organizations own strategies and tactics
Develop market potential matrix of Tata Genuine Parts through different methods: retailer wise, product group wise, district wise potential
Financial Management
Coordinate and monitor the availability of finances for distributors in assigned territory
Ensure competitive customer pricing by negotiating with channel partners to creating a win-win distribution pricing.
Monitor over dues of dealers and distributers in assigned area and take actions when required
Relationship Management
Deliver sales targets by working collaboratively with channel partners, participate in customer contact programs to capture voice of the customers, and providing timely solutions to the market, dealers, distributors and customers
People Management
Maintain up to date product knowledge and actively provide training and educate to the retailers, mechanics, fleet operators and channel partners regarding product and the usage of genuine spare parts.
Instilling the importance of resolving customer complaints received by distributors and guiding them on best practices for handling tricky situations in a timely manner. Also training them on importance of stock keeping and timely ordering of parts

Internal
Warehouse
Servicing of Orders, providing e-permits.
Central Logistics team.
Tracking shipments
Tech Cell
Technical support for NPI
ASM/CSM
Joint Audits of workshops.
External
Dealer
For order planning, Payments, DPM review on regular basis
Transporter
For claims and timely delivery of consignments.

Education MBA from renowned B school along with B E (Mechanical / Automobile Engg)
Relevant Experience: 3 - 4 Years
Experience in Business to Business Sales or Channel Sales or Auto Component Sales

Sales Skills
Technical knowledge
Analytical Skills
Interpersonal Skill
Negotiations skills

Description:
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects is inviting applications for the position of Graduate Engineer (Civil) at our Jorhat office.
We are a professional architectural and engineering firm based in Jorhat, Assam, working in the fields of architectural design, civil engineering, structural planning, interior design, building permission drawings, and turnkey construction projects . Our project portfolio includes residential buildings, commercial buildings, interior projects, institutional buildings, hotels, resorts, and other architectural works across Assam.
We are looking for a sincere, disciplined, and technically sound Civil Engineering graduate who is willing to learn, take responsibility, and work closely with our design and construction team.
Position
Graduate Engineer (Civil)
Location
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects 2nd Floor, Above Naffy Restaurant, Baruah Chariali, Opposite Westside Shopping Mall, Jorhat, Assam
Eligibility
The candidate should have:
B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Basic knowledge of building construction, RCC works, finishing works, and site execution
Basic understanding of drawings, plans, sections, elevations, and structural details
Knowledge of AutoCAD will be preferred
Basic knowledge of estimation, quantity calculation, and BOQ preparation will be an added advantage
Good communication skills and willingness to work in a team
Freshers may apply
Job Responsibilities
The selected candidate will be involved in:
Reading and understanding architectural and structural drawings
Preparing basic quantity calculations and material estimates
Assisting in site supervision and construction monitoring
Coordinating with architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, and site workers
Checking site work as per approved drawings and specifications
Preparing site reports, measurement sheets, and work progress updates
Supporting the team in building permission drawings, BOQ preparation, and project documentation
Maintaining proper technical records and project files
Learning office standards, construction detailing, and professional project workflow
Candidate Profile
We are looking for someone who is:
Serious about building a career in civil engineering and construction
Ready to learn both office-based technical work and site execution work
Punctual, honest, and responsible
Able to follow instructions and maintain professional discipline
Interested in residential, commercial, interior, and turnkey building projects
Comfortable working in a structured office environment
Experience
Freshers can apply. Candidates with 0 to 1 year of experience will be preferred.
Interview Location
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects Jorhat Head Office

Description:
Position: Area Sales Manager (Depot In-charge)
Function: Retail
Location: Silchar
Department: Sales

Role Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Area Sales Manager (ASM) to lead and manage the sales operations of a dedicated Depot within a specified territory. The ASM will be responsible for driving the sales volume, value, and growth targets by leading and motivating a team of frontline sales personnel. You will be instrumental in expanding the retail distribution network, tracking competitive activities, and monitoring local market trends to identify opportunities for growth and improvement. The ASM will also have full accountability for the performance of the Depot and will oversee its day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities:
Sales Performance & Target Achievement:
Lead and manage the sales operations of a single Depot, ensuring the achievement of monthly and annual sales targets (volume and value).
Develop and implement effective sales strategies and action plans to drive growth in the territory.
Monitor sales performance against targets and take corrective actions as necessary to meet business goals.
Foster a high-performance culture within the sales team, setting clear objectives and expectations.
Team Management & Development:
Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of frontline sales personnel, ensuring optimal performance and development of team members.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching and training to improve sales effectiveness.
Build a strong, cohesive team with a focus on collaboration and achieving sales targets.
Market Analysis & Competitor Tracking:
Continuously monitor the local market landscape and competitor activities to identify trends and business opportunities.
Provide insights to senior management regarding market changes and competitive strategies.
Analyze sales data and market trends to adjust sales strategies accordingly.
Distribution Network Expansion & Management:
Identify opportunities for expanding the retail distribution network within the territory.
Develop and implement effective distribution management schemes to maximize coverage and penetration.
Ensure the optimal allocation and management of resources within the Depot.
Customer Relationship Management:
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty.
Act as a liaison between customers and the organization, addressing their needs and concerns proactively.

Professional Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (Graduate)/MBA (Marketing)

Experience Requirements:
10-12 years of hands-on experience in sales management through a channel network, preferably within the paints, building materials, tyre or related industries.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets in a highly competitive market.
Strong experience in managing a sales team and Depot operations independently.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Age Range: 30-35 years

Personality Traits:
Dynamic and Goal-Oriented: Able to work in a fast-paced environment with a focus on results and business growth.
Strong Leadership and Managerial Skills: A natural leader with the ability to inspire and manage teams effectively.
Customer-Centric: Excellent interpersonal skills with a customer-first approach to sales and service.
Analytical Thinker: Strong ability to analyze sales data and market trends to drive informed decisions.
Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally with various departments.

Operations Executive Job Summary
As an Operations Executive at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will be responsible for overseeing and optimizing our operational processes to ensure efficient report production, delivery, and client satisfaction. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including research, editorial, and sales, to streamline workflows, manage project timelines, and maintain high-quality standards. This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. If you are a proactive problem-solver with a passion for operational excellence, we invite you to join our dynamic team.
Key Responsibilities
Oversee and optimize the end-to-end operational processes related to report production, including data collection, analysis, report writing, and quality assurance.
Ensure smooth coordination and communication across teams involved in the report production process, including research, editorial, design, and sales.
Manage project timelines and deadlines, identifying and resolving potential bottlenecks to ensure timely delivery of reports to clients.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) to streamline operations and maintain consistency and quality across report production.
Conduct regular quality checks to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to established standards and guidelines.
Optimize operational workflows and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, productivity, and cost-effectiveness.
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to operational processes in the market research industry.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or masters degree in business, operations management, or a related field.
Proven experience in operations management, preferably within the market research or publishing industry.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Excellent attention to detail, with a focus on maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process inefficiencies and implement effective solutions.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Proactive mindset with a demonstrated ability to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and propose innovative solutions.
Knowledge of market research methodologies and report production processes is preferred.
If you are a detail-oriented operations professional with a passion for optimizing processes and ensuring operational excellence, we invite you to join our team as an Operations Executive. Together, we will streamline operations, enhance efficiency, and deliver high-quality market research reports to our clients, contributing to their business success in a competitive marketplace.

Research Associate Job Summary
As a Research Associate at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a crucial role in conducting extensive market research and analysis to support the development and publication of syndicated market reports. You will collaborate closely with our research team to gather and analyze data, identify market trends, and provide valuable insights to our clients. This position requires strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and a passion for staying updated on market developments.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct comprehensive research on various industries and markets to gather relevant data and information.
Analyze market trends, competitive landscapes, and emerging opportunities to provide insights that contribute to the development of high-quality reports.
Collect and interpret quantitative and qualitative data from diverse sources, including industry databases, research reports, company websites, and government publications.
Collaborate with the research team to define research objectives, methodologies, and timelines for each project.
Conduct primary and secondary research, including interviews, surveys, and data mining, to gather accurate and up-to-date information.
Evaluate and validate data quality, ensuring its reliability and relevance to the research objectives.
Analyze research findings using statistical techniques and data visualization tools to create insightful and visually appealing reports.
Prepare well-structured, concise, and informative written reports that effectively communicate research findings and recommendations to clients.
Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to enhance the quality and relevance of research reports.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales, and editorial, to ensure timely delivery and effective promotion of syndicate reports.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, economics, marketing, market research, science and technology or a related field.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to interpret complex data and draw meaningful insights.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
Detail-oriented mindset with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Self-motivated and proactive approach to research, with a passion for continuous learning and staying updated on industry trends.
If you are a highly motivated individual with a keen interest in market analysis, we invite you to join our dynamic team as a Research Associate. Together, we will contribute to the production of insightful syndicate market reports that enable our clients to make informed business decisions in a rapidly evolving market landscape.

Research Associate Job Summary
As a Research Associate at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a crucial role in conducting extensive market research and analysis to support the development and publication of syndicated market reports. You will collaborate closely with our research team to gather and analyze data, identify market trends, and provide valuable insights to our clients. This position requires strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and a passion for staying updated on market developments.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct comprehensive research on various industries and markets to gather relevant data and information.
Analyze market trends, competitive landscapes, and emerging opportunities to provide insights that contribute to the development of high-quality reports.
Collect and interpret quantitative and qualitative data from diverse sources, including industry databases, research reports, company websites, and government publications.
Collaborate with the research team to define research objectives, methodologies, and timelines for each project.
Conduct primary and secondary research, including interviews, surveys, and data mining, to gather accurate and up-to-date information.
Evaluate and validate data quality, ensuring its reliability and relevance to the research objectives.
Analyze research findings using statistical techniques and data visualization tools to create insightful and visually appealing reports.
Prepare well-structured, concise, and informative written reports that effectively communicate research findings and recommendations to clients.
Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to enhance the quality and relevance of research reports.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales, and editorial, to ensure timely delivery and effective promotion of syndicate reports.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, economics, marketing, market research, science and technology or a related field.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to interpret complex data and draw meaningful insights.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
Detail-oriented mindset with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Self-motivated and proactive approach to research, with a passion for continuous learning and staying updated on industry trends.
If you are a highly motivated individual with a keen interest in market analysis, we invite you to join our dynamic team as a Research Associate. Together, we will contribute to the production of insightful syndicate market reports that enable our clients to make informed business decisions in a rapidly evolving market landscape.

As a Digital Marketing Executive at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a crucial role in driving digital marketing strategies to promote our reports, expand our online presence, and engage our target audience. You will be responsible for developing and executing digital marketing campaigns, managing social media platforms, optimizing website content, and analyzing campaign performance. Develop and implement digital marketing strategies to promote market research reports and increase brand visibility and engagement.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in marketing, digital marketing, communications, or a related field.
Solid understanding of digital marketing channels, including SEO, SEM, social media, email marketing, content marketing, and display advertising.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create engaging content and effectively communicate with the target audience.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and metrics to make data-driven decisions and optimize campaign performance.
Creative mindset with a keen eye for design aesthetics and the ability to create visually appealing digital assets.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
If you are a results-oriented individual with a passion for digital marketing and the ability to drive impactful marketing campaigns, we invite you to join our team as a Digital Marketing Executive. Together, we will leverage digital platforms and strategies to promote our market research reports, engage our audience, and drive business growth in a competitive market landscape.

Sales Executive Job Summary
As a Sales Executive at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a pivotal role in driving sales growth and expanding our client base. You will be responsible for generating new business leads, nurturing client relationships, and closing sales deals. This position requires strong sales acumen, excellent communication skills, and a deep understanding of the market research industry. If you are a self-motivated and results-driven individual with a passion for sales and a knack for building strong client relationships, we invite you to join our dynamic team
Key Responsibilities
Identify and pursue new business opportunities by proactively generating leads and establishing connections with potential clients.
Conduct market research and analysis to identify target industries and sectors for sales prospecting.
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients to foster loyalty and secure repeat business.
Deliver persuasive sales presentations and product demonstrations to prospective clients, showcasing the value and benefits of our syndicated market research reports.
Understand client needs, provide customized solutions, and effectively communicate the unique value propositions of our reports to drive sales conversions.
Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement effective sales strategies, campaigns, and promotional materials.
Utilize CRM systems and sales tools to track sales activities, manage leads, and monitor the sales pipeline.
Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation.
Attend industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events to expand professional networks and generate new sales leads.
Collaborate with internal teams, including research, marketing, and customer support, to ensure client satisfaction and seamless execution of sales processes.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
Proven experience in sales, preferably within the market research industry or a related field.
Strong sales acumen with a track record of achieving sales targets and driving business growth.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively articulate the value propositions of our syndicated market research reports.
Exceptional negotiation and closing skills, with the ability to handle objections and secure sales deals.
Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with clients.
Proficiency in using CRM systems and sales tools to manage leads and track sales activities.
Self-motivated and results-driven mindset, with the ability to work independently and meet sales targets.
Excellent time management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
Knowledge of the market research industry, including the understanding of research methodologies, report types, and client needs, is preferred.
If you are a driven sales professional with a passion for driving business growth and a strong understanding of the market research industry, we invite you to join our team as a Sales Executive. Together, we will leverage your sales expertise to expand our client base, increase revenue, and deliver valuable market insights to our clients.

Job Summary
As a Functional Test Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring software quality through manual testing practices. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, execute test cases, and support the overall testing lifecycle. This role is ideal for junior candidates with a strong foundation in manual testing.


Roles and Responsibilities
Understand and analyze project requirements and acceptance criteria.
Design, write, and execute manual test cases for applications.
Perform Functional, UI, Regression, and Smoke testing.
Identify, log, track, and verify defects throughout the defect life cycle.
Prepare and manage test data required for test execution.
Collaborate with developers and stakeholders to clarify requirements and raise concerns.
Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
Support release activities and maintain test documentation.
Contribute ideas to improve testing processes and efficiency.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
Around 1 year of hands-on experience in manual testing.
Familiarity with Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
Strong understanding of requirement analysis, test case preparation, and execution.
Basic knowledge on API manual testing using Postman or similar tools.
Exposure to test management tools like Jira, Xray, or TestLink is a plus.
Basic understanding of cross-browser and cross-device testing.
Good to have knowledge/experience in the E-commerce domain.
Strong attention to detail with excellent problem-solving and logical thinking abilities.
Ability to communicate clearly and work well within a team environment.
Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and meet deadlines
Eagerness to learn and grow in the testing domain.

Job Title: Senior Business Analyst- Assistant Director
Experience- 10 to 16
Location- Bangalore, Kochi

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst with experience implementing global projects and programs with a high level of competency in Talent systems.  The ideal candidate will play a key role in gathering complex requirements, designing integrated solutions, and contributing to the strategic use of Talent data to support business objectives.

Your key responsibilities:
Requirement Gathering: Lead the gathering of complex business requirements from stakeholders, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of needs related to Talent systems, with a focus on SAP SuccessFactors and data integration
Process Engineering/Optimization: Analyze existing Talent processes, identify areas for optimization, and recommend solutions that leverage SAP SuccessFactors and other technologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
Data Integration: Collaborate with data architecture team to enable the data integration strategy, working closely with the technical teams. Work seamlessly to achieve efficient data exchange between SAP SuccessFactors and other relevant systems, with a focus on data quality and accuracy
Solution Design: Collaborate with technical teams to design integrated solutions, translating business needs into technical requirements, data mapping, security (RBP), and system functionalities
Data Analysis: Perform advanced data analysis, identifying trends, patterns, and insights from Talent data, and presenting findings to support data-driven decision-making
Documentation: Create detailed requirement documents, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents, and other relevant documentation to guide project implementation
Stakeholder Management: Engage with business stakeholders, executive leadership, and project teams, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and delivery of project objectives
Quality Assurance: Implement and maintain best practices for data quality, testing, and validation to ensure that SAP SuccessFactors and integrated systems meet business needs and quality standards
Change Management: Drive change management efforts to support end-users in adapting to new systems and processes resulting from SAP SuccessFactors implementations
Continuous Improvement: Proactively seek opportunities for process improvement, recommend enhancements to business processes and system functionalities

Skills and attributes for success
In-depth knowledge of Talent processes, system functionalities, data integration methodologies, and best practices
Proficiency in data analysis and tools, database query languages (e.g., SQL), and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI)
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights
Excellent documentation and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Strong project management capabilities, including the ability to lead and manage cross-functional teams
Positive attitude, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
Results-oriented, with a focus on achieving project objectives and driving positive outcomes
Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills
Ability to work virtually with global teams

To qualify for this role
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; additional certifications in business analysis or SAP SuccessFactors preferred
Proven experience as a Senior Business Analyst with a focus on Talent systems, SAP SuccessFactors, and data integration
As a Senior Business Analyst, 8 to 10 years of industry experience preferably in Talent

EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Role : Data Modeler
Experience Guide : 6 to 15 years

The opportunity
We are seeking a highly skilled Data Modeler / Data Architect with strong expertise in Enterprise Data Modelling, Data Architecture, Semantic Modelling, Data Governance, and Wealth & Asset Management data domains. The ideal candidate will lead enterprise-scale data modelling and transformation initiatives while collaborating closely with business and technology stakeholders.
The candidate should possess strong experience in logical, physical, and dimensional data modelling, enterprise architecture, data governance, data quality, data lineage, semantic modelling, Ontologies, and either Knowledge Graphs or AI-enabled Data Engineering practices.
Your key responsibilities
Skills and attributes for success
Must Have - Physical Data Modelling, Logical Data Modelling, Dimensional Modelling, Enterprise Architecture, Strong SQL Skills, Erwin or ER/Studio (either one mandatory), CI/CD, Wealth & Asset Management (WAM) Domain Knowledge, Data Governance, Data Lineage, Data Quality, Semantic Modelling, Enterprise Data Warehousing, Data Warehouse Design & Development, Enterprise ETL Architecture, and strong experience in Ontologies, and either Knowledge Graphs or AI skills on data engineering.
Preferred - Conceptual Data Modelling, Oracle SQL Developer Data Modeler, Git, Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, Semantic Layer Design.
To qualify for the role, you must have
6 to 15 years of experience in Data Modelling, Data Architecture, Enterprise Data Warehousing, or Data Engineering.
Strong hands-on expertise in Physical, Logical, and Dimensional Data Modelling.
Proven experience designing enterprise-scale data models and enterprise data warehouse solutions.
Experience using Erwin and/or ER Studio for enterprise data modelling.
Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
Strong understanding of Enterprise Architecture principles and data modelling best practices.
Experience implementing Data Governance, Data Quality, and Data Lineage initiatives.
Prior experience within Wealth & Asset Management, Investment Management, or Capital Markets is highly preferred.
Strong understanding of Semantic Modelling concepts and modern data architecture patterns.
Strong experience in Ontologies, and either Knowledge Graphs or AI skills on data engineering.
Experience working within CI/CD-enabled development environments.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Experience leading enterprise data transformation initiatives.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
Ideally, you'll also have
Graph Data Modeling, RDF, OWL, SPARQL, GraphRAG, Semantic Search, Enterprise Search, Vector Search, AI Knowledge Retrieval, LLM Grounding, Agentic AI, AI-Ready Data Products, ETL/ELT, APIs, Databricks, Snowflake, KPI Frameworks, Data Storytelling, Insight Generation, Advanced SQL, Business Analysis, AI Observability, Documentation, and Architecture Support.
What we look for
We look for professionals who combine strong hands-on delivery, architecture awareness, stakeholder collaboration, production ownership and a continuous learning mindset.
What working at EY offers
At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasises high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

Job Title - Solution Architect - AI - Manager - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 7 -Manager
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore
Must have skills:Generative AI,Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI, , Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills:Model Context Protocol (MCP)/ Agent2Agent (A2A)
Experience:10 - 15 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.


Roles and Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.

EY- Process & Controls Risk Consulting – Manager -IA Capital Projects
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the team in client engagements related to Risk Consulting, Internal Audit, GRC Consulting for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
We’re looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Real Estate and Construction sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
The current role requires executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for Real Estate construction companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
Responsible for leading and executing client engagements and meeting the expectations of the client and the onsite team within the MENA region.
Ability to interact with all levels of management, including C-Suite executives.
Perform end-to-end internal audits from planning to reporting including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrix / audit work program, control testing to assess their design and operating effectiveness, preparation of audit report and agreeing issues/ actions with management.

Demonstrate knowledge and experience of the project delivery (EPC) lifecycle, including understanding of governance structures, organizational design, and Delegation of Authority frameworks.
Assess business cases for capital projects, analyzing their structure, assumptions, and feasibility.

Description:
As a Trainee - Emissions and Compliance Analyst at BSM, you will be responsible for supporting the monitoring, analysis, reporting, and compliance management of vessel emissions and environmental performance. The role plays an important part in ensuring accurate regulatory submissions, supporting decarbonisation initiatives, and helping vessels and stakeholders comply with international and regional maritime environmental requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Collect, validate, and analyse vessel emissions, fuel consumption, voyage, and operational performance data.
Support compliance with IMO DCS, EU MRV, EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS), FuelEU Maritime, CII, EEXI, and other applicable environmental regulations.
Prepare and maintain accurate emissions reports, regulatory submissions, supporting documentation, and audit trails.
Monitor vessel performance against emissions targets, operational benchmarks, carbon intensity indicators, and approved management plans.
Identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, and reporting gaps, and coordinate corrective actions with vessels, technical teams, operations, and other stakeholders.
Support the calculation, verification, and administration of emissions allowances, including EU ETS exposure and compliance requirements.
Assist with the preparation of annual emissions statements, management reports, dashboards, and performance analyses.
Track changes in maritime environmental legislation, regulatory guidance, and industry requirements, communicating relevant updates to internal stakeholders.
Work with shipboard and shore-based teams to improve data collection processes, reporting accuracy, and environmental performance.
Support energy-efficiency and decarbonisation initiatives, including the evaluation of fuel consumption trends, operational measures, and emissions reduction opportunities.
Liaise with flag administrations, classification societies, verifiers, authorities, consultants, and other external stakeholders as required.
Contribute to continuous improvement of emissions management systems, procedures, controls, and reporting tools.
Qualifications & Experience
Marine Engineering, Maritime Studies, Data Analytics,
Experience in emissions reporting, environmental compliance, sustainability analysis, data analysis, or a related maritime role.
Knowledge of maritime environmental regulations, including IMO DCS, EU MRV, EU ETS, FuelEU Maritime, CII, or EEXI requirements.
Experience working with vessel performance, fuel consumption, voyage, or emissions data is desirable.
Experience with data reporting systems, environmental management platforms, or regulatory compliance tools is advantageous.
Skills & Competencies
Strong analytical and numerical skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into practical processes.
Good understanding of maritime operations, vessel emissions, fuel consumption, and carbon accounting principles.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools experience with Power BI or similar reporting platforms is an advantage.
Strong data management, reporting, and documentation skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and meet regulatory deadlines.
Proactive, structured, and solution-oriented approach.
Fluency in English and solid computer literacy.

Career development opportunities
Technical and soft skills training
Comprehensive health insurance coverage
Annual performance bonus
Gym/Entertainment benefits
Sustainability and wellness activities
Diverse workforce
Competitive compensation package
Flexible work opportunities
Be a part of the ever-growing Schulte group family!

Summary
We are seeking a proactive and experienced Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Consultant - Senior, with strong expertise in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), BI Publisher (BIP), and Fast Formula, supported by hands-on experience across Oracle Time and Labor (OTL), Absence Management, and Payroll. The ideal candidate will have a strong Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM technical background and proven experience delivering integrations, reports, extracts, formulas, data conversions, and production support for complex HCM transformation initiatives.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Oracle Fusion HCM integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), including HCM adapters, REST and SOAP services, HDL, HCM Extracts, transformations, fault handling, monitoring, and third-party integrations.
Develop and maintain BI Publisher (BIP) reports, data models, templates, bursting configurations, payroll documents, extracts, and operational reports for HCM processes.
Design, develop, validate, and troubleshoot Fast Formulas for Oracle Time and Labor, Absence Management, and Payroll, including time-entry rules, overtime and premium calculations, accruals, eligibility, validations, payroll elements, earnings, deductions, and calculation logic.
Support end-to-end technical solutions for OTL, Absence, and Payroll, working closely with functional consultants to translate business requirements into scalable integrations, reports, extracts, and formulas.
Develop inbound and outbound interfaces for employee, assignment, time, absence, payroll, costing, and payment-related data using OIC, HCM Extracts, HDL, REST, SOAP, and secure file-transfer mechanisms.
Deliver high-quality work across the full SDLC, including technical design, code reviews, unit testing, SIT, UAT, release management, production deployment, reconciliation, and Hypercare support.
Diagnose integration, reporting, formula, time, absence, and payroll issues; identify root causes; optimize performance; and resolve production incidents within agreed service levels.
Build strong relationships with clients and internal teams while supporting Managers in meeting client commitments and internal KPIs.
Job Requirements
Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), BI Publisher (BIP), and Oracle Fusion HCM Fast Formula.
Minimum 5 years of relevant Oracle Fusion Cloud technical experience, including at least 2-3 full life-cycle implementations and one end-to-end HCM implementation or major rollout.
Extensive OIC experience covering Oracle HCM Cloud adapters, REST, SOAP, FTP/SFTP, scheduled and event-based integrations, mappings, lookups, fault handling, monitoring, and performance troubleshooting.
Strong BIP expertise covering SQL-based data models, RTF, Excel, eText, and XML templates, bursting, scheduling, security, troubleshooting, and report performance optimization.
Proven Fast Formula experience across OTL, Absence Management, and Payroll, including database items, contexts, inputs, defaults, formula functions, validation, compilation, testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
Good functional and technical understanding of OTL configurations and rules, time-entry validation, overtime, shift differentials, premium calculations, approval and transfer processes, and payroll integration.
Good understanding of Absence Management, including absence plans and types, accruals, eligibility, carryover, proration, entitlement, validations, and payroll impact.
Good understanding of Oracle Fusion Payroll, including elements, balances, earnings, deductions, calculation cards, costing, payroll flows, prepayments, payments, reconciliation, and legislative considerations.
Proficiency in HCM Extracts, HDL, OTBI, REST and SOAP web services, Oracle Cloud security, and related HCM reporting and integration technologies.
Experience with HCM data migration, conversion, reconciliation, and interface scheduling, including handling effective-dated employee and payroll data.
Experience preparing technical design documents, formula specifications, interface mappings, report designs, test scripts, deployment plans, and support documentation, with working knowledge of SIT, UAT, SDLC, and change management.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills, with a commitment to secure, compliant, and controlled delivery.
Competencies / Skills
Strong ability to drive projects along with the team and independently
Strong communication skills and ability to translate requirements into design documents.
Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Project Portfolio Management (PPM) and Finance Functional Senior with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience and sound project management and project financials domain knowledge. The role requires hands-on implementation and support experience across Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Control, Project Contracts and Finance modules, with exposure to Project Execution Management, Project Resource Management, Grants Management and capital projects preferred. The successful candidate will independently deliver assigned functional areas and actively support requirement gathering, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live activities.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Deliver assigned Oracle Fusion PPM functional areas across implementations, rollouts, upgrades and support engagements.
Configure and support Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Control and Project Contracts, Finance Modules (Accounts Payables, General Ledger) with exposure to other PPM modules preferred.
Analyse project management and project accounting requirements and map them to standard Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM processes.
Configure project organizations, project units, templates, classifications, expenditure structures, burden schedules, rate schedules, budgets, forecasts, billing plans and revenue methods under solution lead guidance.
Participate in fit-to-standard workshops, requirement gathering, process design and solution walkthroughs.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scripts, training materials and operating procedures.
Support PPM integrations with Financials, Procurement, HCM, Time and Labor, Expenses, Supply Chain, EPM, reporting and external applications.
Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities, including project cost reconciliation and defect resolution.
Validate cost collection, capitalization, burdening, budgeting, forecasting, invoicing, revenue recognition and project performance reporting.
Track assigned activities, risks, issues, dependencies and deliverables, and provide timely status updates.
Collaborate with functional, technical, integration, data, finance and reporting teams and support junior consultants as required.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Oracle Projects or Project Portfolio Management, including hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM and Oracle FInancils
Strong implementation or support experience in Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Control and Project Contracts.
Good understanding of project lifecycle and project financial management concepts, including planning, budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, burdening, capitalization, billing, revenue recognition and performance reporting.
Experience in at least two full lifecycle Oracle Projects or PPM implementations, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM implementation.
Hands-on experience in requirement analysis, configuration, testing, data migration, cutover and post-go-live support.
Exposure to PPM integrations with Financials, Procurement, HCM, Time and Labor, Expenses, SCM or EPM is preferred.
Experience in client-facing delivery, documentation, issue resolution and stakeholder communication.
Experience in project-centric sectors such as government, engineering and construction, professional services, energy, real estate, oil and gas, or power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills
Strong Oracle Fusion PPM functional, customer handling and teamwork skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned PPM work areas, work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Good knowledge of project management, project accounting and project financial control processes.
Effective communication skills and ability to translate business requirements into functional documentation.
Strong organizational, time management, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to learn complex business processes and apply knowledge effectively.
Ability to follow defined delivery and release management processes and remain focused on priorities.
Must have a valid passport for business travel involving work at client sites and be willing to work MENA shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Awareness of AI applications in project portfolio management, including automation, predictive analytics and AI-driven project insights.
Education
Mandatory qualification: Bachelor s or master s degree in engineering, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Project Management or a related discipline from a recognised institution.
Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management certification is preferred; PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification is an advantage.
