Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Procurement (PROC) Functional Consultant at Senior level with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will independently support and deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, transformation, rollout and support engagements across Procurement and related SCM areas, including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Procurement Contracts, Inventory Management, Order Management, Product Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Cost Management, Maintenance and Logistics. The role requires strong hands-on functional capability, client-facing delivery experience and relevant industry/domain expertise to translate real-world source-to-pay and supply-chain requirements into scalable Oracle Fusion solutions. Knowledge of Oracle Redwood user experience and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio is also expected.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and Procurement implementation, transformation, rollout and support activities from requirements gathering through design, configuration, testing, deployment and stabilization.
Manage assigned workstream tasks, plans, risks, issues, dependencies, quality and stakeholder updates under the guidance of the project lead or manager.
Facilitate business workshops, assess current-state industry processes and translate requirements into scalable future-state Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions aligned with leading practices.
Perform functional fit-gap analysis, configuration, prototyping, conference room pilots, testing, training, cutover and go-live support.
Design integrated source-to-pay, procure-to-pay and supply-chain solutions across Procurement, Inventory Management, Order Management, Cost Management and related SCM modules, coordinating dependencies with Payables, Finance, Projects, reporting, integration, security and data teams.
Prepare high-quality functional designs, configuration workbooks, process flows, test artefacts, user guides and training materials in line with Oracle implementation methodologies.
Assess Oracle Redwood readiness, support business-process redesign for Redwood pages and guided experiences, and execute adoption, testing and change-impact activities.
Identify suitable SCM use cases for Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio and support the definition of agent topics, instructions, tools, data access, human-approval checkpoints and expected outcomes.
Collaborate with technical, security and integration teams to configure, test, publish and monitor AI agents and agentic workflows within Oracle Fusion.
Follow responsible AI controls covering role-based access, data privacy, traceability, testing, monitoring and business-owner approval.
Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, cutover and production support, and drive timely resolution of defects and functional queries.
Contribute to client presentations, solution demonstrations, estimates, proposals, knowledge assets and practice-development initiatives.
Guide junior consultants, review assigned deliverables and maintain delivery quality and internal KPIs.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of relevant Oracle SCM and Procurement experience, including strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud.
At least two end-to-end ERP implementation or transformation engagements, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM implementation.
Strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Procurement-including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Supplier Portal and Procurement Contracts-together with hands-on knowledge of at least one core SCM area such as Inventory Management, Order Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Product Management, Cost Management, Maintenance or Logistics.
Hands-on experience with source-to-pay and procure-to-pay process design, enterprise structures, procurement business units, requisitioning, purchasing, approvals, catalogs, supplier onboarding, sourcing, contracts, receiving, integrations, data migration, reporting and operational controls.
Practical knowledge of Oracle Redwood UX, including Redwood page adoption, process redesign, extension considerations, testing and end-user change management.
Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, including agent configuration concepts, topics, instructions, tools, workflow orchestration, deployment, security and monitoring.
Ability to support high-value agentic SCM use cases, such as supplier onboarding assistance, procurement policy guidance, order exception management, inventory insights or planning support.
Client-facing delivery experience with sound planning, estimation, risk management, testing and quality assurance capabilities.
Demonstrable industry/domain experience in at least one sector-such as retail, government, energy, real estate, oil and gas, manufacturing, utilities, logistics or consumer products-with practical understanding of sector-specific procurement, supplier, inventory, fulfilment, planning and operational-control requirements.
Competencies / Skills
Strong stakeholder management, consulting, collaboration and junior-team mentoring skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned functional workstreams, priorities and deliverables within agreed timelines.
Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, with the ability to explain business and functional concepts clearly.
Strong analytical, industry-process design, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to apply domain knowledge to Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions.
Sound understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, access controls, human oversight and governance for enterprise agentic solutions.
Awareness of Oracle quarterly updates and the ability to assess new SCM, Redwood and embedded-AI capabilities for business adoption.
Proficiency in delivery and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent.
Valid passport and willingness to travel to client sites and work MENA business schedules, including Sunday to Thursday, where required.
Education
Bachelor s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, Information Systems or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and/or Procurement certification in relevant modules is preferred; credentials or demonstrated training in Oracle Redwood and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio are an added advantage.

Job Title: Windows & Linux Compliance SME
Job Summary
The MSFT Windows Compliance SME supports the Stay in Compliance Lead by managing compliance, risk and control activities across the global on-premises Windows Server estate. The role provides deep technical expertise for Microsoft Windows Server 2019, 2022 and 2025, Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft Configuration Manager, PowerShell Desired State Configuration, server hardware, virtualisation and associated hybrid-cloud management capabilities. The role helps maintain a secure, supported and consistently configured estate through vulnerability remediation, security hardening, patch and version currency, configuration baselines, identity and access controls, automation, hardware lifecycle management and audit assurance.
Working with On-Prem Hosting Engineering and Operations, Information Security, Active Directory, Service Management, hardware, virtualisation, cloud and application teams, the role assesses security findings and configuration drift, engineers and coordinates large-scale remediation, and produces traceable governance and audit reporting. The position provides Windows-specific subject-matter expertise and clear escalation to the Stay in Compliance Lead, while coordinating cross-platform dependencies where Windows services interact with Linux, Azure, AWS, VMware, Nutanix AHV or Hyper-V environments.
Job Description
Serve as the compliance SME for the global on-premises Microsoft Windows Server estate, supporting environments at enterprise scale, including estates exceeding 10,000 servers.
Monitor Microsoft security advisories, vulnerability findings, operating-system alerts, configuration data and vendor notifications to identify exposure affecting Windows Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.
Assess technical impact, affected versions, exploitability, business criticality, service dependencies and compensating controls, and support risk-based prioritisation in line with agreed standards and remediation SLAs.
Engineer, package, test and coordinate large-scale remediation for security vulnerabilities, configuration changes and software updates using Microsoft Configuration Manager, PowerShell, Desired State Configuration and Ansible.
Design, implement and maintain Group Policy Objects and verify consistent application across relevant Active Directory forests and domains.
Create and maintain security configuration items, baselines, compliance rules and automated corrective controls using PowerShell DSC and approved enterprise tooling.
Plan and schedule deployment waves for patches, security configurations, GPO changes, software packages, firmware and drivers, balancing remediation urgency with production stability.
Maintain compliance visibility across physical and virtual Windows servers hosted on VMware ESXi, Nutanix AHV and Hyper-V, including hardware, firmware, drivers, operating-system versions and support lifecycle.
Support secure account and access management for Windows servers, including privileged access, service accounts, local administrator controls, authentication policy and role separation.
Perform security and performance analysis and recommend hardening, tuning and configuration changes for mission-critical production systems in data-centre environments.
Support hybrid management of on-premises servers through Microsoft Azure capabilities, including Azure Arc-enabled servers, Azure Policy, machine configuration, monitoring and update-management concepts where adopted.
Coordinate cross-platform remediation dependencies with Linux teams using Red Hat Satellite and Ansible Automation Platform when shared services, automation or controls span Windows and Linux environments.
Prepare implementation plans, technical procedures, validation steps, rollback plans, change records and stakeholder communications for compliance deployments.
Track remediation actions, ageing, exceptions, deployment failures, dependencies and closure evidence, escalating material risk or delivery delays to the Stay in Compliance Lead.
Maintain accurate compliance records covering server inventory, patch and configuration status, GPO application, software and firmware currency, lifecycle, vulnerabilities, ownership, approved exceptions and evidence.
Use ServiceNow, Microsoft Configuration Manager, Power BI, Dell OpenManage Enterprise, monitoring platforms, SharePoint, scripts and APIs to analyse compliance, automate recurring tasks and produce dashboards and reports.
Support internal and external audits by providing timely, complete and traceable Windows Server configuration, access, patching, lifecycle and remediation evidence.
Identify opportunities to standardise and automate vulnerability assessment, packaging, deployment, compliance validation, evidence collection and reporting using DevOps and infrastructure-as-code practices.
Build effective working relationships across Engineering, Operations, Information Security, Service Management, Active Directory, Linux, cloud, virtualisation, hardware and application teams while operating within the governance direction set by the Stay in Compliance Lead.
Knowledge & Competencies Required
Advanced hands-on administration and compliance experience with Microsoft Windows Server 2019, 2022 and 2025 in large, globally distributed production environments.
Expert knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy design and management, domain and forest structures, authentication, service accounts and privileged-access controls.
Proven experience assessing security risk, remediating Windows Server vulnerabilities, applying security baselines and tuning systems securely without compromising service availability.
Deep scripting and automation capability in PowerShell, WMI and Python; experience with Ansible is required, while VBS and Perl knowledge is beneficial for legacy environments.
Strong experience administering Microsoft Configuration Manager and packaging and deploying software, scripts, updates and remediation controls at enterprise scale.
Experience creating configuration items, security baselines and desired-state controls using PowerShell DSC or equivalent configuration-as-code capabilities.
Ability to interpret Microsoft security advisories, CVEs, severity scores, vulnerability scan findings, support lifecycle information and technical prerequisites and translate them into deployment actions.
Strong knowledge of Windows Server hardware management, firmware and driver currency, remote management and lifecycle controls; Dell OpenManage Enterprise experience is advantageous.
Good knowledge of VMware ESXi, Nutanix AHV and Hyper-V virtualisation and the operational dependencies between guest operating systems and hosting platforms.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and hybrid-cloud management, including Azure Arc-enabled servers, Azure Policy, machine configuration, monitoring and update-management concepts; AWS familiarity is beneficial.
Working knowledge of Linux security and administration, Red Hat Satellite and Ansible Automation Platform sufficient to coordinate shared compliance and automation dependencies.
Experience with ServiceNow, Power BI, SharePoint, monitoring and systems-management platforms for remediation tracking, data analysis, dashboarding and audit reporting.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Project Financials Functional Senior with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience and strong project accounting and financial management expertise. Chartered Accountant qualification is mandatory. The role requires hands-on implementation and support experience across Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts and Project Control, including budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, burdening, capitalization, intercompany and interproject processing, invoicing, revenue recognition, accounting and reconciliation. The successful candidate will independently deliver assigned functional areas and support requirement gathering, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live activities.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Deliver assigned Oracle Fusion Project Financials functional areas across implementations, rollouts, upgrades and support engagements.
Configure and support Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts and Project Control.
Analyse project accounting and financial management requirements and map them to standard Oracle Fusion Cloud processes and controls.
Configure project organizations, project units, templates, classifications, expenditure types, transaction sources, burden schedules, rate schedules, budgets, forecasts, billing plans, revenue methods and accounting options.
Support cost collection, cost allocation, burdening, capitalization, project asset creation, intercompany and interproject billing, customer invoicing, revenue recognition and project close processes.
Participate in fit-to-standard workshops, requirement gathering, process design, solution walkthroughs and finance stakeholder discussions.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scripts, reconciliation templates, training materials and operating procedures.
Support integrations with General Ledger, Receivables, Payables, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Expenses, Time and Labor, HCM, EPM and external applications.
Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities, including project cost, revenue, invoice and accounting reconciliation and defect resolution.
Validate subledger accounting, accounting distributions, period close, project-to-ledger reconciliation and project performance reporting.
Collaborate with finance, functional, technical, integration, data and reporting teams and support junior consultants as required.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Oracle Projects, Project Accounting or Project Financial Management, including hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Financials.
Chartered Accountant qualification and relevant post-qualification experience in project accounting, financial control, audit, revenue, costing or management accounting are mandatory.
Strong implementation or support experience in Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts, Project Control and Project Foundation.
Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, allocations, burdening, capitalization, project assets, invoicing, revenue recognition, accounting and reconciliation.
Experience in at least two full lifecycle Oracle Projects or Project Financials implementations, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation.
Hands-on experience in requirement analysis, configuration, testing, data migration, cutover, period close, reconciliation and post-go-live support.
Experience with integrations across General Ledger, Receivables, Payables, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Expenses, Time and Labor, HCM or EPM is preferred.
Experience in project-centric sectors such as engineering and construction, professional services, energy, real estate, oil and gas, government, or power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills
Strong Oracle Fusion Project Financials functional, project accounting and financial control skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned Project Financials work areas, work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Sound understanding of accounting standards, project costing, revenue recognition, capitalization, subledger accounting, period close and financial reconciliation.
Effective communication skills and ability to translate finance and business requirements into functional documentation.
Strong organizational, analytical, reconciliation, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to assess financial process and control implications and apply sound professional judgement.
Ability to follow defined delivery, governance and release management processes and remain focused on priorities.
Must have a valid passport for business travel involving work at client sites and be willing to work MENA shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Education
Mandatory qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant from a recognised professional accounting body, with relevant post-qualification experience.
Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management or Project Financial Management certification is preferred.

Oracle Human Capital Management - Functional - Senior (Payroll, Absence and Time & Labor)
Job Summary
We are seeking an initiative-taking and experienced Oracle Fusion Payroll - Functional Senior Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Oracle Fusion Payroll, payroll processing, payroll elements, balances, costing, fast formulas, legislative/localization requirements and related Oracle HCM modules, extensive functional expertise, and a proven ability to deliver successful implementations and support in a consulting environment.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Manage and support internal KPI s, Oracle Fusion Payroll implementation projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
Should be able to interpret functional requirements and able to deliver and design it from onsite and offshore. If required, ready to travel to onsite
Provide functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Payroll and related Oracle HCM modules like Absence and time & labor, payroll elements, balances, payroll flows, costing, retro pay, Core HR
Collaborate with clients to understand their payroll, and related HCM processes and requirements and provide recommendations for improvements and optimizations. Conduct fit-gap analysis, configuration, functional design documentation, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Identify and mitigate system risks by evaluating functional and cross-functional dependencies, proactively recommend process improvements based on best practices.
Develop and maintain project documentation using AIM / OUM / TCM / Agile or other prescribed methodologies, including functional specifications, payroll configuration workbooks, test plans, and user guides.
Drive and assist business users during Prototype/CRPs/SITs/UATs/KUTs and prepare payroll test scripts, payroll cycle test cases, costing validation scenarios and conduct trainings.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Oracle Fusion Payroll and Human Resources, providing timely and effective support to clients.
Ensure project timelines, milestones, and deliverables are met and function as the primary functional consultant for stakeholder alignment.
Stay updated with the latest Oracle Fusion Payroll and Oracle Fusion HCM features, functionalities, and industry best practices to provide innovative solutions to clients.
Participate in proposal development and client presentations.
Guide junior consultants, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
Experience
Core experience in Payroll and Human Resource with localization knowhow and having HR/payroll domain/process knowledge is preferred.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience working in ERP HR modules (EBS /Fusion) in Oracle Fusion Payroll, Absence, Time and labor with implementation and support experience with a focus on functional consulting.
Should have worked in at least 2-3 full life cycle implementations in Oracle Fusion Payroll, Oracle HCM Cloud, Oracle EBS, and emerging ERP platforms.
In-depth knowledge of Oracle Fusion Payroll, Oracle HCM suite and its integration with other Oracle applications suits.
Lead the team either from the onsite and offshore, manage delivery independently.
Experience in payroll costing and integration with Manpower planning, Attendance, Time and Labour or downstream finance systems.
Familiarity with Oracle Reporting Tools (OTBI, BI Publisher), payroll reports, payroll flows and integrations using HCM Extracts.
Demonstrated expertise in Oracle Fusion Payroll, payroll elements, balances, fast formulas, payroll costing, retro pay, Core HR, and Time and Labour
Knowledge of configuration workbooks, Fast Formulas, Payroll Rules, payroll elements, balances, costing, payment methods, payroll processes and payroll reporting is desirable.
Prior consulting experience in a Big Four or similar environment is an asset.
Experience in any of the major industry sectors like Retail, Government, Energy, Real Estate, Oil & Gas, Power & Utilities and Finance & Banking
Competencies / Skills
Strong customer handling skills and ability to lead & mentor team-members
Ability to drive projects along with the team and independently
Strong communication skills and ability to translate requirements into design documents.
Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines
Excellent organizational and time management skills, strong analytical & problem-solving skills
Ability to acquire, absorb, and apply complex business knowledge to problems quickly
Ability to work as part of a team
Ability to follow well defined release management processes
Ability to multitask and still stay focused on release priorities
Education
Should be a graduate with an MBA in HRMS/HCM and preferably with Oracle Payroll/Fusion HCM certification and having professional certification (e.g., SHRM, HRCI) is a plus

Job Summary
Position: Graphics Designer - Senior Associate
Education: Any Graduate
Experience: 5 - 8 years of relevant experience
The Opportunity
This position will support the design and development of engaging visual content for eLearning modules and other digital learning materials. The Graphics Designer will work to agreed design quality standards and processes, using approved templates and tools, and will collaborate with other designers and learning professionals to enhance the quality and effectiveness of visual learning solutions. Additionally, the designer will develop and maintain strong relationships with content owners, Subject Matter Reviewers (SMRs), and other stakeholders.
Your Key Responsibilities
Proficiently create and customize eLearning modules using development tools, implementing interactive elements and assessments.
Independently produce high-quality graphic designs and layouts, mentoring junior designers in the process.
Manage LMS content areas, troubleshooting issues and providing user support while mentoring others in LMS usage.
Design and implement interactive elements for eLearning modules, creating complex interactive experiences.
Produce animations and videos, including storyboarding, editing, and post-production, contributing to creative brainstorming sessions.
Create a wide range of visual assets, including complex graphics and illustrations, guiding junior designers in asset production.
Design sophisticated typographic and layout solutions, setting benchmarks for quality and brand compliance.
Ensure all designs meet accessibility standards, advocating for inclusive design practices and mentoring others in best practices.
Design and implement gamification strategies within eLearning modules to enhance engagement and learning retention.
Craft compelling visual narratives that align with project messages and goals, developing storyboards and providing creative direction.
Apply design principles to enhance project outcomes, mentoring junior designers in effective design practices.
Communicate design ideas clearly, gathering feedback effectively and engaging in collaborative discussions.
Translate complex storyboards into detailed visual designs that enhance learning, providing guidance to junior designers.
Conduct thorough quality assurance reviews, ensuring visual consistency and functionality of eLearning materials.
Audit design work for brand compliance, mentoring junior designers on adherence to brand standards.
Facilitate effective teamwork by coordinating tasks and supporting team members, taking a proactive role in projects.
Adapt designs in response to feedback and evolving project requirements, proactively seeking solutions to design challenges.
Build strong relationships with SMRs and project teams, effectively gathering requirements and incorporating feedback.
Provide mentorship to junior designers, leading by example in design projects and supporting their professional development.
Foresee and proactively deal with challenges in projects
Skills and Attributes for Success
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with content owners, SMRs, and other stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate design concepts and engage in collaborative feedback.
Ability to adapt to a constantly changing and growing business environment.
Good problem-solving skills and a customer service-focused mindset.
Proactive in mentoring junior team members and facilitating effective teamwork.
To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have
5 to 8 years of experience in graphic design and eLearning development.
Advanced proficiency with graphic design software and eLearning development tools which must include:
Articulate Rise & Storyline 360
MS Word, PowerPoint, and whiteboarding applications (ie Miro/Mural/MS Whiteboard)
Videos
Adobe (iPDFs/Flipbooks)
A foundational understanding of LMS platforms and content management.
Experience building and maintaining strong relationships with business customers/clients.
Ability to work in fast-paced, stressful environments to deliver required results.
What We Look For
An experienced graphics designer who can support multiple projects concurrently.
A professional who can quickly problem-solve and offer perspective on solutions.
A professional who demonstrates resilience and is energized by working in a global environment, proactively seeking different opinions and valuing diverse perspectives.

Description:
EY - Risk Consulting - Senior (Risk Analytics)
As part of our Digital Risk (DR) team within Risk Consulting, we are seeking a Senior Consultant with strong business understanding, analytical capability and hands-on experience in process mining and data analytics to join the DR team and work with our clients on some of the most prestigious projects catering to various sectors across the MENA region. This is an excellent opportunity to join a leading consulting practice and contribute to shaping next-generation digital and analytics-driven risk solutions.
This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the state of Kerala.
Your key responsibilities
Design, develop and deploy process mining dashboards using platforms such as Celonis and Power BI to analyze and optimize processes.
Perform deep-dive analysis on core business processes, identifying bottlenecks, root causes and improvement opportunities.
Develop root-cause-driven insights and actionable recommendations to improve efficiency, quality and compliance.
Extract, transform and prepare data from ERP and business applications (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, Salesforce, Workday, etc.) to support process mining and analytics initiatives.
Design and develop ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python and data integration tools to create process mining event logs and reporting datasets.
Perform data mapping, data modelling and process event reconstruction to enable end-to-end process visibility.
Work closely with business and technology teams to understand process flows, source systems and data structures required for process mining analysis.
Support the onboarding of new data sources into process mining platforms such as Celonis, Signavio and ARIS.
Validate process mining datasets through reconciliation, completeness checks and data quality assessments.
Assist in developing process mining use cases, KPIs and dashboards by leveraging transactional and master data from enterprise systems.
Skills and attributes for success
Hands-on experience with
Process Mining & Analytics
Experience with Celonis, Signavio, ARIS Process Mining or similar platforms preferred.
Candidates with strong SQL, ETL, Data Engineering or Data Analytics experience and willingness to learn Process Mining are encouraged to apply.
Understanding of business process analysis, workflow optimization and operational excellence concepts.
Data Engineering & Integration
Strong SQL skills including complex joins, stored procedures, views and performance optimization.
Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, Alteryx or similar tools.
Experience working with large transactional datasets from ERP and enterprise applications.
Understanding of data modelling, data lineage, data transformation and data quality concepts.
Programming & Analytics
Python, SQL, PQL (preferred), R (optional).
Data analysis, automation and scripting experience.
Exposure to machine learning and statistical analysis is advantageous.
Dashboarding & Visualization
Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or similar BI platforms.
Enterprise Platforms
SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Workday, Azure, AWS, GCP or similar enterprise ecosystems.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science or a related field.
4 to 8 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
Process Mining
Data Analytics
Data Engineering
Business Intelligence
Process Improvement
Experience working with Big4 is a strong advantage.
A valid passport for travel.
Preferred Experience
Experience creating event logs and process datasets from SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365 or other ERP platforms.
Exposure to process mining concepts such as event logs, case IDs, process variants, conformance checking and root cause analysis.
Knowledge of process mining platforms such as Celonis, SAP Signavio or ARIS is desirable but not mandatory.
Experience with data integration, data warehousing and cloud-based analytics platforms.
Understanding of Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), HR or similar business processes.

Job Summary
EY-Digital Risk - Cloud Security
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be joining the Digital Risk Consulting Team.
The opportunity
We're looking for Senior Consultant with expertise in Cloud Security and Risk Assessment to lead the audit/review of security architecture and controls across hybrid cloud environments. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering.
Your key responsibilities
Evaluate key cloud security solutions such as Cloud Security Posture Management CSPM, Cloud Workload Protection Platforms CWPP, Identity and Access Management IAM, Cloud Access Security Brokers CASB, Web Application Firewalls WAF, Cloud encryption and key management services, Security Information and Event Management SIEM, and security automation tools with respect to hybrid cloud security posture AWS, Azure, GCP, and on-premises.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the implementation and operations of vulnerability management and patching programs, including timely identification, prioritization, and remediation of cloud and on-premises vulnerabilities
Evaluate security hardening standards and secure cloud configuration best practices across all environments.
Assess AWS, Azure, and GCP environments against industry standards, regulatory requirements, and cloud security best practices.
Review and design cloud security architectures, landing zones, network segmentation, identity and access management, privileged access management, encryption, and key management controls.
Conduct cloud security strategy, maturity, governance, and target-state assessments to support cloud adoption and transformation initiatives.
Perform technical security configuration reviews across cloud infrastructure, platforms, containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, and cloud-native security controls.
Assess cloud security posture using CSPM and CNAPP solutions such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Prisma Cloud, or equivalent tools.
Conduct cloud security audits, risk and compliance reviews, maturity assessments, and third-party or vendor security assessments.
Develop actionable security improvement recommendations and prioritised roadmap strategies based on identified cloud risks, control gaps, and target-state objectives
Evaluate DevSecOps implementation to embed security into CI CD pipelines and cloud deployments.
Evaluate the current practice followed of cloud security monitoring and incident management
Conducting risk assessments and vulnerability analyses in cloud environments and propose mitigation strategies
Support larger Internal Audit and Cyber security audits engagements especially on domains related to cloud security
Develop cloud security policies procedures to protect data in the cloud and prevent unauthorized access.
Good understanding of cloud security standards regulations globally and within the MENA region KSA, UAE, Qatar
Communicate cloud security risks, strategies, and remediation plans clearly to technical teams and senior management
Ability to translate complex technical details into clear, business understandable language for effective communication with stakeholders business users
Skills and attributes for success
Strong technical knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI and on-premises security architectures and controls.
Proven ability to evaluate cloud security technologies, policies and processes.
Experience conducting cloud risk assessments against global MENA specific standards regulations
Experience managing cloud security metrics, reporting, and audit readiness.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in incident management and response in cloud environments.
Familiarity with DevSecOps and secure CI CD practices in Cloud
To qualify for the role, you must have
5-8 years of experience in cloud security, with hands-on expertise in hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Knowledge of CIS Benchmarks, NIST, ISO 27001, CSA CCM, and cloud security best practices.
Experience leading client workshops, assessments, cloud security strategy engagements, and preparing executive-level reports and recommendations.
Open to travel to MENA up to 50% of the time
Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred
Ideally, you ll also have
A bachelors or masters degree in B TECH/B E, MS in computer science, MBA (IT or Systems) or a related discipline.
Certifications such as CCSP, CCSK, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, or CISM preferred.
Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for Consultants with knowledge in UKG Pro Workforce Management to join the GDS PC team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading global professional services organisation whilst being instrumental in the growth of the GDS PC team.
Your Key Responsibilities
Support client projects leveraging deep knowledge and understanding of Time Management, Attendance, Leave Management, Forecasting and Labour Scheduling and other components of Workforce management processes and systems
Work on client projects as part of a global distributed team. Ensure quality of all work outputs, timeliness and accuracy of content.
Be recognized as a subject matter expert in one or more areas in the Workforce management domain.
Participate in full life cycle activities (Discovery, Design, Configuration, Build, Testing, Knowledge Transfer, Migration and Postproduction Support)
Support development of thought leadership, collateral, tools, techniques and methodologies to build and enhance Workforce management service offerings within the practice
Management and support EY initiatives within the practice
Drive effective client communication, cadence and build relations with client and project team counterparts across global locations. Ensure to obtain excellent feedback from the client and global project counterparts
Skills and attributes for success
High integrity and commitment to work in a new and challenging environment
Ability to manage ambiguity and be proactive
Strong communication and presentation skills
Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity
High energy levels, agility and adaptability
Open to travel nationally and internationally for client projects that are approved as per EY and country specific travel advisory guidelines.
Ideally, you ll also
3-4 years of relevant experience
Minimum 1-2 years of experience in Workforce management (Time management, attendance, forecasting, scheduling, etc.) and Payroll consulting
Bachelor s degree or equivalent
Experience of working in a consulting environment on global client projects
Demonstrated technical proficiencies in WFM; a practical/business driven approach to solving complex global Work Force Management client challenges
Strong technical knowledge and experience of end-to-end Work Force Management process
Analytical abilities and knowledge of Excel, Word and PowerPoint
Expertise in process mapping and documentation using Visio and other tools
Expertise in creating SOP, process documentation and work instructions
Ability to undertake Work Force Management process review and improvement activities including the identification of process efficiencies and control effectiveness.
Exposure to work force transformation programs enabled by technology. Led or been part of a work stream in multi work stream transformation program
Involved in policy review, current Work Force Management assessments, vendor selections, designing payroll processes and strategies at global level, global payroll implementation support
What we look for
Professionals who are independent, self-motivated, proactive, results-oriented and able to provide a high level of customer satisfaction through the delivery of world-class support services. Apart from day-to-day activities, the candidate is expected to be involved in strategic planning to grow the team.
Technical experts with commercial acumen, relevant experiences and high degree of enthusiasm to adapt and learn in a fast-moving environment
Professionals who are willing to work in an environment of continual professional development, drive to take on new responsibilities and projects and work experiences with clients across geographies

Description:
Job Summary
As part of our Digital Risk (DR) team within Risk Consulting, we are seeking a Manager with strong business understanding, analytical capability and hands-on experience in process mining and data analytics to join the DR team and work with our clients on some of the most prestigious projects catering to various sectors across the MENA region. This is an excellent opportunity to join a leading consulting practice and contribute to shaping next-generation digital and analytics-driven risk solutions.
Location: Based out of offices in Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
Your key responsibilities
Design, develop and oversee the deployment of process mining dashboards using platforms such as Celonis and Power BI to analyze and optimize processes.
Perform and validate deep-dive analysis on core business processes, identifying bottlenecks, root causes and improvement opportunities.
Develop and review root-cause-driven insights and actionable recommendations to improve efficiency, quality and compliance.
Extract, transform and prepare data from ERP and business applications (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, Salesforce, Workday, etc.) to support process mining and analytics initiatives.
Design and develop ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python and data integration tools to create process mining event logs and reporting datasets.
Perform data mapping, data modelling and process event reconstruction to enable end-to-end process visibility.
Support the onboarding of new data sources into process mining platforms such as Celonis, Signavio and ARIS.
Validate process mining datasets through reconciliation, completeness checks and data quality assessments.
Assist in developing process mining use cases, KPIs and dashboards by leveraging transactional and master data from enterprise systems.
Lead a team of Senior Consultants and independently drive client discussions and communications.
Groom junior resources and participate in business development activities.
Provide timely and constructive feedback to junior staff and manage team/individual KPIs and other performance metrics.
Skills and attributes for success
Hands-on experience with:
Process Mining & Analytics
Experience with Celonis, Signavio, ARIS Process Mining or similar platforms preferred.
Candidates with strong SQL, ETL, Data Engineering or Data Analytics experience and willingness to learn Process Mining are encouraged to apply.
Understanding of business process analysis, workflow optimization and operational excellence concepts.
Data Engineering & Integration
Strong SQL skills including complex joins, stored procedures, views and performance optimization.
Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, Alteryx or similar tools.
Experience working with large transactional datasets from ERP and enterprise applications.
Understanding of data modelling, data lineage, data transformation and data quality concepts.
Programming & Analytics
Python, SQL, PQL (preferred), R (optional).
Data analysis, automation and scripting experience.
Exposure to machine learning and statistical analysis is advantageous.
Dashboarding & Visualization
Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or similar BI platforms.
Enterprise Platforms
SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Workday, Azure, AWS, GCP or similar enterprise ecosystems.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor's/Master's degree in computer science, data science or a related field.
8 to 10 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
Process Mining
Data Analytics
Data Engineering
Business Intelligence
Process Improvement
Experience working with Big4 is a strong advantage.
A valid passport for travel.
Preferred Experience
Experience creating event logs and process datasets from SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365 or other ERP platforms.
Exposure to process mining concepts such as event logs, case IDs, process variants, conformance checking and root cause analysis.
Knowledge of process mining platforms such as Celonis, SAP Signavio or ARIS is desirable but not mandatory.
Experience with data integration, data warehousing and cloud-based analytics platforms.
Understanding of Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), HR or similar business processes.

Job Summary
As a Business Analyst - you will support business analysis and requirement management activities by working closely with Analysts, Senior Analysts and project leadership. You will contribute to translating business needs into clearly documented requirements and support the delivery of digitally enabled solutions across client engagements. This role focuses on learning Accenture delivery methodologies, tools and ways of working while building foundational consulting and analysis skills.


Roles and Responsibilities
Support the analysis of current-state (as-is) processes and assist in documenting future-state (to-be) processes under the direction of senior team members.
Assist in planning, preparing and documenting client workshops, interviews and requirement gathering sessions.
Work with client and internal stakeholders to understand stated requirements and contribute to documentation using process models, basic story maps, data analysis, and document reviews.
Support day-to-day communication with delivery teams by helping clarify documented requirements and assumptions.
Assist with iteration planning, backlog refinement and sprint activities, including drafting user stories and acceptance criteria under guidance.
Support stakeholder engagement activities and help maintain alignment between the project team, client, and project leadership.
Contribute to the identification of solution options by documenting business needs, dependencies and constraints to support decision-making.
Create and maintain requirement artefacts (user stories, process flows, functional documentation) based on Accenture and client-defined standards.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to gather inputs required for analysis and documentation.
Support alignment between requirements, solution design and implementation artefacts, escalating gaps or inconsistencies when identified.
Assist in maintaining requirement traceability, accuracy and version control throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Qualification
Professional and Technical Skill
Foundational knowledge of business analysis and requirement documentation practices using structured templates and tools.
Ability to understand project scope, objectives, and inception documentation with guidance.
Exposure to Agile and iterative delivery methodologies, including backlog refinement and sprint execution.
Ability to proactively raise issues, risks and clarifications to Analysts, Senior Analysts or Project Managers.
Basic application awareness of enterprise or commerce platforms (e.g. SAP Hybris, Salesforce or similar) is beneficial.
Demonstrates structured thinking and clear communication, shows learning agility, proactively takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, and collaborates effectively within a team-based delivery environment.
Ability to think in terms of systems, roles & system capabilities
Ability to aid clients in making data driven decisions by using data analysis tools such as Excel & guide clients towards solutions to their business problems
Ability to do market research to understand client''s business
Ability to use AI tools efficiently
Exposure to the following is considered a plus
JIRA / Azure DevOps for backlog management
Basic SQL
Basic understanding of APIs / system integrations
Analytics tools

We are looking for Executive Assistant who would be required to work in a team environment in delivering the secretarial needs of the global EY office senior management team such as diary management, calendar management, travel management, documentation, tool support and other administrative requirements that may arise on a need basis.
Role Details
Discipline: Executive Assistance CoE
Role Type: Assigned Support / Associate
Responsibilities
The primary role and responsibility of this position will be to work in a team environment and deliver administrative services including, but not limited to
Diary Management - Provide support to the project team members on maintaining and managing key project meetings and the meeting location
Calendar Management - Maintaining project teams calendar to showcase all key events that needs to be planned.
Meetings Management - Working closely with the project teams and other stakeholders in scheduling/organizing the meeting or conference call
Travel Management - Support the project team members in booking the travel tickets
Workshop or Area visit Plan - Help in planning the agenda, for workshops/area visits by handling the logistics of stay, food and printing, etc.
Documentation - Recording the minutes of the meeting with clear emphasis on the key action points from the meeting. Maintaining the project database and ensure all documentations are captured and organized for ease of access.
Training Management - Provide support in setting up training by sending out invites, enabling cut-off point for training sessions, issuing confirmations and/or offering alternative dates. Supplement delegates with correct pre-work and sessions
Tool Support and administration - Administrative support on various internal/external tools used across EY offices
Data Processing and administration - Data capture, processing and administration of business information
Skills and attributes for success
The role requires someone who can manage several concurrent activities, with strong multi-tasking, prioritization, organizational and time management skills.
Administration and organization
Enjoys problem solving
Able to prioritize effectively
Strong project coordination skills
Comfortable using IT systems
Interpersonal skills
Excellent written and oral communication skills
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others
Must be able to work virtually, and independently
Able to be diplomatic when dealing with clients
Flexibility
Respond well to deadlines and work outside of normal hours when required
Comfortable working on several activities concurrently
Able to work in a rapidly changing environment and prioritize accordingly
Key attributes
Professional and diplomatic communicator
Quality focused and takes pride in paying attention to detail
Self-starter, who can manage with minimal direction
Able to interact with senior management
Extremely organized and enjoys administration
Able to work in a team arrangement
Demonstrated experience
Demonstrated experience in MS Office (Word, Excel & PowerPoint) and fair knowledge of MS Outlook
Qualifications
To qualify for the role, you must have Any graduate or Postgraduate
Ideally, you'll also have
1 to 4 Years
At least a year of experience working in a team environment handling virtual secretarial services is preferred
Good command over English (written & spoken) is mandatory

Description:
EYP Staff EYP Financial Restructuring Job Description
Support financial restructuring and turnaround advisory business development activities under the guidance of senior team members. Assist with proposal development support including:
Financial analysis of companies - reviews of historical and forecast performance, profitability, cash flows, working capital and capital structure
Support the team in understanding clients businesses, key financial trends, profitdrivers and potential areas of risk or improvement
Conduct desktop market and industry research, gather relevant data and summarize findings into meaningful insights
Assist with benchmarking analyses, including capital and debt mix, working capital levers, revenue trends and product performance
Prepare clear and well-structured Excel analysis, PowerPoint presentations and supporting reports for business development requirements.
Assist in preparing materials for client discussions, internal reviews and pursuit meetings.
Document the analysis and procedures performed, ensuring that work products are accurate, organized and aligned with project objectives.
Coordinate with team members across different service lines and locations to support data collection and timely project delivery.
Contribute ideas, ask relevant questions and work collaboratively with colleagues in a multicultural and multidisciplinary environment.
Demonstrate attention to detail, adaptability and a willingness to learn while managing assigned responsibilities and deadlines.
This internship provides hands-on exposure to financial restructuring, turnaround, capital advisory and transaction-related projects, supported by structured learning and coaching.
Candidate Profile
Ideal for candidates looking to start their career in finance
Strong academic foundation in finance, accounting and financial statement analysis.
Basic understanding of corporate finance concepts such as cash flow, working capital, debt, capital structure and business performance.
Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and draw logical conclusions.
Good desktop research skills and the ability to identify, organize and summarize relevant market and company information.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with an interest in developing financial analysis and presentation skills.
Knowledge of how to leverage AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot in a business setting would be an added advantage.
Ability to communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate, well-structured work.
Proactive, curious and willing to learn new concepts, industries and analytical approaches.
Able to work effectively both independently on assigned tasks and collaboratively as part of a project team.
Comfortable working across multiple tasks and adapting to changing project requirements and deadlines.
Prior internship, academic project or coursework in corporate finance, banking, restructuring, transactions or consulting would be an advantage but is not mandatory.
Familiarity with the MENA business environment, banking products or Islamic Finance would be an added advantage.
Fluency in English is required, while knowledge of Arabic would be an added advantage.

Job Summary
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Discipline Clients & Industries
Role Type C&I Business Operations Coordinator
Business unit specific description Clients & Industries GDS Europe West
Join our GDS Clients & Industries and you will help support the important business enablement functions that keep our organization running strong. As an Operations professional, you will work across teams both onshore and offshore to provide the knowledge, resources and tools that help EY deliver exceptional quality service to our clients, win in the marketplace and support EY's growth and profitability.
With so many offerings, you can develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring and formal learning. That's how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
The practice also works closely with the Region/Service Line/BD team with the project management / coordination activities. The role requires a comparable work experience, strong skills, work ethic and attention to detail for as the team has a high focus on accuracy and timeliness.
Responsibilities
Maintain pipeline hygiene and ensure the accuracy of sales and revenue data.
Support account management activities and stakeholder engagement.
Prepare business reports, forecasts, and performance updates.
Collaborate with teams to resolve data issues and improve reporting quality.
Provide insights to support business reviews, leadership meetings, and client discussions.
Identify opportunities to improve processes through automation and digital tools.
Skills and attributes for success
Skilled in designing interactive dashboards, reports, and visual narratives that enable stakeholders to quickly interpret trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
Presentation and facilitation skills - Ability to drive meetings, build presentations that interpret the data, creating valuable business insights and delivering the message to the stakeholders
Work under minimal direction/supervision - Be accountable for projects assigned, take complete ownership and drive projects end to end
Business acumen and Adaptability Capable of quickly understanding the needs of the business and be able to align with changing customer expectations
Quick learner - Ability to grasp or quickly understand the process, objectives / intricacies of projects and move to delivery mode in a short span
Attention to detail - Utmost importance to numbers, formatting etc.
Excellent Communication - Listening, reading, writing & speaking skills
MS Office skills: Advanced level experience in Excel reporting & PowerPoint.
Power BI/Other BI tools/ Alteryx - Data Integration and Data Visualization etc.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 3 - 6 years work experience in professional services industry.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ideally, youll also have
The role demands expertise in Power BI and related Microsoft Power Platform tools, including PowerApps and Power Automate, to design, develop, and maintain robust data solutions. A strong work ethic, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy and timeliness are essential to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Experience doing secondary research using Google and other external sources like Factiva, Company Inforgator, BoardEx, OneSource etc
Content management Familiar with maintenance of SharePoint, preparation of newsletters, managing surveys etc.
Private Equity/Investment Banking Industry experience preferable but not essential.

Job Title
EY- Assurance Senior Associate
Job Summary
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
Were looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, you'll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Description:
Job Summary
The Regional Contracts & Supplier Governance Assistant Manager serves as a key enabler of effective contract management, supplier governance, and procurement compliance across the UK&I business. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end contract lifecycle, supporting supplier onboarding and governance activities, and ensuring adherence to contractual, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
Acting as a central point of coordination between business stakeholders, Procurement, Risk, Finance, and suppliers, the Assistant Manager drives operational excellence through robust governance, process optimization, reporting, and continuous improvement. The role ensures that third-party engagements are managed efficiently, risks are mitigated, and supplier relationships deliver sustainable value and strategic business outcomes.
Your key responsibilities
Manage contract and supplier governance mailboxes, providing guidance and coordinating contract requests through to execution.
Draft, review, negotiate, and administer supplier contracts while ensuring compliance with procurement and governance requirements.
Oversee contract execution processes, including approvals, DocuSign workflows, and maintenance of executed agreements.
Maintain contract repositories, lifecycle trackers, renewals, and audit-ready documentation.
Support supplier onboarding, vendor enablement, and supplier due diligence activities.
Manage supplier governance programs, MSA renewals, performance reviews, and compliance obligations.
Ensure adherence to risk, compliance, and third-party governance frameworks, escalating issues where required.
Support procurement and sourcing activities, including supplier evaluations and governance approvals.
Prepare management reports, dashboards, and analytics on contracts, suppliers, compliance, and performance metrics.
Coordinate audit reviews, remediation activities, invoice governance, and payment-related issue resolution.
Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, stakeholder training, and continuous enhancement of contract management practices.
Ariba supply chain management life cycle
Skills and attributes for success
Demonstrates expertise in leveraging advanced analytics platforms and visualization tools (such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, or similar) to transform raw data into actionable insights.
Skilled in designing interactive dashboards, reports, and visual narratives that enable stakeholders to quickly interpret trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
Presentation and facilitation skills - Ability to drive meetings, build presentations that interpret the data, creating valuable business insights and delivering the message to the stakeholders
Work under minimal direction/supervision - Be accountable for projects assigned, take complete ownership and drive projects end to end
Business acumen and Adaptability Capable of quickly understanding the needs of the business and be able to align with changing customer expectations
Quick learner - Ability to grasp or quickly understand the process, objectives / intricacies of projects and move to delivery mode in a short span
Attention to detail - Utmost importance to numbers, formatting etc.
Excellent Communication - Listening, reading, writing & speaking skills
MS Office skills: Advanced level experience in Excel reporting & PowerPoint.
Power BI/Other BI tools/ Alteryx - Data Integration and Data Visualization etc.
High degree of professionalism and integrity
To qualify for the role, you must have
Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 6 - 8 years work experience in professional services industry.
Strong understanding of data analytics, best practices when developing solutions and experience in solution development, specifically utilizing Microsoft Power Platform.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ideally, youll also have
The role demands expertise in Power BI and related Microsoft Power Platform tools, including PowerApps and Power Automate, to design, develop, and maintain robust data solutions. A strong work ethic, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy and timeliness are essential to ensure high-quality deliverables.
What we look for
Self-motivated towards continuous learning and upskilling.
Solution oriented - Ability to focus on solutions in case of ambiguity /uncertainties and not stuck with the problem.
Display a positive attitude, interest in learning new things, capability to work under pressure and thinking out of the box with strategic mindset.
Content management Familiar with maintenance of SharePoint, MS office (Excel and PowerPoint proficiency is a must)

Description:
Job Summary
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence.
A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value.
Your key responsibilities
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations.
The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing.
Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation.
Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting.
Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including:
Workflow execution metrics
OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends
Drift detection signals
ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation
Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including:
Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
Virtualization platforms Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware
Kubernetes cluster concepts pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization
Network fundamentals VLANs, DNS, IP management
Storage and compute provisioning concepts
Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources.
Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting.
Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources.
Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources.
Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks:
Python (pandas, NumPy, requests)
PowerShell
Bash
Strong written and verbal communication skills able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences.
Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones.
To qualify for the role, you must have experience with
Power BI report and dashboard development 57 years.
Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations 57 years.
ELK stack data analysis Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development 35 years.
SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores 57 years.
KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services.
Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent).
Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data metrics, logs, workflow events and traces.
Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms.
Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis.
Workflow orchestration data analysis Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics.
OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting.
Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis.
Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data.
Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI).
Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation 35 years.
PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection.
Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery.
Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred).
Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred).
Ideally, you'll also have
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired).
Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have).
ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have).
Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms.
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data.
Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP ABAP Developer with 5-8 years of hands-on experience in SAP development. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting ABAP programs, reports, interfaces, enhancements, forms, and workflows while working closely with functional consultants and business stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, customize, and maintain SAP ABAP programs based on business requirements.
Design and develop Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms, and Workflows (RICEFW).
Work on Classical Reports, Interactive Reports, ALV Reports, SmartForms, SAP Scripts, and Adobe Forms.
Develop and support BDCs, BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, Customer Exits, and Enhancement Framework objects.
Develop interfaces using IDocs, RFCs, Web Services, and APIs.
Collaborate with functional consultants to understand business requirements and provide technical solutions.
Perform unit testing, debugging, code reviews, and performance tuning.
Prepare technical specifications and development documentation.
Support SAP implementation, rollout, migration, and enhancement projects.

Description:
EY- Assurance Senior
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.

Educational Criteria : Must be a Qualified CA - Fresher or Upto 1 yr exp.

The opportunity
Were looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.

Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team’s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one’s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one’s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.

Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.

Ideally, you’ll also have
Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.

What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Role summary
Managerial Responsibilities:

Technical Responsibilities:
