Description:
Role & responsibilities
SAP controls design, integration and assurance
Lead pre- and post-implementation control design assessments, fit-gap reviews, configuration testing, and operating effectiveness support across R2R, O2C, P2P, P2M and related cross-functional processes.
Oversee development and review of control activity narratives (CANs), manual control procedures (MCPs), control test scripts (CTSs), risk and control matrices (RCMs), process flows and control ownership/RACI documentation.
Assess automated application controls, configurable controls, interfaces, key reports, data dependencies, exception handling, and manual controls reliant on SAP-generated information.
Challenge design deviations, identify control gaps, evaluate business and financial reporting impact, and recommend remediation or compensating controls with clear ownership and deadlines.
Oversee RICEFW/WRICEF reviews, functional specifications, custom enhancements, defect and change assessments, testing evidence, and control impacts throughout project releases and hypercare.
Technology risk, security and regulatory compliance
Direct SAP ITGC reviews covering user access, privileged access, authentication, change management, operations, logging, and configuration governance, aligned to relevant SOX and audit requirements.
Guide SAP GRC and Pathlock-related reviews, including access request approvals, periodic access reviews, segregation of duties (SoD), sensitive access, ruleset governance and mitigating controls.
Provide implementation assurance through design checkpoints, go-live readiness reviews, risk escalation, remediation validation, and coordination with internal and external assurance teams.
Engagement and people leadership
Own engagement planning, budgets, resourcing, work allocation, milestones, quality review, issue resolution and senior stakeholder reporting across concurrent projects.
Coach and review multidisciplinary teams; set clear expectations for documentation, evidence sufficiency, technical accuracy, productivity, and timely delivery.
Build trusted relationships with overseas engagement teams, client process owners, SAP functional and technical leads, compliance teams, and program management offices.
Contribute to proposals, solution development, methodology improvement, knowledge assets, reusable testing accelerators and practice growth.

Job Details:
The Sr. Infrastructure Engineer will play a critical role in managing and optimizing our infrastructure systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in VMWare technologies and will be responsible for ensuring the stability, performance, and security of our infrastructure. This position requires a proactive approach to problem-solving and a commitment to delivering high-quality infrastructure solutions that meet the needs of our organization.

Responsibilities:
Design, implement, and manage VMWare environments to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
Monitor and maintain infrastructure systems, including servers, storage, and network components.
Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure-related issues in a timely manner.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support application deployments and infrastructure upgrades.
Develop and maintain documentation for infrastructure processes, configurations, and procedures.
Implement and manage backup and disaster recovery solutions to ensure data integrity and availability.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies to recommend improvements to infrastructure systems.
Participate in capacity planning and performance tuning of infrastructure resources.
Provide technical support and guidance to junior team members.

Mandatory Skills:
Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with VMWare technologies, including vSphere, vCenter, and ESXi.
Proficiency in managing virtualized environments and understanding of virtualization best practices.
Experience with infrastructure monitoring tools and performance tuning.
Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols.
Familiarity with backup and disaster recovery solutions.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.

Preferred Skills:
Knowledge of cloud technologies and hybrid cloud environments.
Experience with automation tools and scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python).
Familiarity with ITIL processes and best practices.
Experience with storage solutions and SAN technologies.
Certifications related to VMWare or infrastructure management (e.g., VCP, VCAP).

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Relevant certifications in VMWare or infrastructure management are highly desirable.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously

The accolades we have been garnering can be attributed to our undeterred focus in delivering quality solutions across verticals that meet the challenging requirements of our esteemed customers. Our integrated solutions offering is aimed at creating value for our customers, helping them in improving their business processes with minimum hassles and capital outlays. The perfect blend of technical excellence, business performance monitoring, business intelligence and customer experience management is what makes us endearing to our clients.

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Description:
AI Agent Developer- Senior Associate
Responsibilities
- Develop and optimize AI agents using Python, integrating with OpenAI API, Claude, and Azure AI Foundry for advanced natural language processing capabilities.
- Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and Prompt Engineering techniques to improve agent accuracy and contextual understanding.
- Build scalable multi-agent systems using Multi-Agent Frameworks, LangGraph, LangChain, and AutoGen for orchestrating complex AI workflows and interactions.
- Develop and maintain REST APIs to expose agent functionalities, ensuring seamless integration with cloud platforms and external systems.
- Implement observability and monitoring solutions to track agent performance, system health, and facilitate debugging across cloud environments.
-Manage data storage and querying with SQL databases, harnessing Agent Core and Github for version control and collaboration in building AI Code Assistants.
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
Expert in developing and optimizing AI agents using Python, seamlessly integrating with cutting-edge APIs like OpenAI, Claude, and Azure AI Foundry to deliver advanced NLP solutions.
- Proven ability to design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and apply sophisticated Prompt Engineering techniques that significantly enhance agent accuracy and contextual relevance.
- Skilled in building scalable, collaborative AI ecosystems using Multi-Agent Frameworks, LangGraph, LangChain, and AutoGen to orchestrate complex, multi-agent workflows efficiently.
- Experienced in developing and maintaining robust REST APIs that enable smooth integration of AI agents with diverse cloud platforms and third-party systems.
- Strong background in implementing comprehensive observability and monitoring frameworks to ensure high performance, reliability, and maintainability of AI systems in cloud environments.
- Proficient in managing data with SQL databases and leveraging tools like Agent Core and GitHub for version control, collaboration, and accelerating the development of AI Code Assistants.

Responsibilities:
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and identify opportunities to apply Agentic AI and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions to solve complex enterprise problems.
Design, develop, and implement advanced GenAI and Agentic AI systems, including ReAct agents (Reasoning + Acting frameworks), multi-agent architectures, and autonomous AI workflows.
Build and deploy intelligent AI-powered chatbots and conversational agents using LLMs, tool-calling frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory modules, and agent orchestration patterns.
Ensure consistency, reliability, and alignment in AI-generated outputs through prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring mechanisms.
Develop and implement machine learning models and algorithms to support GenAI applications, including fine-tuning, embeddings, and hybrid AI architectures.
Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, and feature engineering to prepare structured and unstructured data for machine learning and GenAI pipelines.
Collaborate with data engineers to design efficient data pipelines and integrate ML/LLM systems into scalable production environments.
Validate and evaluate model and agent performance using appropriate metrics (accuracy, latency, hallucination rate, consistency scoring, human evaluation frameworks).
Develop and deploy production-ready AI applications using object-oriented programming principles, ensuring modularity, scalability, maintainability, and robustness.
Implement containerized AI solutions using Docker and Kubernetes for orchestration, scaling, and cloud-native deployments.
Design and implement tool-augmented agents, API-integrated workflows, and autonomous decision-making systems using modern AI agent frameworks.
Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate AI insights and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously stay updated with advancements in GenAI, Agentic AI, multi-agent systems, LLM orchestration, and emerging AI frameworks, recommending innovative approaches to enhance enterprise AI capabilities.
Requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
7+ years of relevant technical/technology experience, with a focus on GenAI projects.
Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, R, or Scala.

Role: Workday Recruiting Consultant
Exp: 2 to 10 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM, Recruiting certification.
Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up Questionnaires, Job requisitions, Evergreen Requisitions.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring Job Posting Templates, Career Sites, Job Applications Business Process while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on configuring Referrals, Prospects, Candidates.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Compensation, Absence, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Recruiting.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Recruiting areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Advanced Compensation, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

Skill: Platform Infra Engineer- GCP
Exp: 8yrs to 13 yrs
Location- Bangalore/ Hyderabad/ Pune
NP- Immediate- 30 days Joiners

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop cloud-native APIs, microservices, and serverless applications on GCP.
Build real-time data processing solutions using Cloud Functions, Kafka, and Pub/Sub.
Develop scalable data platforms leveraging BigQuery, Snowflake, data lakes, and cloud storage.
Integrate CDPs, CRMs, analytics, and activation platforms to support personalization and customer journeys.
Implement CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, Docker, and GCP deployment tools.
Ensure security, monitoring, IAM governance, authentication (OIDC, Workload Identity Federation), and cloud cost optimization.

Strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), serverless computing, REST APIs, and microservices.

Experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka, Pub/Sub, Event Hubs, or Kinesis.
Proficiency in Docker, container registries, and CI/CD automation.
Good understanding of cloud security, IAM, networking, observability, and monitoring.
Experience collaborating with Data Engineering, Data Science, and MarTech teams.
Preferred
Experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code).
Knowledge of React-based application deployments.
GCP Associate Cloud Engineer or Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer certification.

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.

Worked on various pieces of CPU/GPU unit/microarchitecture verification

Description:
Job Description
Overview
AtkinsR alis is one of the world s most respected design, engineering and project management consultancies, with a proven track record of more than 75 years of relevant experience in the industry. AtkinsR alis is a leading provider of consultancy services in the field of master planning, economics and sustainability; architecture environmental management; landscape & urban design; infrastructure planning; and engineering and transportation analysis, offering professional advice, engineering and environmental consultancy and design solutions.
As a provider of multi-disciplinary technical design services to the built environment, AtkinsR alis India is committed to design excellence in the delivery of first-class solutions which combine innovation, imagination and best practice.
Your Role
Roles & Responsibilities
A sound understanding of electrical engineering principles and their application in Water, Wastewater Treatment plant and pumping stations.
Experience in the production of design documentations including optioneering reports, data sheets, calculations, and specifications of electrical equipment.
Undertake Electrical design to local and international standards, preferably for UK region.
Understand and apply BS/NEC/NFPA/IEC/International standards.
Undertake design of a variety of electrical design elements i.e., MV & LV Distribution, Grounding, Lighting design (internal and external), Cable management, Sizing, Fire Alarm Protection & Detection system.
Electrical Equipment calculations, Cable and cable tray sizing calculations, grounding calculation, lighting calculation (using Dialux EVO, AGI32), Lightening assessment etc.
A competent user of IT tools in particular Word, Excel, Outlook and Electrical design tools e.g., AMTECH, ETAP, SKM. Dialux Evo, AGI32, Specsizer etc
Liaison with clients (Lead Project Offices), developing and maintaining relationships.
Responsible for completion of projects within his/her team to time, cost and quality.
Should be able to present design solutions to the client requirement.
Check/review electrical drawings and designs deliverables.
Coordinate with other disciplines and improve inter-discipline working with other disciplines such as Mechanical, Architecture, Civil and Structural.
Should have knowledge of 3D Models for check review of Navis works.
Demonstrate ability to cultivate and lead a cohesive team, fostering individual growth and collaboration withing the organization framework.
About You
Qualifications & Skills
Master/Bachelor s Degree in Electrical engineering;
Previous electrical engineering or design role experience within consultancy.
Relevant and appropriate experience of more than 14+ years in Water & Wastewater Treatment plant and Pumping stations.
Experience of working in Multi-D environment and good understanding of co-ordination and interfaces with other disciplines.
Able to independently deliver work and integrate with larger project teams.
Good report writing skills, experience of making presentations to and attending meetings with clients is essential.
Positive and enthusiastic, a confident communicator at all levels, and a collaborator.
Resilient, can work under pressure, doesn t show frustration, and lose composure when facing resistance.
Mandatory Requirements
Relevant and appropriate experience within Water, wastewater treatment plant and pumping station.
Competent designer UK, International codes and standards.
Knowledge of tools such as AMTECH, DIALUX EVO etc.
Review model using Navis tool.
Should have working knowledge of common data environment (CDE) like BIM360, ProjectWise etc.
Manage quality of deliverables of yours as well as the team members.
Maintains harmony and a productive atmosphere by being open about the work activities and project status.
An effective communicator both written and verbal.
People manager and should be able to develop electrical engineers.
Rewards & Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsR alis
Were AtkinsR alis , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the worlds infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. Were committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Find out more.

At AtkinsR alis , we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Lead and coordinate Workday Financials delivery across R2R and P2P workstreams, ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, timelines and dependencies.

Work with client stakeholders to understand business priorities, assess requirements and guide solution decisions.
Manage delivery of enhancements, production support, releases and continuous improvement initiatives.

Track delivery risks, issues, dependencies and escalations, and drive them to closure.
Lead planning, prioritization and allocation of work across the team while balancing delivery commitments and capacity.
Provide guidance, coaching and functional oversight to Senior Associates and Associates.
Support stakeholder reporting, governance discussions and overall service delivery performance.
What You Bring
Approximately 810 years of relevant experience, including strong hands-on experience with Workday Financial Management and experience leading delivery or functional workstreams.
Strong functional knowledge of R2R and/or P2P, with good understanding of end-to-end financial business processes.
Experience across key Workday Financials capabilities such as Accounting, Supplier Accounts, Procurement, Expenses, Banking, Settlement and related business processes.
Experience leading or coordinating multiple functional and technical workstreams within Workday implementations, optimization programs or managed-services engagements.
Strong understanding of the Workday delivery lifecycle, including requirements, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and production support.
Ability to review functional solutions, identify cross-workstream impacts and guide teams toward scalable solutions.
Experience managing client stakeholders, priorities, escalations and competing delivery demands.

Experience mentoring and developing junior team members and providing functional direction.
Experience across both R2R and P2P is preferred; deep expertise in one with good working knowledge of the other is acceptable.
Workday Financial Management certification or relevant accreditation is preferred.

About the Role:
Grade Level (for internal use): 11
Role Summary
The Application Cloud Security Lead will serve as a key security leader within the SP Global Energy Division BISO team, responsible for coordinating security initiatives across application, cloud, and AI-enabled environments. This role directly supports the protection of applications, data, systems, and reputation by proactively managing cyber risk, strengthening resilience and embedding security into everything we do.
The successful candidate will partner with technology, product, engineering, cloud, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure security is integrated into architecture, delivery, operations, and innovation. The role will focus on security architecture reviews, application security governance, cloud security enforcement, AI security oversight, risk remediation, and alignment with enterprise cybersecurity standards.
This position requires a hands-on security leader who can translate cybersecurity requirements into practical controls, influence engineering teams, guide secure design decisions, and drive measurable improvements in cyber resilience across the Energy Division.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate application, cloud, and AI security initiatives across the SP Global Energy Division in alignment with SP Global's cyber risk management objectives.
Conduct security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data flows, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions to identify risks and recommend secure design improvements.
Partner with engineering, product, architecture, cloud, and business teams to embed security requirements into solution design, development, deployment, and operations.
Enforce application security controls, including secure coding practices, vulnerability remediation, authentication, authorization, secrets management, dependency security, and software supply chain risk management.
Oversee cloud security control implementation across public cloud environments, including identity and access management, network security, encryption, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration.
Review and assess AI and machine learning use cases for security risks, including data leakage, prompt injection, model exposure, access control, third-party AI risk, and misuse scenarios.
Track, prioritize, and drive remediation of application, cloud, and AI security findings, exceptions, and risk acceptances in partnership with accountable technology owners.
Support cyber risk assessments, compliance reviews, audit requests, and security reporting related to Energy Division applications, cloud services, and AI-enabled platforms.
Develop and maintain metrics, dashboards, and executive-level reporting to communicate security posture, risk trends, remediation progress, and key security initiatives.
Serve as a trusted security advisor and liaison between the Energy Division and Enterprise cybersecurity teams, promoting secure-by-design practices and consistent adoption of security standards.
Required Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
5-8+ years experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on application security, cloud security, security architecture, and/or technology risk management.
Experience conducting security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data platforms, and enterprise technology solutions.
Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD security, container security, Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets management, and software supply chain security.
Experience with cloud security tools such as CSPM, CWPP, CNAPP, SIEM, vulnerability management platforms, container scanners, and identity governance tools.
Familiar with AI security concepts such as prompt injection, model access control, sensitive data exposure, model monitoring, adversarial testing, AI red teaming, and third-party AI risk.
Experience working with public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders including technology, product, risk, compliance, privacy, legal, and business teams.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to prioritise risks, influence remediation, and drive outcomes in a complex enterprise environment.
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, SABSA, CCSK, Cloud Vendor Certifications (e.g. AWS Certified Security Specialty, AWS Certified Solution Architect, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer) or equivalent credentials.

Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Description:
#ACN Song GN Reinvention Services Customer Service Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Job Title Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Management Level: L07 Manager
Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai (India; global remit)
Experience: 10+ Years (L07)
Must have skills: Retail Service Reinvention / Customer Service Strategy Transformation; a blend of industry and consulting experience with deep understanding of the end-to-end retail value chain and how it drives service demand, volume and exceptions; experience shaping AI-native / agentic service operating models.
The Practice A Brief Sketch
The practice works with clients across their marketing, commerce, sales and service functions to reinvent how they engage customers. As part of the Reinvention Services Customer Service team, you will help the worlds leading retailers transform service from a reactive, cost-driven function into an intelligence-led, AI-native capability that senses signals in real time, resolves issues before they escalate, and continuously improves from every interaction across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystem driving customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience.
Job summary
As a Retail Service Reinvention Senior Manager / Associate Director, you will advise C-suite executives, shape AI-native service operating models, and lead end-to-end transformation for the worlds leading retailers. Reporting to the Customer Service Managing Director, you will build and lead a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts and carry accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M. The role requires a strong blend of retail domain expertise, consulting leadership, end-to-end value chain understanding, executive stakeholder management, and business development capability to shape and deliver scalable, future-ready retail service solutions.
Roles and responsibilities
Service Strategy Advisory
Define enterprise and omnichannel service strategy across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystems.
Shape AI-native service vision, target operating models and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
Develop business cases, prioritize investment and establish value-realization frameworks.
Advise boards and C-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise-scale change.
Experience Design
Map end-to-end journeys for shoppers (order, delivery, returns, loyalty, complaints), associates (store, picker, contact centre) and suppliers (onboarding, purchase orders, invoicing, disputes).
Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.
Identify moments of truth and design service recovery for stock-outs, failed deliveries, substitutions and disputed refunds.
Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.
Operating Model Process Transformation
Design target operating models spanning shopper services, supplier services, store workforce services, and fulfilment/ecosystem services.
Design the workforce across shoppers, store associates, pickers and inventory teams, contact-centre specialists and leads, supplier account teams, and delivery partners/dispatchers.
Establish governance frameworks policy and business rules, approval/escalation thresholds, SLAs and entitlements, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.
Technology AI Transformation
Set CRM and CCaaS platform strategy (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect).
Shape knowledge and case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk).
Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.
Integrate across order, store and supply-chain systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, supplier/EDI portals) and IoT/GPS-enabled field and delivery tracking.
Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root-cause analysis capability.
Human + Agentic Operations
Design hybrid workforce models blending advisors, associates, AI copilots and autonomous agents across the shopper, supplier, store and fulfilment domains.
Design agents for high-volume service capabilities order status, substitutions, returns, refunds, delivery orchestration, supplier collaboration and dispute resolution.
Lead change management, upskilling and adoption programmes for frontline and support teams.
Establish AI governance, ethics and bias controls, and ongoing model/agent performance oversight.
Enterprise Transformation Delivery
Lead end-to-end programmes from strategy through implementation, adoption and value realisation.
Orchestrate multi-workstream delivery across business, experience, operations, technology and data/AI teams.
Manage executive steering committees and track value against committed business cases.
Practice Building
Develop market-leading thought leadership and intellectual property.
Build reusable methods, accelerators, assets and AI workflows for retail reinvention services.
Coach and mentor consulting teams.
Support business development and strategic pursuits collaborating with Song leadership to identify new opportunities and with Songs Consulting, Technology and Data AI teams for delivery.
Professional Technical Skills
Deep expertise in grocery, apparel or large omnichannel retail, with working knowledge of the end-to-end value chain merchandising and assortment planning, inventory and price management, promotions execution, digital commerce, in-store operations, supplier and partner operations, and last-mile fulfilment and how each stage drives customer demand, service volume and service exceptions.
First-hand practitioner experience inside leading grocery, apparel or omnichannel retailers (not advisory-only) having lived these operations, partnered with frontline teams, and redesigned them at enterprise scale.
Proven track record across service strategy advisory, experience design, operating model transformation, technology AI transformation, and enterprise delivery; consulting background is valuable but strong industry leadership experience counts equally.
Hands-on shopper/customer service experience across the lifecycle: order status and delivery-exception handling; substitutions, out-of-stock and refund/credit resolution; returns and reverse-logistics servicing; loyalty, rewards and membership servicing; complaint, feedback and social/review response; and multi-channel delivery (mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social) with consistent resolution regardless of entry channel.
Supplier and partner service experience: onboarding, compliance and account management; forecast, purchase-order and inventory collaboration; quality issues, disputes and score-carding; invoice, payment and reconciliation servicing; and supplier/partner portals, EDI exchanges and account-management workflows.
Store and workforce service experience: inventory accuracy, price integrity and promotion execution at store level; pick, pack and in-store fulfilment; store-to-contact-centre escalation and case hand-off; associate empowerment tools (store apps, picker/associate devices, knowledge assistants); and workforce scheduling, service standards and frontline performance management.
Fulfilment and ecosystem service experience: delivery orchestration, routing and ETA/live tracking; failed-delivery, missed-slot and delivery-recovery workflows; reverse logistics and returns-to-warehouse operations; driver, dispatcher and 3PL partner management; and last-mile SLAs, on-time performance and partner score-carding.
Working knowledge of core retail service processes order-to-delivery, returns refunds, complaint case management, store-to-contact-centre escalation, substitution/refund workflows and supplier dispute resolution with the SLAs and benchmarks that define operational excellence, and fluency in how cases move end-to-end (detect, triage/categorise, route/assign, investigate/enrich, decide/approve, orchestrate, execute/communicate, confirm/close).
Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root-cause analytics).
Experience designing target operating models that combine human and AI/agentic capacity reusable service capability design, hybrid workforce design, and governance/guardrail frameworks (policy business rules, approvals escalation, human-in-the-loop controls, SLAs entitlements, privacy consent, security access, compliance audit, model/agent performance governance, ethics bias controls, and data quality traceability).
Demonstrated track record of driving measurable outcomes customer value (NPS/CSAT, trust, advocacy); growth (repeat purchase rate, average order value, attach rate, customer lifetime value); service quality productivity (first-contact and overall resolution, reduced cost-to-serve and contact volume, higher associate productivity); and availability resilience (in-stock rate, on-time delivery/payment, margin protection, and supply/compliance resilience).
Executive stakeholder management, communication and storytelling; ability to build and defend a business case at board level; fluency across business, experience, operations, technology and AI/data teams; and comfort translating complex operating models into a clear enterprise narrative.
Additional information
Experience in retail, customer service or enterprise service transformation, including large-scale programmes delivered end-to-end from strategy through implementation; the ideal candidate blends industry and consulting experience.
Reports to the Customer Service Managing Director; builds and leads a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts, with accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M.
Employment type: Permanent. Work arrangement: remote / hybrid / onsite, flexed to client and project needs; travel expectation varies by client engagement.
MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred. Relevant certifications a plus CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking, or platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).



Qualification
Experience in Retail industry (physical + digital) - Grocery, Apparel or large omnichannel retail sector experience
Good to have skills: relevant certifications (CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking) and platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).
Educational Qualification: MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred; MBA or equivalent degree in Business, Strategy, Sales Marketing.

Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to drive large-scale complex AI led Technology Transformation programmes for our most strategic clients across the globe. Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernisation, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programmes? Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping CIOs, CTOs and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernising delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.
We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organisations through complex transformation journeys - from translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:
Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership:Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to enterprise priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. Position Title-Delivery Lead- Salesforce Business Partner
Department-Sales operations
Location-Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Colombo
Position reports to-Associate Director - Sales Operations / Global Sales Operations
Job Summary
To provide hands-on ownership of Acuity's enterprise Salesforce ecosystem across user support, platform administration, data management, integration, enhancements and user enablement. The role will translate business needs into secure, scalable CRM solutions; strengthen data quality; support responsible AI adoption; and turn Salesforce data into actionable commercial insight.
Another important angle will be to improve forecasting accuracy by developing repeatable, data-led approaches that use opening pipeline position, conversion, win rates, sales cycle dynamics and deal level signals to better anticipate quarterly and year-end sales outcomes.
Responsibilities
Business-facing support and ownership: Act as the primary contact for Salesforce incidents, service requests, enhancements and user queries; manage intake, prioritization, communication, resolution and escalation; provide training, release updates and clear documentation.
Salesforce administration: Manage users, licenses, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing settings and access reviews; configure Flows, approvals, validation and assignment rules, record types, page layouts, Dynamic Forms and Lightning pages; maintain reports, dashboards, queues and notifications.
Platform development and continuous improvement: Apply configuration-first thinking while using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and APIs where appropriate; troubleshoot defects, address root causes, reduce technical debt and coordinate environments, deployments and post-release validation.
Integrations and data management: Support Salesforce integrations with ERP, billing, CPQ, e-signature, marketing and other enterprise platforms; oversee APIs, authentication, middleware, monitoring and error handling; lead migration, cleansing, deduplication, reconciliation, backup and validation activities.
AI, analytics and forecasting: Build operational and executive dashboards covering pipeline, conversion, sales, forecasting, revenue, customers, adoption and service performance; establish repeatable predictive methods to forecast quarterly and year-end landing positions using opening pipeline, stage conversion, win rates, sales-cycle velocity, slippage and deal-level risk; identify and deliver high-value use cases using Agent force, Einstein and related capabilities.
Governance, risk and documentation: Maintain effective release, change, backup, testing and deployment controls; support audits and ITGC requirements; maintain solution designs, SOPs, configuration inventories, deployment records and user guidance; coordinate vendors while retaining clear internal accountability.
Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Billing, Delivery, IT and external partners to support connected Lead-to-Order and Order-to-Cash processes, including merger and acquisition initiatives.
Key Competencies
Customer and support orientation: Approachable and accountable front line for Salesforce users.
Technical depth: Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, APIs, testing and deployment, balancing configuration-first thinking with development and integration capability.
Commercial forecasting and analytical judgement: Converts CRM data into reliable forecasts, early-warning indicators and practical actions for Sales Leadership; challenges assumptions and explains variance clearly.
AI and automation mindset: Identifies AI and automation opportunities that simplify day to day business processes
Ownership and delivery: Takes responsibility from problem definition through design, delivery, validation, adoption and support.
Communication and stakeholder management: Make complex principles easy to understand and explain technical and analytical topics clearly to users, technical teams and senior leadership.
Continuous improvement: Identifies opportunities for automation, simplification, innovation and improved user experience.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer science preferred but Information Systems, Engineering, Analytics or a related discipline considered too, Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification required, with Sales Cloud Consultant, Platform Developer, Omni studio, CPQ, platform data architect or Agent force certification advantageous.

Description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring resolution in large-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi-vendor infrastructures.
What you will be doing:
Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
Monitor and support the network health of on-premises and cloud infrastructures.
Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.
What we need to see:
Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem-solving abilities.
Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
Hands-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:
Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

Description:
About The Role

Job Title Industry SME Banking / Senior Manager S&C GN SONG

Management Level:06 Senior Manager

Location:Bangalore/ Gurgaon/ Chennai/ Pune/ Hyderabad/ Mumbai

Must have skills:Customer Service Strategy and Transformation, Technology, and Innovation

Good to have skills: Industry Trends and Disruptions, Digital Literacy, Value architect, Product Owner, Business Analyst, Digital transformation, Business case creations for Contact center transformation.

Experience: 10+ Years preferably in a Bank

Educational Qualification:Post Graduation in Business Management

Job

Summary:

We are seeking an initiative-taking and experienced Senior Manager to lead our Customer Service team, with a strong focus on leveraging technology, driving innovation, creating business value, reducing operational expenses, and maximizing customer satisfaction (CSAT). This role is critical in shaping the future of our customer service and ensuring we remain at the forefront of the banking industry.

If this role resonates with you, we invite you to discover many exciting global opportunities available within Accenture Strategy & Consultings Customer, Sales & Service practice.


Roles & Responsibilities:




Retail and Commercial Banking Expertise: Serve as a recognized subject matter expert (SME) on retail and commercial banking processes, products, and services. Maintain a deep understanding of core banking systems, lending, deposit, payment, and other banking functions.


Customer Service Strategy & Vision:Develop and execute a customer service strategy that aligns with the bank''s overall business objectives, focusing on technology integration, innovation, and delivering exceptional customer experience.


Customer Service KPI Mastery: Possess a strong understanding of key customer service performance indicators (KPIs) in the banking sector, including customer satisfaction (CSAT), Net Promoter Score (NPS), first call resolution (FCR), average handle time (AHT), cost per contact, Employee Satisfaction etc. Be able to analyze and interpret these KPIs to identify areas for improvement.


Competitive Analysis: Conduct competitive analysis to identify best practices and emerging trends in the banking industry. Benchmark the bank''s performance against competitors and identify opportunities to differentiate.


Technology & Innovation Leadership:Identify, evaluate, and implement innovative technologies and digital solutions to enhance customer service, such as AI-powered chatbots, personalized banking platforms, mobile-first solutions, and advanced analytics. Drive the adoption of these technologies within the customer service team.


Business Value Creation:Demonstrate a clear link between customer service initiatives and tangible business outcomes, such as increased customer acquisition, retention, cross-selling, and revenue generation. Develop metrics to track and report on the business value created.


Digital Transformation Leadership: Drive the digital transformation of customer service, including the implementation of self-service portals, mobile apps, CRM systems, and other relevant technologies. Focus on creating seamless omnichannel experiences. Experience in integrating these technologies into a Banking firm''s ecosystem is essential.


Cross-Functional Collaboration:Collaborate effectively with other departments, such as product development, marketing, and IT, to ensure alignment and seamless integration of customer service initiatives.


Client Engagement: Consult with clients on their customer service strategies and provide expert guidance on transformation initiatives, with a focus on technology and AI adoption. This may involve leveraging knowledge of specific insurance regulations and compliance requirements.


Pre-sales activities:Lead and contribute to pre-sales activities including response to RFPs, creating proofs of concept, creating effective presentations, demonstrating solutions during client orals, effort and cost estimation process, Business Case development etc.


Thought Leadership:Lead practice-specific initiatives including creating points of view, creating reusable assets on contact center space, performing analysis on industry research and market trends and bringing in innovative solutions etc.


Continuous Learning:Ability to take new challenges and to be an enthusiastic learner.


Qualification

Professional & Technical Skills:

MBA from a tier 1 or tier 2 institute.
10+ years of digital experience and solid knowledge of industry tools and understanding of designing intuitive and responsive user experiences.
Experience in working for a Banking company in Service Transformation role / Solid experience developing interactive models using conversational platforms and deep understanding of customer-centered design processes with consulting experience (optional).
Experience of working with business stakeholders across multiple geographic areas, with different priorities and requirements.
Ability to work in high-paced and complex projects and understand industry-specific customer service processes, operations and functional needs.
Thorough skills to manage stakeholder expectations and be engaging in resolving issues and risks for the success of the project.
Bachelors degree in related field or equivalent experience and Post-Graduation in Business management would be an added value.
Experience leading the design and implementation of contact center applications, from concept to deployment, is highly desirable.



Additional Information:
An opportunity to work on

transformative projects with key G2000 clients

Potential to

Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed

responsible business into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your

strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a

culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Description:
Real Estate Sales Executive ICSA LivX

About ICSA LivX:
ICSA LivX is a residential real estate and rental housing company based in Whitefield, Bangalore. We focus on providing quality rental homes and a seamless experience for tenants through well-managed properties and customer-focused services.

Role Overview:
We are looking for a proactive, confident, and target-oriented Real Estate Sales Executive to drive tenant acquisition and occupancy across our residential properties. The role involves handling customer enquiries, telesales, field sales, property visits, lead follow-ups, deal closures, and broker relationship management.

This is a sales-focused, on-site role suited to freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience who are eager to build a career in real estate sales.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Lead Management & Telesales
Handle inbound and outbound leads received through calls, WhatsApp, property portals, referrals, and other channels.
Contact prospective tenants, understand their requirements, and recommend suitable rental properties.
Conduct timely follow-ups to convert enquiries into confirmed bookings.
Maintain accurate lead records and update the CRM or Google Sheets regularly.
Ensure no potential customer is missed during the sales process.

2. Field Sales & Property Visits
Conduct property visits and site tours for prospective tenants.
Explain rental pricing, deposits, amenities, availability, and rental terms.
Build customer confidence and address questions or objections.
Negotiate within approved pricing guidelines and close rental deals.
Generate new leads through local outreach and networking in and around Whitefield.

3. Broker & Channel Partner Management
Build and maintain relationships with local property brokers and referral partners.
Manage broker WhatsApp groups and other lead-generation channels.
Share updated property availability, rental prices, and offers with brokers.
Coordinate site visits and follow up on broker-generated enquiries.
Track broker leads, conversions, pending follow-ups, and performance.
Coordinate broker commissions with management as per approved policies.

4. Sales Conversion & Occupancy
Work towards assigned sales and tenant acquisition targets.
Follow up with interested prospects until closure.
Coordinate with the relevant team to complete booking formalities after a deal is closed.
Support pre-sales and lead-generation activities for upcoming residential properties.
Maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective tenants to support occupancy growth.

5. Reporting & Coordination
Maintain daily records of calls, enquiries, site visits, follow-ups, and closures.
Submit regular sales updates to management.
Track lead sources and identify effective sales channels.
Ensure customer and broker information is recorded accurately.

Preferred Candidate Profile:
Freshers and candidates with 02 years of experience are welcome.
Candidates with experience in real estate sales, field sales, telesales, lead generation, or customer-facing roles will have an advantage.
Strong communication, negotiation, and customer-handling skills.
Comfortable making calls, conducting property visits, and meeting prospective customers.
Willingness to travel locally for field sales activities.
Basic knowledge of WhatsApp, Google Sheets, or MS Excel.
Self-motivated, target-oriented, and consistent with follow-ups.
A two-wheeler and valid driving licence are preferred.

Compensation & Benefits:
Salary: 2.5 - 3.0 LPA, depending on experience and suitability.
Performance-based sales incentives.
Opportunity to develop sales and real estate expertise in a growing business.

Job Details
Designation: Real Estate Sales Executive
Company: ICSA LivX
Location: Whitefield, Bangalore
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Experience: 0 - 2 years
Work Mode: On-site with field sales activities

If you are confident in communicating with customers, enjoy sales, and want to grow in the real estate industry, we encourage you to apply.
AboutCompany: ICSA LivX is a rapidly growing property management startup dedicated to transforming the rental housing experience. We manage residential properties, drive occupancy through strong sales, and deliver exceptional tenant experiences through efficient on-ground operations. Join us to be part of a dynamic team where you'll have the opportunity to learn, take ownership, and grow alongside the company.

Description:
Join a team shaping the future of digital payments and drive your professional growth. Become a pivotal leader at the forefront of revolutionizing payment operations, where your expertise will help drive efficiency across our financial systems.

As a Payment Lifecycle Associate II within Payments Operations, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our payment operations framework by streamlining processes, implementing new technologies, and developing operational functions. You will manage payment processing across various products, ensuring smooth fund transfers and reconciling purchase and sales options, futures, or securities, while leveraging your proficiency in automation, cybersecurity, and anti-fraud awareness to ensure security and efficiency. Your ability to manage stakeholders, influence decisions, and handle conflicts will drive mutually beneficial outcomes, and your strategic planning skills will guide our direction and resource allocation decisions. Additionally, your proficiency in AI/ML will be utilized to solve complex problems and enhance processes, applying your knowledge in market product and process improvement to optimize our operations.

Job responsibilities
Manage and deliver programs or projects of moderate to advanced complexity related to the payments lifecycle, while leading or contributing to client experience, transformation initiatives, and process optimization.
Define project requirements, impact, outcome criteria, and metrics using process models and diagrams, providing subject matter expertise on key initiatives, new system developments, and automation opportunities.
Conduct research and data analysis to resolve non-routine payment lifecycle issues, including cash, trade, merchant, or commercial card transactions, and client investigations.
Monitor and enhance the control environment for technical, financial, and operations processes, participating in the detection and prevention of fraudulent transactions to mitigate risks.
Build effective relationships with stakeholders, cross-functional and cross-locational teams, and clients to drive mutually beneficial outcomes and ensure smooth operations.
Coach, train, mentor, and develop junior talent to equip the team for future success.
Required Qualifications, Skills and Capabilities:
Demonstrated ability in operations leadership or management within payments, with at least three years of experience, showcasing advanced knowledge of global payment processing operations, products, and systems architecture to support operational efficiency and change management.
Self-reliant and proactive in problem-solving, with the ability to independently conduct root cause analysis and execute analytics projects, creatively finding solutions.
Ability to navigate effectively in dynamic environments with evolving priorities and shifting workloads across complex products, applying a commercial and growth mindset to adapt to new business initiatives.
Proficient in data analysis techniques, capable of interpreting and communicating insights to inform decision-making with senior stakeholders, while leveraging strong interpersonal skills for collaboration.
Understand cybersecurity controls and anti-fraud strategies to protect information and systems, with familiarity in continuous improvement methodologies and design thinking techniques.
Demonstrated proficiency in using automation technologies to optimize payments processing, with a proven track record in enhancing customer experience throughout the customer journey.
Preferred Qualifications, Skills and Capabilities:
Knowledge of ISO or Swift message processing or management.
Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes

Description:
Site Supervisor Make My Bath (MMB)
Company: DesignCafe
Vertical: Make My Bath (MMB)
Department: Projects / Execution
Location: [Bangalore]

Job Summary
We are looking for a Site Supervisor to oversee and manage on-site execution of bathroom interior projects. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating with contractors, vendors, designers, and customers to ensure projects are completed on time, as per quality standards and company requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Supervise day-to-day site execution and ensure work is completed as per the approved design and specifications.
Coordinate with contractors, carpenters, plumbers, electricians, tilers, and other site teams.
Ensure proper execution of bathroom interiors, including civil, plumbing, electrical, tiling, sanitary fittings, and installation works.
Monitor project timelines, site progress, manpower, and material availability.
Conduct regular site inspections to ensure quality and workmanship standards are maintained.
Identify and resolve site-related issues and coordinate with the project/design team for timely solutions.
Ensure materials are received, stored, and utilized properly at the site.
Coordinate with customers and internal teams to provide regular updates on project progress.
Ensure adherence to safety standards and company processes at the site.
Prepare and maintain site reports, progress updates, measurements, and other required documentation.
Ensure project completion and handover within the committed timeline.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Diploma / ITI / Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Interior Design, Construction, or a related field.
2–5 years of experience in site supervision, interior execution, construction, or residential projects.
Experience in bathroom interiors, modular interiors, residential interiors, or turnkey projects will be preferred.
Good knowledge of civil, plumbing, electrical, tiling, waterproofing, and installation works.
Strong knowledge of site execution and quality control.
Good vendor and contractor management skills.
Ability to read and understand drawings and site layouts.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Ability to manage multiple sites/tasks and meet project timelines.

Kindly drop in your cv to radhika.an@designcafe.com

The Officer Operations will be responsible for managing the visa application process and managing operational aspects of Visa Application Centers (VACs), ensuring compliance and efficiency in all operations.

Job description
Visa Application Processing and Customer Interaction
Scrutinize and collect visa application documents for processing.
Attend to customer/applicant queries through various channels, including in-person, email, and telephone.
Inform applicants about available Value-Added Services and facilitate their delivery.
Encourage applicants to provide feedback on services and experiences at the application center.
Operations and Compliance
Handle cash and bank transactions accurately, adhering to established procedures.
Record and maintain all application data, ensuring accurate and timely entry into the system without errors.
Ensure timely completion of the visa application process within the specified Turn Around Time (TAT).
Maintain strict compliance with standard operating procedures and manuals to ensure process consistency.
Logistics and Project Support
Manage passport delivery logistics to consulates, applicants, and logistic companies.
Support the Deputy Manager/Operations Manager in executing World Bank projects.
Sustainability:
Promote judicious use of natural resources.
Adhere to the organisation's environment, health, and safety policies, objectives, and guidelines.
Anti Bribery Management Systems (ABMS)
Follow the ABMS roles and responsibilities details as prescribed on the ABMS manual.
a. Understanding of ethical standards and the importance of integrity in business practices.
Education
Graduate/postgraduate or global equivalent degree in the related field.
Experience
1 - 2 years of experience preferably in the Travel and Tourism or Service industry.

Verify accuracy of citations and bibliographic references (IJGO, APA, or other required formats)

Communication and stakeholder management
Project coordination and organizational skills
Attention to detail and accuracy
Clinical and pharmaceutical knowledge (B.Pharmacy background)

Collaboration and teamwork
Adaptability to dynamic project environments

Prior experience in educational counselling, admissions, or sales will be an advantage.

Opportunity to work in the creative education industry.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Performance-based incentives, as applicable.
Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume.
