Description:
Job Summary
The Employment Livelihood Supervisor will be responsible for supporting the implementation, supervision, and monitoring of employment, livelihood, skilling, entrepreneurship, and value-chain development initiatives across Nagaland.
The role will work closely with youth, entrepreneurs, producers, community groups, artisans, trainees, government departments, financial institutions, corporates, development partners, and other stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of programmes and achievement of project outcomes.
Responsibilities
Employment Livelihood Programme Implementation: Support the planning and implementation of Employment Livelihood programmes and projects.
Coordinate day-to-day field activities and ensure timely achievement of programme targets.
Supervise programme activities across assigned locations and ensure compliance with project plans and guidelines.
Identify implementation challenges and coordinate with the concerned team for timely resolution.
Livelihood Value-Chain Development: Support the implementation and strengthening of various livelihood value chains promotion.
Work with producers, entrepreneurs, community groups, and other stakeholders across different stages of the value chain, including production, processing, value addition, packaging, marketing, and market linkage.
Support initiatives related to Banana Fibre, Pineapple Fibre, and other livelihood enterprises.
Assist in identifying opportunities for improving productivity, product development, market access, and income generation.
Document challenges, learnings, innovations, and success stories from livelihood interventions.
Financial Institution-Supported Initiatives: Support the implementation and field-level coordination of programmes undertaken in collaboration with development and financial institutions.
Coordinate with beneficiaries, entrepreneurs, producer groups, community institutions, and project stakeholders.
Ensure that project activities and deliverables are implemented in accordance with approved plans and timelines.
Support beneficiary identification, mobilisation, training, enterprise development, monitoring, and reporting.
Maintain accurate project records and supporting documentation as required by partners and funding agencies.
Youth Mobilisation Employment Support: Mobilise youth for employment, skill development, entrepreneurship, and livelihood opportunities.
Conduct outreach activities in communities, educational institutions, training centres, and other relevant locations.
Support career guidance, job-readiness, and employment-related activities.
Facilitate linkages between youth and relevant employers, training institutions, and livelihood opportunities.
Track employment and livelihood outcomes of programme participants.
Enterprise Entrepreneur Support: Provide field-level support to aspiring and existing entrepreneurs.
Assist entrepreneurs in identifying opportunities, challenges, and potential market linkages.
Support enterprise development activities, including business planning, capacity building, product development, and market access.
Coordinate with relevant technical experts, financial institutions, and market partners where required.
Field Supervision Stakeholder Coordination: Conduct regular field visits to monitor programme activities and beneficiary progress.
Supervise field staff, mobilisers, trainers, and other project personnel, as assigned.
Build and maintain relationships with government departments, financial institutions, employers, educational institutions, community organisations, producer groups, and other stakeholders.
Represent in field-level meetings, workshops, consultations, exhibitions, and other programme events.
Monitoring, Documentation Reporting: Maintain accurate records of beneficiaries, enterprises, training activities, production, employment, placements, and livelihood outcomes.
Collect, verify, and maintain programme data and supporting documentation.
Prepare regular field visit reports, progress reports, case studies, success stories, and other project documentation.
Track project indicators, milestones, outputs, and outcomes against approved targets.
Support the preparation of reports and updates required by YouthNet s partners and funding agencies.
Market Linkages Promotion: Support market linkage initiatives for products developed through livelihood value chains.
Assist in identifying potential buyers, institutional markets, retailers, distributors, and other market opportunities.
Support exhibitions, fairs, product showcases, buyer-seller meets, and promotional activities.
Coordinate with relevant teams on branding, packaging, marketing, and product promotion.
Key Deliverables
Timely and effective implementation of assigned Employment Livelihood projects.
Achievement of beneficiary, training, employment, enterprise, and livelihood targets.
Effective field-level implementation of financial institution-supported initiatives.
Strengthened livelihood value chains.
Increased participation of youth and communities in sustainable livelihood and employment opportunities.
Improved market and institutional linkages for livelihood enterprises.
Accurate and timely programme data, documentation, and reporting.
Regular field monitoring and follow-up with beneficiaries and stakeholders.
Documentation of programme outcomes, success stories, and lessons learned.
Qualifications Requirements
Bachelor s degree in Development Studies, Social Work, Rural Development, Management, Economics, Sociology, Agriculture, Entrepreneurship, or a related field.
2-4 years of relevant experience in livelihood development, employment, entrepreneurship, skill development, value-chain development, community development, or programme implementation.
Experience working with development organisations, government programmes, financial institutions, NGOs, CSR programmes, or donor-funded projects will be an advantage.
Experience in livelihood value chains, enterprise development, market linkages, or community-based programmes will be preferred.
Familiarity with the socio-economic and livelihood context of Nagaland will be an advantage.
Key Skills Competencies
Employment and livelihood programme implementation
Value-chain and enterprise development
Field supervision and community mobilisation
Youth engagement and employment facilitation
Stakeholder and partner coordination
Market linkage and business development
Monitoring, data collection, and reporting
Team coordination and problem-solving
Strong written and verbal communication
MS Office/Google Workspace proficiency
Willingness to undertake frequent field travel across Nagaland
Personal Attributes
Strong ownership and accountability
Proactive and solution-oriented approach
Good interpersonal and community engagement skills
Ability to work with diverse stakeholders
Strong organisational and coordination skills
Adaptability to field-based working environments
Commitment to youth development, employment generation, and sustainable livelihoods
Employment type
Full Time
Notes
For Queries - Working Hours: Monday to Friday (10:00 am to 4:30 pm)

Description:
Position: Regional Head Northeast: Manipur, Nagaland and Assam (Programmes, Partnerships & Business)

About Dharmalife
Dharmalife (www.dharmalife.in) is a social impact organization advancing inclusive progress across India through two core pillars — People and Planet. Working in over 40,000 villages across 15 states, it has built a rural network of 20,000+ women entrepreneurs, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), who drive sustainable community development.

The organization works alongside women by enhancing their economic power, agency, and leadership, while addressing key social and environmental challenges. Through this network of DLEs, Dharmalife promotes sustainable livelihoods, behaviour change, and solutions across key domains — Health, Well-being, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, and Circular Economy.

By 2030, Dharmalife aims to advance 1 million rural women through sustainable livelihoods and care support. Its group entities — Dharmalife Foundation, Gajam India Pvt. Ltd., Dharmalife Labs, and Dharmalife Society — work together to create lasting systemic change at scale.

Position Summary
The Regional Head – Northeast-Manipur, Nagaland and Assam is the senior leadership position in the region responsible for driving Dharmalife’s growth, programme delivery, partnerships, and operational excellence across the region.

The role combines four critical dimensions:
Business and Sales Growth through the Dharmalife Entrepreneur (DLE) network
DLE Group Development and Entrepreneur Ecosystem Strengthening
High-Quality Execution of Donor and CSR-Funded Programmes
Strategic Government and Institutional Partnership Development

The Regional Head serves as the primary representative of Dharmalife within the Northeast region, along with central office functions, and is responsible for achieving commercial, social impact, operational, and stakeholder engagement objectives across all assigned districts

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Growth & Revenue Generation
Drive state-level sales and revenue targets across region, across Dharmalife products, services, and programme-linked business opportunities.
Strengthen entrepreneur productivity, customer outreach, and market penetration.
Develop district-wise growth plans and sales strategies.
Monitor sales conversion, order fulfilment, collections, inventory movement, and business performance.
Identify new business opportunities and market expansion areas.
Improve DLE earnings and income-generating opportunities.
Drive sustainable business growth through community-based distribution models.

2. DLE (Dharmalife Entrepreneur) Network Development & Community Engagement
Lead recruitment, onboarding, activation, and retention of DLEs and DLTs.
Build and strengthen village-level DLE groups and entrepreneur collectives.
Increase active participation and engagement of women entrepreneurs.
Develop leadership capabilities among high-potential DLEs.
Ensure regular field engagement, group meetings, and entrepreneur support.
Improve entrepreneur retention and productivity.

3. Programme & Project Execution
Lead implementation of donor-funded and CSR-supported programmes across the Northeast.
Ensure achievement of programme deliverables, timelines, budgets, and impact indicators.
Monitor beneficiary outreach, training completion, adoption metrics, and community engagement.
Ensure high-quality implementation across Health, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, Circular Economy, and future programmes.
Maintain programme documentation, field evidence, case studies, and reporting standards.
Support surveys, assessments, research activities, audits, and donor visits.
Ensure safeguarding, compliance, and quality standards are maintained.

4. Government & Strategic Partnerships
Develop strategic relationships with: State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLMs); Women & Child Development Department; Labour Department; Education Department; Tribal Development Department; Skill Development Missions; Renewable Energy Agencies; District Administration; and Panchayati Raj Institutions
Build partnerships with CSR foundations, corporate partners, financial institutions, NGOs, development organizations, Academic and research institutions
Identify opportunities for programme convergence, co-funding, and scale-up.
Represent Dharmalife at state-level/ region level forums, consultations, and stakeholder meetings.
Facilitate approvals, coordination, and institutional support for programme implementation.

5. Team Leadership, Governance & Operations
Lead and mentor Territory Channel Managers, Cluster Heads, Enterprise Leaders, and other teams.
Drive performance management, coaching, and capability development.
Conduct regular reviews and field visits.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and operating procedures.
Monitor budgets, resource utilization, and operational efficiency.
Ensure data quality, reporting discipline, and governance standards.

Candidate Profile

Education
Graduate or Postgraduate in: Rural Management; Business Administration; Social Work; Development Studies and Related disciplines

Experience Required
8–12 years of relevant experience.
Experience in rural markets, social enterprises, development sector, livelihood promotion, microfinance, channel management, CSR, or large-scale field operations.
Proven experience managing multi-district or state-level teams across the region.
Demonstrated success in both programme delivery and business development.
Experience working with government stakeholders and donor-funded programmes will be preferred.

Competencies Required

Leadership Competencies: Strategic Thinking; Execution Excellence; Team Leadership; Ownership & Accountability

Functional Competencies: Rural Market Development; Programme Management; Sales & Business Development; Stakeholder Engagement; Partnership Development; Community Mobilisation; Data-Driven Decision Making;

Behavioural Competencies: Integrity; Collaboration; Resilience; Learning Agility; Entrepreneurial Mindset; Relationship Building

Travel Requirement
This position requires extensive travel across the Northeast, including regular visits to the Head office (Delhi), villages, DLE groups, programme sites, government offices, partner organizations, and district headquarters. Field immersion and direct stakeholder engagement are critical success factors for this role.

Why Join Dharmalife
This role is a chance to lead one of India's largest women-led rural entrepreneurship and impact ecosystems and to directly contribute to livelihoods, sustainability, community development, and social transformation at scale.
AboutCompany: Dharmalife is a grassroot level social impact organization committed to fostering inclusive progress for both people and the planet. Its initiatives are driven by women change agents, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), and are supported by data-driven insights, innovative approaches, and technology. Operating through a network of over 20,000 rural women entrepreneurs across 40,000 villages in 15 states, Dharmalife has positively impacted more than 17.5 million individuals, including 500,000 children. We aim to enhance womens economic autonomy and leadership while promoting sustainable practices, thereby contributing to the creation of resilient communities. By 2030, Dharmalife aims to empower 1 million rural women through sustainable employment, livelihood growth, and care support.

JOB DESCRIPTION
1. Position Details
Designation: Junior Engineer
Techno Marketing
Reporting To: Zonal Engineer
Location: As per Requirement
Experience: 2-4 years (Cement / Building Materials Industry preferred)
Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Department: Techno Marketing

2. Role Purpose
The Junior Engineer Techno Marketing is responsible for providing technical support to sales, customers, and channel partners to drive product acceptance, brand credibility, and sustainable market growth in the region. The role focuses on site-level technical engagement, product promotion through demonstrations and trials, complaint resolution, and supporting the sales team with techno-commercial inputs.

3. Key Responsibilities
-Technical support to sales team for lead generation
- Conduct product demonstrations and site trials
- Site testing (Cube test, Slump, NDT, material tests)
- Technical guidance to masons, contractors, engineers
- Mix design and product suitability recommendations
- Customer complaint handling and resolution
- Technical documentation and MIS
- Support mason/contractor meets and seminars
- Coordinate with quality and production teams

4. Key Result Areas (KRA)
-Technical lead generation & sales support
- Site testing & service quality
- Product trials & acceptance
- Complaint resolution TAT
- Market technical engagement
- Reporting & compliance

5. Roadmap of Success (First 12 Months)
3 Months: Product and market understanding
6 Months: Independent site handling and demonstrations
9 Months: Trusted technical advisor status
12 Months: Consistent contribution to volume growth

6. Annual Success Plan (FY)
- Support regional sales targets
- Improve product acceptance and repeat usage
- Reduce technical complaints
- Strengthen brand credibility through technical excellence

7. Competency Framework
Functional Competencies:
- Knowledge of cement and construction practices
- Site testing and technical analysis
- Product application knowledge

Behavioural Competencies:
- Communication and interpersonal skills
- Problem-solving and decision-making
- Customer orientation
- Team collaboration
Decision-making and problem-solving ability
Effective communication and negotiation skills
High ownership and accountability

8. Company Profile
Set up and promoted by first generation entrepreneurs more than a decade ago, Amrit Cement Limited (ACL) today is one of the leading manufacturers of cement with a Pan-India presence and a particularly strong foothold in the North East Indian market.

Website: https://www.amritcement.com/about/company-profile/

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.

Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Description:
We are looking for a skilled Attendant Operator to join our team at Tagros Chemicals India Ltd., responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of our chemical plant. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in chemical plant operations and be able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Roles and Responsibility


Operate and maintain chemical plant equipment, including reactors, distillation columns, and centrifuges.

Monitor and control chemical processes to ensure product quality and safety.

Collaborate with other operators and maintenance personnel to troubleshoot issues and optimize performance.

Implement safety procedures and protocols to prevent accidents and injuries.

Conduct regular inspections of equipment and facilities to identify potential hazards or defects.

Develop and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs.


Job Requirements


Diploma or degree in Chemical Engineering or related field.

Minimum 2 years of experience as an operator in a chemical plant setting.

Strong knowledge of chemical plant operations, including safety procedures and protocols.

Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly with colleagues.

Familiarity with chemical plant software and instrumentation is desirable.

Must pass a pre-employment physical and drug-alcohol screening.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To ensure efficient operation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and breakdown maintenance of mechanical equipment in the cement plant, with specific responsibility for crushers and associated material-handling equipment to minimize downtime and ensure smooth plant operations.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. Crusher Operation and Maintenance
Perform preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of crushers, including jaw crushers, hammer crushers, impact crushers, and other crushing equipment, as applicable to the plant.
Monitor crusher performance, vibration, temperature, noise, lubrication, and equipment condition to identify potential faults.
Inspect and maintain crusher components, including hammers, blow bars, liners, jaw plates, bearings, shafts, rotors, and drive assemblies.
Identify and troubleshoot mechanical issues related to crushing equipment and ensure timely rectification of breakdowns.
Monitor wear parts and coordinate their replacement to maintain crushing efficiency and equipment availability.
Assist in maintenance and troubleshooting of crusher feed systems, belt conveyors, vibrating screens, feeders, and associated material-handling systems.
Ensure proper alignment, clearance, lubrication, and assembly of crusher components after maintenance activities.
B. Mechanical Maintenance
Execute scheduled preventive maintenance and equipment inspections as per the maintenance plan.
Maintain and troubleshoot mechanical equipment such as conveyors, gearboxes, motors, pumps, fans, bearings, couplings, and hydraulic systems.
Assist in equipment erection, installation, alignment, dismantling, and commissioning activities.
Identify recurring mechanical failures and support root cause analysis to prevent repeated breakdowns.
Ensure the availability of critical spares and maintain records of maintenance activities, breakdowns, and equipment history.
C. Safety and Compliance
Follow plant safety procedures, Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and applicable PPE requirements.
Ensure safe execution of maintenance activities, particularly during crusher inspection, cleaning, and repair.
Identify unsafe conditions and report equipment abnormalities, hazards, and near misses.
Maintain good housekeeping and ensure compliance with plant safety standards.
D. Coordination and Reporting
Coordinate with production, electrical, instrumentation, and other maintenance teams for planned maintenance and breakdown resolution.
Maintain daily maintenance reports, inspection checklists, and breakdown records.
Support efforts to improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and optimize maintenance costs.
2.. Educational Qualification
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
Relevant technical qualifications in mechanical maintenance may be considered based on experience and company requirements.
3. Required Technical Skills
Practical knowledge of crusher maintenance, wear parts, bearings, shafts, lubrication, and drive mechanisms.
Understanding of preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and basic troubleshooting techniques.
Knowledge of conveyors, feeders, gearboxes, couplings, and material-handling equipment.
Ability to read mechanical drawings, equipment manuals, and maintenance checklists.
Basic knowledge of maintenance planning, spare parts management, and root cause analysis.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and maintenance reporting systems.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with hands-on experience in crusher maintenance within a cement manufacturing plant, particularly limestone/raw material crushing, are preferred. The candidate should possess sound mechanical troubleshooting skills and the ability to support preventive and breakdown maintenance activities independently under the guidance of the senior maintenance team.

Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

Description:
1. Background of The Hans Foundation
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust working towards creating an equitable society and enhancing the quality of life of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. THF works to improve the health and wellbeing of remote and underserved populations, with additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women, alongside education and livelihood development.
2. Project Overview: Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre project aims to strengthen access to essential healthcare for rural and hard-to-reach communities in Meghalaya. In its first phase, THF has committed to supporting 50 Sub-Centres through gap assessment, provision of equipment and facilities, deployment of skilled human resources, training, regular operations and monitoring. The project seeks to improve grassroots health services and contribute to better health outcomes, including maternal health.
3. General Information Position MIS Associate Project Hans Health & Wellness Centre (HWC), Meghalaya Location To be specified based on project requirement (e.g., assigned HSC / Project Office) No. of Positions 1 (or as per approved project requirement) Employment Type Contractual for one year; renewable based on performance and project requirements Reporting To Project Manager 4. Key Duties and Responsibilities A. Data Collection, Entry and Management
Collect, compile and enter data received from HSCs in approved registers, Excel sheets, MIS platforms and reporting formats.
Provide data-entry and documentation support to HSC staff, Project Manager and MEL Manager, as required.
Maintain an updated and organised database of HSC-wise service delivery, beneficiary and programme information, as applicable to approved project indicators.
Ensure that records are complete, legible, accurate and updated within prescribed timelines.
B. Data Quality and Verification
Review submitted data for completeness, consistency, duplication, missing entries and obvious errors; seek clarification or corrections from the concerned HSC staff.
Cross-check digital data with source registers and records wherever required.
Maintain proper documentation and an audit trail for corrections and updates; do not alter clinical records without authorisation.
Flag data gaps, discrepancies and delayed submissions to the Project Coordinator for timely resolution.
C. Reporting and MIS
Prepare and submit regular HSC-wise and consolidated project progress reports as per the reporting calendar and formats approved by THF.
Compile monthly and periodic data on service delivery and project indicators, as applicable and approved by the project team.
Support preparation of summary tables, charts, dashboards and presentations for internal reviews and management meetings.
Share verified data with the Project Coordinator and authorised stakeholders within stipulated timelines.
D. Record and Document Management
Maintain and organise registers, reporting files, attendance records and other programme documentation assigned to the role.
Ensure systematic filing, version control, safe storage and timely retrieval of records, in both digital and physical formats.
Support documentation of data-related observations, follow-up actions and reporting submissions.
E. Coordination and Field Support
Coordinate with MLHPs, GNM/ANMs and other HSC personnel to obtain timely and accurate data and clarify reporting requirements.
Follow up on pending reports and support staff in understanding prescribed data formats and reporting timelines.
Participate in project review meetings, trainings and data-verification visits as assigned.
Undertake other MIS, data management and administrative responsibilities relevant to the HWC project, as assigned by the reporting officer.
F. Confidentiality and Compliance
Maintain confidentiality and protect personal and health-related information of beneficiaries in accordance with THF policies and applicable requirements.
Share data only with authorised personnel and use approved systems and formats for storage and transmission.
Adhere to THF policies, professional conduct standards and instructions issued by the project management team.
5. Educational Qualifications
Graduate in any discipline from a recognised institution.
Diploma or certificate in Computer Applications / IT is preferred.
6. Experience and Technical Skills
Preferably 2-3 years of experience in MIS, data entry, reporting, programme support or a related role. Fresh graduates with strong computer skills may also be considered.
Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, email and data-entry systems; ability to maintain structured spreadsheets and prepare basic summaries is essential.
Experience in health programmes, public health reporting or work with healthcare facilities would be an advantage.
Ability to check data for accuracy, maintain organised records and meet recurring reporting deadlines.
7. Behavioural and Other Requirements
Good communication, coordination and follow-up skills.
Attention to detail, integrity, reliability and respect for confidentiality.
Ability to work with frontline health staff and manage multiple reporting tasks within deadlines.
Proficiency in English and Hindi; knowledge of the local language/dialect is desirable.
Willingness to travel to assigned HSCs or project locations, as required.
8. Equal Opportunity Statement
The Hans Foundation is an equal opportunity employer and encourages women, persons with disabilities and individuals from economically and socially excluded communities who meet the requisite skills and qualifications to apply. THF does not discriminate on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or any other such matter.

Field Associate - West Garo Hills (Garo Language)
Location: West Garo Hills, Meghalaya (Onsite)
Experience Level: 1-3 years (Relevant fellowships in enterprise/livelihoods considered)
Salary Band: 5-6 LPA
Job Summary
Ground Zero is looking for an independent, field-driven Field Associate based in West Garo Hills to strengthen women-owned Producer Groups (PGs) through our Women s Enterprise Support System (WESS). Working directly with community members and state livelihood frameworks, this role provides handholding support in day-to-day business operations, member engagement, governance, procurement, and market linkages across rural enterprises (agri-business, spices, etc.).
Responsibilities
Community Mobilization & Member Engagement: Mobilize and engage women producer group members (~20 members per group) for collective business actions, including produce procurement, aggregation, and marketing.
Business Operations & Planning: Help set up ground-level business operations for agri-business and value chains. Coordinate with input suppliers, buyers, transporters, and local service providers.
Governance & Financial Records: Assist PG leaders in maintaining accurate books of accounts, meeting resolutions, governance registers, and financial discipline.
Capacity Building & Training: Facilitate block and district-level training sessions for producer groups and community cadres.
Strategic Linkages & Coordination: Build institutional linkages with local government departments, market actors, and financial institutions under the guidance of the senior team.
Reporting & Field Surveys: Conduct ground-level surveys, market studies, and maintain routine field reports on operational progress, issues, and financials.
Qualifications & Candidate Profile
Education: Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Rural Management, Development Studies, or a related field (Master s/MBA preferred).
Experience: 1-3 years of experience in rural development, SHGs/PGs, collective enterprises, or livelihood promotion. Candidates with recognized fellowships in rural enterprise development will also be considered.
Language Mandatory: Excellent written and spoken command of Garo is mandatory. Basic ability to communicate in English and Hindi is preferred.
Key Competencies: Strong community mobilization skills, basic computer literacy (MS Word, Excel), and willingness to conduct rigorous field travel.
Logistics: Having a personal two-wheeler/bike is highly advantageous for field mobility. Candidates must be open to occasional travel to Shillong and Guwahati for official meetings.
Diversity: Female candidates are preferred, though qualified male candidates are also encouraged to apply.
Hiring Process
Round 1: HR & Program Team Interview
Round 2: Practical Assignment
Round 3: Final Interview based on Assignment (with Program Lead)
Hiring Note: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal , Virohan is an education-to-industry partner building the workforce powering India s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry-aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real-world employability.

Our model combines academic learning with hands-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles. Identify, onboard, and manage channel partners to expand offline sales reach and drive business growth.

Plan canopy activities strategically for better outreach.
Plan and execute marketing activities, generating sales leads.

Comfortable with field sales; committed to daily market presence.

Strong communication skills, particularly in regional languages.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.

Meghalaya MSc./B.Tech/B.Sc. 7+ years

Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced Quality Assurance Specialist with strong food testing and regulatory expertise to lead quality assurance activities at our Meghalaya facility. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in an NABL-accredited food testing laboratory and in-depth knowledge of FSSAI regulations, and can ensure analytical accuracy, compliance and audit readiness.


Key Responsibilities
Implement, maintain and continually improve the Quality Management System (QMS) in line with ISO/IEC 17025 and NABL requirements.
Ensure compliance with FSSAI Act, Rules and Regulations, including food safety standards, labelling, contaminants and residue limits.
Prepare, review and control SOPs, quality manuals, work instructions, formats and records.

Monitor internal quality control (IQC) activities and review test data, reports and certificates of analysis for accuracy and compliance.

Role & responsibilities

Job Purpose
To lead and manage all store operations within the cement plant, ensuring efficient receipt, storage, preservation, inventory control, and issuance of materials, spare parts, consumables, and capital items. The role is responsible for maintaining inventory accuracy, optimizing stock levels, supporting uninterrupted plant operations, and ensuring compliance with company policies, safety standards, and audit requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Store Operations Management
Oversee day-to-day store activities including receipt, inspection, storage, preservation, and issue of materials.
Ensure systematic storage and identification of all inventory items.
Implement best practices in warehouse and store management.
Maintain proper housekeeping and safety standards within store premises.
2. Inventory Management
Monitor inventory levels and ensure availability of critical spares and consumables.
Optimize stock holdings to balance operational requirements and inventory carrying costs.
Conduct regular stock verification, cycle counting, and annual physical inventory.
Analyze slow-moving, non-moving, obsolete, and surplus inventory and recommend corrective actions.
3. Material Receipt & Dispatch
Ensure timely receipt and documentation of incoming materials.
Coordinate with procurement, quality, and user departments for material inspection and acceptance.
Manage material issuance as per approved procedures and authorization matrix.
Monitor transportation and dispatch activities where applicable.
4. ERP & Documentation Control
Ensure accurate and timely transactions in ERP systems (SAP/Oracle/other ERP platforms).
Maintain inventory records, stock registers, material movement records, and statutory documents.
Generate periodic MIS reports related to inventory, stock valuation, consumption trends, and KPI performance.
5. Coordination & Stakeholder Management
Liaise with procurement, maintenance, production, finance, and project teams for material planning and availability.
Support plant shutdowns, overhauls, and project activities through effective material management.
Coordinate with vendors and logistics partners regarding deliveries and material discrepancies.
6. Compliance, Audit & Governance
Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and statutory requirements.
Facilitate internal, external, and statutory audits.
Implement inventory control procedures to prevent losses, pilferage, and material deterioration.
Ensure adherence to ISO, safety, environmental, and quality management systems.
7. Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop store personnel.
Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence within the stores function.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To carry out chemical analysis and quality control activities for raw materials, intermediate products, clinker and cement to ensure compliance with defined quality standards and specifications. The role will be responsible for XRF analysis, laboratory testing, monitoring chemical parameters and supporting consistent product quality throughout the manufacturing process.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Chemical Analysis & Quality Control
Conduct chemical analysis of limestone, additives, raw mix, kiln feed, clinker, gypsum, fly ash, slag and cement.
Perform routine and non-routine chemical testing as per established laboratory procedures.
Monitor key chemical parameters such as:
CaO, SiO, AlO and FeO
MgO, SO, KO, NaO and other relevant parameters
LOI and other quality indicators
Ensure test results are accurate, reliable and recorded properly.
B. XRF Operations
Operate and perform routine analysis using X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) equipment.
Prepare samples and pellets/beads as required for XRF analysis.
Perform calibration, standardization and routine checks of the XRF equipment.
Monitor instrument performance and identify abnormal readings or deviations.
Maintain XRF-related records, standards and calibration data.
Coordinate with the concerned team for troubleshooting and maintenance of XRF equipment.
C. Cement & Clinker Quality Monitoring
Monitor the chemical quality of clinker and cement at different stages of production.
Analyze and report quality deviations promptly to the concerned departments.
Support production teams in maintaining required chemical parameters.
Ensure final cement quality meets applicable BIS/IS specifications and internal quality standards.
Assist in maintaining consistency in cement quality.
D. Raw Material & Process Control
Analyze incoming raw materials and monitor their chemical characteristics.
Monitor raw mix and kiln feed quality.
Evaluate chemical variations and communicate deviations to the concerned team.
Support optimization of raw mix and process parameters based on laboratory results.
E. Laboratory Management
Ensure proper functioning, cleanliness and housekeeping of the chemical laboratory.
Maintain laboratory equipment, instruments, chemicals, reagents and standards.
Maintain proper records of test results, calibration, analysis and equipment maintenance.
Ensure safe handling, storage and disposal of laboratory chemicals.
Follow laboratory safety procedures and applicable environmental and safety requirements.
F. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain daily laboratory test reports and quality records.
Prepare and communicate test results to the concerned HOD/Manager.

Job Summary
Programme Lead - Community Libraries
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya, India
Contract: Fixed term consulting contract
Based on previous CTC and experience
Project Background
Sauramandala Foundation is an NGO founded in 2018 with a vision to bring about systemic change in the lives of remote communities through empathetic, collaborative, and contextual solutions that are co-created with the communities themselves.
About the Project (CM Youth Center):
The Government of Meghalaya, in partnership with Sauramandala Foundation, has established 22 rural community centres for youth, called the Chief Ministers Youth Centers (CMYC) with an aim to build resilience, agency and problem-solving skills in the community. The key programmes in the CMYCs are - Self Designed Learning, Entrepreneurship Development, Sports Coaching, Arts and Theatre and a Community Library Programme. The learning is open to all ages to have more involvement from the community. The CMYCs are set to expand from 22 centers to cover all 55 blocks of Meghalaya over a 2 year period.
Objective of the Engagement
To design and operationalize well-resourced, welcoming libraries in CMYCs that:
Build a culture of reading by working closely with children, young adults and youth in the community.
Serve as learning hubs supporting adolescent well-being and development.
Scope of Work
Curation
Build vibrant, culturally rooted, multilingual collections for children, young adults and youth.
Curate collections across themes of well-being, mental health, coming of age, gender, environment, sci-fi, indigenous knowledge and local culture and so on.
Ensure enough reading materials for beginner to confident and advanced readers.
Programme Design
Support the design of libraries and child and youth-friendly spaces.
Design a joyful community library programme that makes reading social, engaging and meaningful.
Create spaces for dialogue and self expression - reading circles, book discussions, open mics, writing labs, movie screenings and debrief reflections.
Integrate life skills and SEL into the library programme to build empathy, self-confidence, critical thinking etc.
Design for the library activities to travel to nearby villages around the Youth Center and to engage with existing Youth Clubs.
Building Community Ownership
Position the CMYC and the libraries as a community asset by engaging the community especially the adults to build a connection with the space.
Organise reading festivals, youth showcases, and community celebrations.
Create systems to encourage youth to play an active role in shaping the libraries - youth volunteers, library leaders and so on.
Strengthening libraries as safe, welcoming, learning hubs
Develop a simple monitoring framework for smooth operations.
Train first-time libraries with tools and techniques on youth engagement, creating safe spaces, facilitating shared reading experiences in the libraries.
Bring in low-cost digital tools and offline e-resources where possible.
Document learnings and adolescent and youth stories from the libraries.
Expected area of expertise
Master's Degree in Education/Library & Information Science or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
8-9 years of experience in setting up community libraries, training librarians and educators to build a culture of reading.
Any certifications on library science or engagements with organisations working in the field is preferred.
Strong knowledge of curation for different age groups from children to young adults and youth.
Ability to design and facilitate training workshops for first-time librarians.
Adaptability to an agile, cross-functional, collaborative working environment.

Job Description

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals and youth on rural development, agriculture, skilling and economic inclusion, along with 15+ central and state government partners.

Our economic inclusion journey for 25 million Indians, has reached 10 states with $250M of government funding to cover 1.25M people. Our incubator, accelerator and grand challenges have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs including 17 Forbes 30U30, 3 EarthShot Prize winners, 1 Time Magazine cover and more.

Set up with support from 90+ eminent philanthropists , 40+ corporates and 15+ foundations including Gates, Mackenzie Scott, Vinod Khosla, Nandan Nilekani, Tata Trusts, Skoll, Meta, LinkedIn, HDFC, Mphasis, KPMG and LOreal, we are contributing towards a "poverty-free India, within our lifetime".

What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals a contributing member to the economy:

Enable govt to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iterate the design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale with quality.

What will you do
The/Nudge is working with various state SRLMs to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting vulnerable rural women through community institutions.
To understand and practice the Spirits of The/Nudge Institute and the respective SRLMs
Ensure all project activities are implemented on time with utmost quality as per approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP)/ Standard Operating Procedure (SoP)/ Package of Practice (PoP)/ Community Operational Manual (COM) in the respective districts.
Support the district in projects under PVTG Domain.
Coordinate with DMMU and BMMU to ensure smooth implementation of the project .
Coordinate and facilitate in organizing capacity building training of project team and community.
Coordinate and lead in organizing any project related event at regional and district.
Coordinate and support in any field visits of dignitaries and officials.
Ensure timely planning and implementation of project activities.
Ensure proper documentation and reporting related to the project to respective offices.
Facilitate the timely collection/ entry, processing and reporting of data.
Support and practice monitoring evaluation of projects.
Good stakeholder management at the grassroots level.

Who are we looking for in this role
Candidate must be graduate; post-graduate will be preferred, in relevant streams like rural development, rural management, agriculture, forestry, social work, anthropology etc.
Candidate must have 4-6 years of relevant experience in the development sector/ rural development projects/ poverty eradication projects/ livelihood promotion projects/ tribal development projects.
Candidate with work experience working in district-level positions in National Rural Livelihood Mission/ State Rural Livelihood Missions in Institution Building, Capacity Building, Social Inclusion, Social Development, and Livelihood promotion will be preferred.
The candidate must have her/his own two-wheeler with a valid driving license as it is a field job.
The Location for this role is based in Eastern West Khasi Hills

What s in it for you

Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

You can learn more about what we do and how we do it through this deck .

Description:
Role & Responsibilities
Manage end-to-end logistics operations, including dispatch planning, transportation, and delivery of finished steel products such as TMT bars.
Plan and monitor daily vehicle placement, loading, dispatch schedules, and timely delivery to dealers, distributors, and customers.
Coordinate with Sales, Production, Warehouse, and Finance teams to ensure smooth dispatch operations.
Manage transporters and logistics vendors, negotiate freight rates, and optimize transportation costs.
Monitor vehicle utilization, freight expenses, transit time, and delivery performance.
Ensure proper documentation for dispatches, including invoices, e-way bills, delivery challans, and transport documents.
Track shipments and resolve delivery delays, transit issues, and customer complaints.
Ensure compliance with applicable transportation regulations, safety standards, and company policies.
Monitor logistics budgets, transport bills, freight reconciliation, and cost-control initiatives.
Maintain MIS reports on dispatches, freight costs, vehicle availability, and delivery performance.
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, reduce logistics costs, and enhance customer satisfaction.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or Operations will be an added advantage.
Relevant experience in logistics, transportation, dispatch, or supply chain management, preferably in the steel, cement, manufacturing, or infrastructure industry.
Experience in managing bulk material transportation, heavy vehicles, transporter networks, and dealer/customer deliveries.
Strong knowledge of dispatch planning, freight negotiation, vehicle utilization, and logistics cost optimization.
Working knowledge of GST-related transport documentation, e-way bills, invoicing, and compliance requirements.
Proficiency in MS Excel and experience with ERP/SAP systems will be preferred.
Strong vendor management, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple dispatches and operational priorities.
Willingness to travel and work at plant or logistics locations as per business requirements.

Lab Operations
Role summary
Managerial Responsibilities:
Overall Management of the laboratory

Technical Responsibilities:
Up gradation of advanced technologies Quality of the results.
What the role entails - Key accountabilities/ responsibilities
1. Provide advice to those requesting information about the choice of tests, the use of the laboratory service and the interpretation of laboratory data.
2. Serve as an active member of the medical staff in main lab, collection center,
3. Relate and function effectively with NABL & other accrediting agencies, Appropriate administrative officials, healthcare community, the patient / clients.
4. Define, implement, and monitor standards of performance and quality improvement of the medical laboratory service orservices.
5. Monitor all processes in the laboratory to determine that reliable data is being generated.
6. Ensure availability of sufficiently qualified personnel with adequate training and experience to meet the needs of the laboratory.
7. Plan, set goals, develop, and allocate resources appropriate to the medical environment.
8. Provide effective and efficient administration of the medical laboratory service, including budget planning and control with responsible financial management, in accordance with institutional assignment of such responsibilities.
9. Provide educational programs for the medical and laboratory staff and participate in educational programs of the institution.
10. Implement a safe laboratory environment in compliance with good practice and applicable regulations.
11. Address any complaint, request, or suggestion from users of laboratory services. Ensure good staff morale.
12. Report authorization of Hematology, Biochemistry, Immunoassay, Clinical Pathology, and serology
13. Routine review of QC for all departments with review of reports including CBC, MP, PS, Reticulocyte count, Fluid routine, ICT/DCT, Blood group before approving
14. Formulate review and recheck policies for all tests and ensure compliance with the help of Lab supervisor and technicians.
15. Verification of critical, unusual, and abnormal test results before release
16. Interpret, Correlate, and generate medically significant laboratory data.
17. Attending all sorts of client queries related to test enquiries and interpretation of test results.
18. Approval of SOPs for use and ensure compliance with respect to accreditation requirements.
19. Ensure review of monthly MIS
20. Ensure results are reported within turnaround time with the help of section head.
21. Review and improvement of reports formats.
22. To identify new equipment, tests, technology, products and standardization of assays.
23. Identify needs for resources (human / equipment / infrastructure) and submit to senior management for approval.
24. Attending conferences/workshops to ensure updated knowledge about recent trends.
25. To spend time reviewing daily pendency status on reports not released as well as sample received cases to avoid patient dissatisfaction.
26. To keep a watchful eye on instrument maintenance and hygiene of lab and practice 0 tolerance in this area. Any instrument failure due to user s should be avoided totally as it affects our patient and business.
27. To ensure sample processing is not stopped due to KIT non availability.
28. To ensure that every PR is approved on time and any gaps are highlighted.
29. COL/ Lab Head should work with BU Heads in forecasting CAMP s and other seasonal activities and order KITs sufficiently.
30. To keep a close watch on technical complaints. Ensure analytical complaints get logged, DE flagging is minimized. For recorded complaints and initiate proper CAPA and must also discuss in weekly calls with the team on learning and preventive actionsand timely escalation of analytical complaints/ Legal threats
31. To spend quality time on understanding patient and customer VOC especially on cases we are not resolving on time. COL/Lab Head should guide the team to resolve issues on time andsupport them wherever technical input is required.
32. To participate in weekly meetings along with BU/SBU Heads to resolve issues as well as seek support wherever needs from nontechnical team.
33. To take responsibility to train the non-technical team for better business and customer engagement.
34. COL/Lab Head must contribute at least 8 hours in a month in training and sharing knowledge to the team through a formal mechanism.
35. To promote MHL test to larger communities of clinician through KOL Connects. They must use our report as a tool to promote test by recommending new test based on diagnosis in the report.
36. To make time at least once a month to meet B2B clients, collection centers, customers to understand the pulse of the market.
37. To follow guidelines objectively as per MHL Policy and ensure a culture of data-based decision making and discussions; hence every month compliance is very important. It is at most importance for to have self-Compliance from every lab and noncompliance is given utmost importance for closure.
38. To give sufficient time to check and review the Lab managers /Technical team on quality, material consumption and technical performance.
39. Ensure that processes needed for the quality management system are established, implemented, and maintained.
40. Reporting to laboratory management, at the level at which decisions are made on laboratory policy, objectives, and resources, on the performance of the quality management system and any need for improvement.
41. Ensuring the promotion of awareness of users needs and requirements throughout the laboratory organization.
What we are looking for in you
Excellent communication and analytical skill.

Lab Operations Team

Yes

Yes

A strong growth prospective.

Description:
Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accountant to manage daily accounting operations, GST compliance, ledger reconciliation, financial reporting, and documentation. Candidates with experience in steel, manufacturing, or trading industries will be preferred.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day accounting entries, journal vouchers, and general ledger maintenance.
Handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, and vendor/customer reconciliations.
Prepare bank reconciliation statements (BRS) and monitor outstanding balances.
Assist in GST returns, TDS compliance, and input tax credit reconciliation.
Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices, debit notes, credit notes, and payment documents.
Maintain inventory and stock reconciliation records related to steel purchases and sales.
Monitor freight, transportation, and other operational expenses.
Prepare monthly MIS reports, expense statements, and account summaries.
Support internal audits, statutory audits, and month-end closing activities.
Work on accounting software/ERP such as SAP, Tally, and MS Excel.
Candidate Requirements
Graduate in Commerce (B.Com); M.Com or MBA Finance preferred.
25 years of relevant experience in accounting and finance.
Good knowledge of GST, TDS, accounting principles, and reconciliations.
Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software/ERP.
Experience in steel, manufacturing, or trading companies will be an advantage.
Strong analytical skills, accuracy, and attention to detail.

Key Skills:
Accounting | GST | TDS | Accounts Payable | Accounts Receivable | Bank Reconciliation | Ledger Reconciliation | MIS Reporting | MS Excel | SAP | Tally | Inventory Accounting.

Preferred Industry: Steel / Iron & Steel / Manufacturing / Trading.
AboutCompany:
We Are JK Lakshmi Steel

From the foundation to the frame.

For over 40 years, JK Lakshmi has held India's buildings together from the ground up. Our cement is in homes, schools, hospitals, bridges and roads across the country, trusted by the families who live in them and the engineers who design them.

Now we're adding the part that holds them up.

Steel is what keeps a structure standing. It carries the weight of every floor, every wall and every life inside. That's too important to leave to chance, so we're bringing the same discipline that built the JK Lakshmi name in cement to everything we make in steel: TMT bars, wires, structural channels and pipes.

We're not new to building India. We're simply taking the next step. What we did for cement, we're now doing for steel: raising the standard, checking every stage, and making sure the name on the product means something.

We're in your cement. Now we're in your steel.

Description:
Role & responsibilities :
Conduct comprehensive physiotherapy assessments and develop individualized treatment and rehabilitation plans.
Provide physiotherapy interventions for orthopaedic, neurological, cardiopulmonary, sports, geriatric, paediatric, and post-operative conditions, as applicable.
Deliver bedside physiotherapy, early mobilization, respiratory care, mobility training, and functional rehabilitation for admitted patients.
Monitor patient progress and modify treatment plans based on clinical requirements.
Manage inpatient and outpatient referrals, follow-ups, and continuity of rehabilitation care.
Educate patients and caregivers on exercises, posture, mobility, home rehabilitation, and preventive care.
Maintain accurate clinical records and comply with hospital protocols, infection control, and patient safety standards.
Coordinate with consultants, nursing staff, and other healthcare professionals for integrated patient care.
Participate in clinical audits, quality improvement initiatives, NABH-related activities, and departmental development.
Contribute to health camps, awareness programs, research activities, and continuous professional development.
AboutCompany:
Jindal Power Limited (JPL) is a leading Indian power company with a diverse energy portfolio encompassing thermal and renewable sources. With an impressive installed capacity of 4300 MW, JPL has been instrumental in meeting the nation's growing power demands. Pioneering the establishment of an Independent Power Plant (IPP) in 2007 with its 4x250 MW thermal power unit in Chhattisgarh's Raigarh district, JPL has continued its expansion in Tamnar with a 2400 MW (4X600 MW) thermal power plant.
JPL energy portfolio includes 3400 MW at Tamnar, Chhattisgarh and 600 MW at Simhapuri Andhra Pradesh & 300 MW at Shirpur, Maharashtra. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies and best practices, JPL has set new standards in India's power sector.
The company's vision is to emerge as a significant player in the industry, contributing to the nation's development. Committed to renewable energy sources, JPL aims to substantially increase the share of power generated through sustainable means. As the 5th largest integrated power producer in India, based on million units of generation, and with three captive mines, JPL stands as a key player in the sector. The company envisions establishing benchmarks in renewable energy, carbon emissions, and environmental protection. Furthermore, JPL is a trailblazer in community development and welfare initiatives.
