Lead BMS AMC/vendor performance (response time, fix quality, spares readiness, documentation completeness).
Validate OEM recommendations, ensure technical correctness, and prevent unnecessary replacements.
Documentation & compliance readiness
Maintain accurate as-built drawings, point lists, network architecture, controller programs/versions, cause-effect matrices, and change logs.
Support audits and internal reviews through evidence-based records (backups, trend logs, incident RCA, maintenance logs).
B) Projects / Enhancements (secondary but essential)
Deliver BMS upgrades and minor projects
Manage enhancements such as new floor/area integrations, sensor additions, control logic modifications, dashboard/reporting buildouts, alarm rationalization projects, and server/workstation refresh support.
Own scope, requirements, vendor coordination, site execution planning, and handover.
Commissioning, testing & handover
Create and execute commissioning plans: point-to-point checks, functional testing, trend verification, and UAT with stakeholders.
Ensure clean handover package: updated as-builts, programs, backups, O&M, training, and SOPs.
Support larger MEP/fit-out initiatives
Partner with project teams to ensure BMS design compliance, integration feasibility, and maintainability.
Review control drawings, IO schedules, network designs, and sequences of operation.
Key deliverables / KPIs (examples)
Reduction in repeat alarms and nuisance alarms (alarm rationalization effectiveness)
MTTR improvement for BMS-related incidents; quality of RCA closure
BMS uptime/availability; backup/restore success rate
Energy performance improvements attributable to controls optimization (where metering supports)
On-time delivery of BMS enhancements/projects with compliant documentation handover
Vendor SLA adherence and first-time-fix rate
Required qualifications & experience
Experience: Typically 8–12+ years in BMS/IBMS operations, with multi-site exposure preferred; at least 3–5 years in a lead/manager role.
Education: BE/BTech in Electrical, Mechanical, Instrumentation, Electronics, or equivalent.
Core technical skills:
Strong hands-on in BMS platforms (any major OEM acceptable), including supervisory layer, DDC/controller level, and field integration.
Protocols & integration: BACnet (IP/MS-TP), Modbus (TCP/RTU), OPC, Lon (if legacy), gateways and multi-vendor integration.
HVAC control concepts: AHU/PAHU, VAV, chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers; control loops, sequencing, interlocks.
Networking fundamentals relevant to BMS: IP addressing, VLAN basics (as applicable), switch ports, latency/packet loss troubleshooting, basic cybersecurity coordination.
Trend analysis, reporting, and data-driven troubleshooting.
Preferred / nice-to-have
Exposure to DC-grade critical environments or high-availability buildings, command centers, or regulated workplaces.
Experience implementing analytics/FDD tools or advanced dashboards.
Project management capability (basic scheduling, BOQ review, vendor evaluation, change control).
Certifications (nice to have): OEM BMS certifications, PMP/Prince2 (lightweight), energy management fundamentals.
Behavioral competencies
Strong ownership and calm incident handling; can lead from the front during outages.
Structured problem solving (hypothesis test isolate validate fix prevent recurrence).
Stakeholder management across engineering, IT, security, and vendors.
Clear communication: converts technical issues into business impact and action plans.

Experience managing global or multi-country SAP programs.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with Agile, Hybrid Agile, and Waterfall delivery methodologies.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Senior Sales Manager with strong experience in the steel industry to drive business growth, develop new markets, manage key accounts, and lead the sales team. The ideal candidate should have in-depth knowledge of steel products, excellent negotiation skills, and a proven track record of achieving sales targets.

Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue and business growth targets.
Identify new business opportunities, develop new customers, and expand market presence.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, distributors, dealers, and industrial clients.
Lead, motivate, and manage the sales team to achieve individual and organizational targets.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing, and customer requirements.
Manage key accounts and negotiate commercial terms with customers.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely order processing, delivery, and customer satisfaction.
Prepare sales forecasts, market reports, and business development plans.
Identify opportunities to improve sales performance, profitability, and customer retention.



Minimum 10 years of sales experience, preferably in the steel industry.
At least 5 years of experience in a sales leadership or managerial role.
Strong understanding of steel products, the supply chain, and the Indian steel market.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.


Required Skills
Steel Sales and Business Development
Strategic Sales Planning
B2B Sales and Key Account Management
Team Leadership and Sales Team Management
Customer Relationship Management
Negotiation and Commercial Skills
Market Analysis and Competitor Research
Revenue Growth and Sales Target Achievement
Sales Forecasting and Business Planning
Strong Communication and Interpersonal Skills


Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate will be a proactive sales professional with strong industry connections, a customer-focused approach, excellent leadership abilities, and the capability to develop long-term business relationships while driving sustainable revenue growth.

Interested candidates with relevant experience in steel sales and business development are encouraged to apply.

Manage and control voluntary attrition and control absconders by conducting regular engagement activities.
Provide feedback at the individual level and conduct weekly one-on-ones to understand problem areas.
Ensure excellent customer experience by solving order level escalations.
Support Pickup and Delivery Partners during emergencies and exigencies.

Prior experience in process design and operations implementation. 2-3 years of experience in managing blue collar workers.

Knowledge of supervisory techniques to manage, motivate and train blue collared workers.

Must have customer service skills and be able to maintain a consistent, high level of service.

Description:
Job Description
Supply Chain Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.
With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships.
It s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers hands, you ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.


Qualifications Experience
B.Sc/M.Sc. (Chemistry/Microbiology/Food Technology/Biotechnology) or BE/BTech- Food Tech/Chemical Engineering.
6-10 years of experience in distillery, brewery or beverage manufacturing quality.
Knowledge of SAP/LIMS, laboratory systems, HACCP, ISO/FSSC 22000 and statistical quality tools.


About the role

Quality Governance Compliance
Lead and sustain the Unit Quality Food Safety Management System in line with organizational, regulatory and statutory requirements.
Ensure effective quality controls for RM/PM, liquid, in-process and finished goods, including end-of-line inspection and product release.
Lead internal audits, MRM and ensure readiness for external, certification and regulatory audits.
Govern QC holds, deviations, rework and disposition of non-conforming materials/products.
Ensure timely investigation and closure of consumer/customer complaints and escalation of significant quality risks.
Ensure accurate Quality MIS/KPI reporting and partner with cross-functional teams to deliver production without compromising Quality or Food Safety.


Continuous Improvement
Lead structured RCPS/RCA for quality incidents, complaints, deviations and recurring defects.
Ensure robust CAPAs are implemented with process owners and verified for effectiveness.
Analyse Quality KPIs and trends to identify systemic issues and improvement opportunities.
Drive reduction in defects, complaints, rejection, rework and Cost of Poor Quality.
Drive Right-First-Time and process capability improvements jointly with Operations and Engineering.
Ensure Quality risk assessment and validation for new products, packs, materials, equipment and process changes

Job Summary:
Troubleshoots, assembles, installs, tests and maintains electrical systems using all necessary tools to keep equipment available and capable. Learns and understands the protocols of working safely with electricity and other energy sources with industrial equipment. May work independently and instruct or coach others.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship. Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis. Performs work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments. Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system. Follows all process documentation and quality procedures. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Delivery Fully proficient performing troubleshooting, electrical repairs and maintenance of equipment . Conforms to applicable codes and standards to maintain, install, and operate electrical systems. Instructs and coaches others and acts as an informal resource for team members with less capability. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks. Performs other duties as required to meet business goals. Work with peers and support staff to: Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Schedule maintenance activities around production requirements Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.
Intermediate-level knowledge gained through education, training, or on-the-job experience.
Hands-on experience with SIEMENS TIA Portal, servo drive handling, programming, and troubleshooting.
Strong basic logic-building and analytical thinking ability.
Knowledge of LOTO, HIRA, and other industrial safety practices.
Knowledge of machine safety systems (added advantage).
Ability to perform Why-Why analysis and use structured problem-solving techniques.
Ability to identify and implement cost-saving techniques in daily work.
Hands-on experience with Yaskawa robots and familiarity with ABB/Yaskawa systems.
Experience working in Robot Studio or equivalent platforms.
3 to 5 years of experience in Yaskawa robotics /Fanuc (teaching, troubleshooting, maintenance).
Understanding of robot safety standards and regulations (ISO, ANSI/RIA).
Experience integrating ABB robotic systems with conveyors, and PLCs.
Need to Attend Daily Breakdown Electrical and Mechanical with Maintain 5S .
Experience
Requires intermediate-level experience gained through education, training, or on-the-job exposure.
3-5 years of experience in Siemens PLC Programming Knowledge, automation, or electrical machine maintenance preferred.
Experience with PLCs, robotics programming, troubleshooting, and industrial automation systems.
Preferers SIEMENS PLC training Certification
Competencies:
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Controls Safety - Recognizes controls related hazards in a manufacturing environment (Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic) to incorporate safe practices and procedures as part of the daily work plan to reduce injuries and create a safe machine environment.

Electrical System Troubleshooting - Analyzes an electrical control system to resolve and repair electrical issues to return the system to proper operating conditions.

Factory Automation and Control Systems - Implements changes to further automate manufacturing processes using available technology, programming techniques, and identifying needed material and resources for project completion to provide the optimum automation for the manufacturing environment.

Machine Programming - Creates factory floor machine programs by designing and implementing solutions to improve usage of machine and overall operation.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the functions needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

Job Summary
The Engineering Manufacturing Interface (EMI) / Plant Product Engineer (PPE) acts as the technical bridge between Product Engineering and Manufacturing, supporting products throughout the development and production lifecycle. The role coordinates prototype, pilot, and production builds, ensures manufacturing readiness for new products, supports engineering changes and configuration management, and drives resolution of manufacturing and product quality issues.
The position works closely with Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Suppliers, and other cross-functional teams to ensure successful product introduction, robust manufacturing processes, and continuous product and process improvement.
Key Responsibilities
Act as the technical interface between Product Engineering and Manufacturing teams for current and future products.
Support build events, prototype builds, pilot builds, and New Product Introduction (NPI) activities.
Coordinate prototype, pilot, and production builds and track actions to ensure timely execution.
Assess and verify manufacturing readiness for new products and engineering changes.
Support APQP, PPAP, production validation, and product launch activities.
Review, coordinate, and implement Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), Engineering Change Requests (ECRs), and VPCRs at the plant.
Coordinate design changes with Product Engineering and plant teams to ensure effective implementation.
Create, release, maintain, and align Manufacturing Bill of Materials (MBOMs) with Engineering Bill of Materials (EBOMs).
Support product configuration and change management throughout the product lifecycle.
Investigate manufacturing, product, warranty, and field quality issues using structured problem-solving methodologies.
Lead or support root cause analysis, 8D, 7-step problem solving, and corrective/preventive action activities.
Support DFMEA/PFMEA, design reviews, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG), and other product quality processes.
Coordinate with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Suppliers, Purchasing, and Customer teams to resolve technical issues.
Support product verification and validation activities and evaluate test results against requirements.
Identify opportunities for process optimization, waste elimination, quality improvement, and manufacturing efficiency.
Support warranty, reliability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Maintain technical documentation and communicate product and manufacturing requirements effectively to stakeholders.
Coordinate activities across functional teams to ensure project milestones, quality expectations, and production requirements are achieved.
Willingness to learn new products, technologies, processes, and engineering systems.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related Engineering/STEM discipline.
Masters degree in a relevant engineering discipline is preferred for select roles.
Relevant internship, co-op, project, or early-career experience in product development, manufacturing engineering, quality, or plant engineering is preferred.
Skills & Experience
Understanding of product development, manufacturing engineering, plant engineering, or quality processes.
Knowledge of GD&T, DFMEA/PFMEA, APQP, PPAP, Six Sigma/Lean, and structured problem-solving methodologies.
Experience or knowledge of 8D, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and engineering problem-solving tools.
Understanding of EBOM, MBOM, product configuration, and change management.
Knowledge of CAD, PLM, and engineering change management systems.
Understanding of product verification, validation, and manufacturing readiness processes.
Ability to coordinate and manage engineering changes and implementation activities across multiple functions.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret technical and manufacturing data and make data-driven decisions.
Knowledge of statistical methods, process improvement, and waste reduction techniques is preferred.
Product knowledge of DEF dosing systems and Aftertreatment Systems is preferred.
Strong cross-functional collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work effectively with Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing, Suppliers, and other stakeholders.
Strong technical documentation and presentation skills.
Ability to take ownership, manage multiple priorities, and deliver results within defined timelines.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications is preferred.

Description:
Job Description Cluster Manager
Role objective
The Cluster Manager is primarily responsible for driving sales and building the loan portfolio across assigned branches, while ensuring good customer service, quality business and disciplined branch operations.
Key responsibilities
1. Sales and portfolio growth
Set branch-wise sales priorities and follow up with the sales team on customer acquisition and loan disbursements.
Monitor branch performance, identify gaps and take corrective action to achieve business targets.
Ensure portfolio growth is supported by proper customer verification, adherence to company policies and quality lending practices.
2. Customer service and branch readiness
Ensure every operating branch opens by 9:30 a.m. Escalate any delay immediately.
Ensure at least two employees are present at each branch. Where staffing falls short, contact Pavan Kalyan immediately to arrange deputation.
Ensure customers receive prompt, courteous service and that complaints and service delays are addressed quickly.
3. Auction-loan follow-up
Follow up with customers and branch staff on loans identified for the June auction.
Ensure each affected customer receives the auction message through WhatsApp, in line with the companys communication process.
Track customer responses and repayment commitments, and ensure branch staff complete the required follow-up.
4. Branch expansion
Identify suitable premises for new branches with the assistance of Team Leaders from nearby branches.
Coordinate site visits and submit shortlisted premises for review and approval.
5. Recruitment and staffing coordination
Follow up with HR on hiring the sales team for existing and proposed branches.
Coordinate with Deepika from MIS to download candidate profiles based on the required locations, such as Nagarkurnool, Mahabubabad and Nalgonda.
Assist AVPs and VPs in uploading candidate profiles onto FINS.
Send emails proposing the rejoining of suitable former employees and follow up with HR on the necessary approvals and joining arrangements.
Performance expectations
The Cluster Manager will be assessed on portfolio growth, loan disbursements, customer service, business quality, timely branch opening, staffing readiness and completion of assigned auction follow-ups.
- Each operating Branch is opened by 9.30am;
- If any Branch opening after 9.30am, shall be escalated;
- Min two employees are present in the Branch; If not, shall reach out Pavan Kalyan for deputation
- Follow up June Auction Loans with customers and Branch staff;
- Shall send Auction message to each customer through whatsapp;
- Identify premises for new Branches with the help of TLs of nearby Branches
- Follow up with HR as regards hiring of Sales team;
- Reach out Deepika of MIS to download profiles using location – For example – Nagarkurnool, Mehabubabad, Nalgonda.
- Shall help AVPs and VPs to upload profiles on FINS;
- Shall send mails for rejoining of staff;
- Follow up with Sales Team for Loan Disbursements.

The Bancassurance Department within Axis Max Life Insurance plays a critical role in driving the distribution of life insurance products through our strategic partnership with Yes Bank. This department leverages Yes Bank s existing customer base and infrastructure to offer insurance solutions.

Title: Head - Finance
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, BudgetingCapexInsuranceTreasuryRisk Management, About company, Tata Power- An Equal Opportunity Employer.
Description:
About Organisation
Tata Power runs four electricity distribution companies (Discoms) in Odisha through a public-private partnership with the state government. Formed as 51:49 joint ventures between Tata Power and the Government of Odisha, these utilities supply reliable power to nearly 10 million consumers across the state.

The Four Odisha Discoms
TPCODL (TP Central Odisha Distribution Limited)
TPNODL (TP Northern Odisha Distribution Limited)
TPSODL (TP Southern Odisha Distribution Limited)
TPWODL (TP Western Odisha Distribution Limited)

This Position will be based at TP Central Odisha Distribution Limited, Bhubaneswar, Odisha

Job Purpose
TPCODL is seeking an experienced and strategic finance leader to head key finance functions including Budgeting, Capital Expenditure (Capex), Treasury Management, Insurance, and Enterprise Risk Management.
The role requires a seasoned Chartered Accountant with strong financial planning, regulatory, and stakeholder management capabilities, preferably from power, infrastructure, utilities, manufacturing, or large corporate environments.

Key Responsibilities
Budgeting & Financial Planning
Lead the annual budgeting process and long-term financial planning across functions.
Monitor budget utilization and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Drive budgeting reviews, variance analysis, forecasting, and financial performance reporting.
Present budget insights and recommendations to senior management.
Capital Expenditure (Capex) Management.
Evaluate and monitor Capex proposals, business cases, and investment decisions.
Establish controls to ensure optimum utilization of capital investments.
Track project-wise Capex spending against approved budgets.
Support management in capital allocation and investment prioritization.

Treasury Management
Manage organizational liquidity, cash flow planning, and working capital requirements.
Optimize fund deployment and borrowing arrangements.
Maintain relationships with banks, financial institutions, and lenders.
Ensure compliance with treasury policies and financial covenants.
Insurance Management
Design and manage the organization's insurance portfolio.
Assess insurance requirements for operational and strategic risks.
Coordinate renewals, claims management, and policy negotiations.
Liaise with insurers, brokers, and internal stakeholders to ensure adequate coverage.

Enterprise Risk Management
Develop and implement risk management frameworks and policies.
Identify, evaluate, and mitigate financial, operational, and strategic risks.
Drive risk assessments and monitor risk mitigation plans across functions.
Report key risk indicators and risk exposures to leadership.

Financial Governance & Compliance
Ensure compliance with statutory, regulatory, taxation, and corporate governance requirements.
Support internal and external audits related to treasury, risk, and financial controls.
Strengthen internal controls and financial governance practices.
Monitor changes in regulations impacting finance operations.

Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business leaders to support strategic decision-making.
Engage with auditors, banks, regulators, insurers, and external consultants.
Build and mentor a high-performing finance team.

Educational Qualification
Chartered Accountant (CA) from ICAI (Mandatory).

Experience
12+ years of progressive experience in Finance.
Strong expertise in Budgeting, Capex Management, Treasury Operations, Insurance, and Risk Management.
Experience in Utilities, Power Distribution
Proven experience in managing large budgets and strategic finance initiatives.
AboutCompany:
Tata Power- An Equal Opportunity Employer.

Led by a powerful vision, Tata Power pioneered the generation of electricity in India. It has now successfully served the Mumbai consumers for over ninety years and has spread its footprints across the nation. Today, it is the countrys largest private player in the sector. Apart from Mumbai and Delhi, the company has generation capacities in Jojobera, Jharkhand and Karnataka.As a growth strategy , Tata Power has ventured into several greenfield projects in Generation. The 4000 megawatt imported Coal-based generating station at Mundra , Gujarat , 1000 megawatt Thermal Power plant at Maithon , Jharkhand are some of its recent involvements. It has got several other upcoming capacity additions / greenfield projects in Maharashtra , Jharkhand , Orissa , West Bengal.

Description:
Job Purpose


This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd.


Duties and Responsibilities


General Admin (Facility Management RM)
1. Control branch OPEX expenses within set budget.
2. Maintain regular Maintenance Hygiene of branches.
3. Timely closer on Issues including RM activity.
4. Timely Payment of branch expense bills.
5. Expense control of general expenses of branches.
6. Branch Feedback of employees seniors visiting branches.
7. Maintain proper data / records of all expenses of all locations managers supervised.
8.Monthly branch visits .
Infrastructure (NEW Projects under BASE)
1. Identification of new premises as per company requirement (Location rate).
2. Close on documentation legal clearance.
3. Having the civil work (as required) completed.
4. Installation of furniture fixtures.
5. Coordination with infra vendors.
6. Ensuring the branch is complete handed over to business well in TAT
Statutory Compliances
1. Ensuring the LOI is signed well within the TAT. (within 5 working days from receiving the legal clearance stability
2. Ensuring the lease agreement is signed well within the TAT. (within 10 working days from signing the LOI
3. Ensuring the lease agreement is registered well within the TAT. (within 20 working days of receiving the approval from H.O)
4.the shops establishments application is applied the certificate is received well within the TAT. (within 10 days of branch completion)
5.security related equipments are up to date under AMC renewals are done prior to expiry of contract.
6. Renewals of all Lease agreements AMC contract done prior to the expiry date.
7. Ensuring all statutory documents / certificates are displayed at the common area (reception) in line to compliance.





1. Graduate in any discipline with experience of working in Administration preferred
2. Inclination to have knowledge/ exposure on legal/ compliance matters.
3. Exposure in handling govt. / legal Issues
4. Team management interpersonal Skills
5. Good on negotiations and Vendor development Management
6. Well versed with MS Word, Excel, Power Point
7. Willing to Travel

About Swiggy: 
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city.
You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants - learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement.
This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success.
You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
-Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
-Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
-Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling
services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward
the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day
tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the
customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a
conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick
up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of
the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is
expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the
overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of
stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Job Title: Field Sales Executive Lenskart@Home


We're looking for energetic and customer-focused Sales Executives to visit customers' homes, conduct eye tests, and sell Lenskart spectacles. As a Sales Executive, you'll:
Visit customers' homes based on scheduled appointments
Conduct eye tests using specialized equipment
Sell Lenskart spectacles and provide exceptional customer service
Carry a 20-25 kg bag with eye check equipment and eyewears
Meet sales targets and earn attractive commissions

Compensation Package:
Fixed CTC: Salary
Variable compensation based on sales performance
Travel allowances

Training:
30-days comprehensive training in Ahmedabad on eye checkups and sales techniques
Candidates must be willing to stay/travel to the training location for 30 days
Support and product training

Graduate or Diploma holder
Fresher/Experienced
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to lift and carry equipment (20-25 kg)
Willingness to travel and work flexible hours
Must possess a valid driving license
Must own a bike (two-wheeler)

What We Offer:
Opportunity to work with India's leading eyewear brand
Competitive compensation and incentives
Comprehensive training and support
Chance to make a difference in customers' lives through vision care

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Driving Net
Promoter Score Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same

Cash & Inventory Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services

Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring
the best customer experience to the Lenskart CustomerEnsuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues

standards

implementation Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues

maintenance equipment at the store

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Location: Itanagar

Job Summary
Responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing electrical systems and equipment to ensure safe, uninterrupted, and efficient operations of the cinema premises.

ITI or Diploma in Electrical Engineering.
25 years of experience in electrical maintenance, preferably in cinemas, hotels, malls, or commercial establishments.
Practical knowledge of electrical wiring, panels, fault diagnosis, and preventive maintenance.
Knowledge of electrical safety procedures and the use of maintenance tools.
Required Skills
Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Basic documentation and reporting abilities.
Ability to work in shifts and handle operational emergencies.
Strong safety awareness and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and coordinate with the maintenance team.

BNYS or BAMS or MSc (Yoga) with UGC-NET

Description:
We are seeking an experienced Knowledge Graph Engineer / Semantic Web Developer to design, develop, and integrate enterprise metadata and ontology models using TopBraid EDG and W3C semantic standards. The ideal candidate will bridge semantic data modeling with backend microservices engineering to deliver production-ready Knowledge Graph solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
- Design, build, and maintain enterprise semantic knowledge graph models using RDF, OWL, and SHACL constraint shapes in TopBraid EDG.
- Develop, optimize, and test complex SPARQL queries and rules for data extraction, reasoning, and metadata management.
- Build and maintain integration pipelines, microservices, and REST/GraphQL APIs using Java or Python to connect TopBraid EDG with upstream/downstream enterprise systems.
- Establish metadata governance workflows, data lineage, business glossaries, and reference data management within TopBraid EDG.
- Collaborate with data governance leads, domain ontologists, and technical architects to translate functional requirements into robust graph schemas.
Required Technical Qualifications:
- 6+ years of hands-on software development experience with at least 2-3 years dedicated to semantic technologies and Knowledge Graphs.
- Strong hands-on experience working directly with TopBraid EDG (or equivalent semantic graph platforms like Stardog / GraphDB).
- Expertise in W3C semantic web standards: RDF, RDFS, OWL, SPARQL, and SHACL.
- Proficient backend programming skills in Java or Python for building enterprise APIs and integration microservices.
- Solid understanding of metadata management, enterprise data governance, data cataloging, and ontology modeling.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with Property Graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune).
- Experience exposing Knowledge Graphs as a Service (KaaS) or integrating graphs with LLM/GenAI pipelines (e.g., GraphRAG).
- Consulting or client-delivery experience in a global delivery environment.

Description:
Resident Engineer (RE) - Civil Position: Resident Engineer (Civil) Project: HEO 240 MW Hydro Electric Project Location: Project Site, Arunachal Pradesh Employment Type: Full-time, Site-based Experience Required: 7-10 Years Qualification
B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized university/institution.
Proficiency in computer-aided design tools, project management software (MS Project/Primavera), and technical documentation.
Experience Overview
Minimum 8 years of total post-qualification experience in execution, site supervision, and quality control of major infrastructure projects, with a strong preference for Hydro Electric Projects (HEP), Tunneling/Underground works, or Dam/Powerhouse construction.
Key Responsibilities
Site Execution & Supervision: Act as the primary on-site engineering representative to oversee daily civil construction activities, including surface/underground excavation, slope stabilization, tunneling, concreting, and structural works.
Quality Assurance & Control (QA/QC): Ensure all construction materials (cement, steel, aggregates) and workmanship rigorously comply with national standards, project technical specifications, and design drawings.
Progress Monitoring: Track daily site progress against baseline construction schedules, report bottlenecks, and assist senior management in developing recovery plans for delayed activities.
Technical Compliance & Drawings: Review construction drawings, method statements, bar-bending schedules, and technical submittals at the site level, flagging discrepancies proactively.
Contract Administration Support: Maintain meticulous daily site records, measurement books (MB), joint measurements, and documentation required for tracking variations and contractor billing.
Safety & Health Compliance: Strictly enforce site safety rules, health guidelines, and environmental protocols, working closely with the HSE team, particularly given the challenging Himalayan terrain of Arunachal Pradesh.
Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate smoothly with contractors, testing laboratories, and multidisciplinary project teams to resolve technical issues swiftly on-site.

Description:
*Role: Business Development / Expansion Role – OYO (Field Profile)*
*What is this role about?*
This role is about **expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets*
You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.
This is a *field-based role* and requires regular travel.
*What will you do in this role?*
• Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
• Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
• Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
• Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
• Negotiate commercials and close property signings
• Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
• Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
• Review agreements and service levels with property owners
• Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams
*How is your performance measured?*
• Number of sellable rooms signed every month
• Number of rooms made live and available for booking
• Gross margin generated from signed properties
*Education:*
• Graduation mandatory
• MBA preferred
**Experience & Skills:**
• 1–5 years of relevant experience
• Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
• Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
• Analytical and data-driven mindset
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
• Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
• Good Excel skills and professional email writing
*Stakeholders you will work with:*
*Internal:*
• Business Development Head
• Hub Head
• Central Team
• Operations Team
• Transformation Team
• Legal Team
*External:*
• Property Owners
• Real Estate Brokers
*In simple words:*
Your role is to *find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable*.

Evaluation Engineer CARS24
Location: Ranchi
Department: Operations / Used Car Evaluation
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Evaluation Engineer to inspect and evaluate used vehicles. The candidate will be responsible for conducting technical inspections, identifying vehicle conditions, and preparing accurate evaluation reports to support vehicle procurement and pricing decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct comprehensive inspections of used vehicles.
Evaluate vehicle condition including:
Engine performance
Transmission
Suspension
Electrical systems
Body & paint condition
Interior quality
Perform test drives to assess vehicle performance.
Use diagnostic tools and standard checklists for technical assessment.
Identify accidental history, repainting, or mechanical defects.
Prepare accurate vehicle evaluation reports and upload findings into the system.
Coordinate with procurement and operations teams for smooth vehicle acquisition.
Ensure adherence to company SOPs and quality standards.
Maintain transparency and professionalism during customer interactions.

Technical Skills

Good understanding of:
Automobile systems and components
Engine diagnostics
Vehicle body structure
OBD/diagnostic tools
Knowledge of accidental and flood damage identification preferred.
Basic computer and reporting skills.
Candidate should know two and four wheeler driving.
Candidate should have valid two and four wheeler driving license

Preferred Candidate Profile

Passionate about automobiles and vehicle technology
Ability to work in field operations
Comfortable with rotational shifts and travel within city locations
Valid Driving License preferred

To be responsible for all aspects of specification jobs which includes writing specification packages/ ensuring that the specifications written are given impetus and thrust especially with technical community including opinion makers for all products (excluding cement Grinding aids) and help the sales team in running projects for getting specified new products with consultants/clients & and also to break the competitor specifications.

AboutCompany:
Fosroc, a Saint-Gobain business, is a leading global provider of high-performance construction chemical solutions, serving the building and infrastructure industry for decades.
With a strong presence across markets, Fosroc provides innovative solutions in concrete repair, waterproofing, grouting, sealants, flooring, jointing, admixtures and structural strengthening.
Fosroc partners closely with architects, consultants, engineers, contractors and project owners to provide technically advanced solutions for complex construction challenges.

Purpose/Objective


The Store Incharge oversees the efficient receipt, storage, and issuance of materials, ensuring adherence to standard operating procedures (SOP) and maintaining material quality.
This role coordinates with site store in-charges on material requisitions and vendor deliveries, manages inventory through regular monitoring and timely disposal of non-moving items, and handles financial and documentation management to ensure accurate records.
Key Responsibilities of Role


Store In-charge - Mining Stakeholder Liasioning: Liasion with site store in-charge to cordinate with material requisitions and vendor deliveries Obtain vendor reports from all sites on monthly basis and consolidate the same for providing inputs to Vendor Development Lead and senior management.
Material Handling and Procurement: Ensure efficient receipt, storage, and issuance of various materials in accordance with standard operating procedures (SOP).
Coordinate material collection from the vendors for material procured or services sourced.
Implement appropriate storage methods tailored to different categories of materials to maintain their quality and integrity.
Oversee PR and verify stock availability before approving PRs to facilitate timely procurement.
Ensure the closure of open goods receipt/invoice receipt (GR/IR) issues to maintain accurate inventory records.
Employ effective handling methods to prevent material damage.
Inventory Management: Authorize RGP/NRGP material gate passes and define ROL and ROQ for fast-moving items in collaboration with user and commercial departments to optimize inventory management Ensure timely monitoring and disposal of non-moving items nearing expiration, following established procedures.
Oversee regular physical verification of inventory in accordance with SOP.
Financial and Documentation Management: Maintain records encompassing store registers and material requisition slips (MRS).
Enter invoices into the system to enable Contract Admin / ABEX for doing MIRO and subsequent release of payment.
Operational Management and Reporting: Facilitate daily review meetings with store team members to promptly address and resolve any outstanding issues.
Respond to internal and external audit queries, provide necessary data, and implement corrective actions for audit observations.
Ensure compliance with IMS standards in all store processes and data management activities.
Oversee GRN, quality, DCC, and MRS posting in SAP.
Compile monthly MIS reports on inventory aging, non-moving items (NMI), and project inventory, and distribute them to relevant stakeholders.
Technology Utilization: Leverage digital tools to streamline store operations, including order processing, stock management, and supplier coordination.
Develop and maintain digital records for store transactions and inventory, enhancing accuracy and transparency in store operations.
Key Stakeholders - Internal Site Store In-charges Finance Team Operations Team Quality Assurance Team Key Stakeholders - External Vendors Suppliers Regulatory Authorities

Category Management-NR,Contract Management-PRJ,Contractor Management-NR,Data Analysis and Reporting-NR,Digitization & Automation-NR,Inventory Management-PRJ,Market Intelligence Understanding-NR,Mining Business Know-how-NR,NR Business Know How-NR,Sourcing Strategy and Execution-NR
Qualifications and Experience


Educational Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
Work Experience (Range of years): 3-5 years of work experience

Role & responsibilities
Business Development: Generate leads and sales for Home Loans (HL) and Loans Against Property (LAP) through direct sales, DSAs, builders, and referrals.

AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Company: Cars24 Services Pvt. Ltd.
Position: Technical Retail Associate (TRA)
POC: Anubhavi Singh
Contact no: 8448285788
Location: Ranchi
Salary Budget: Up to 4 LPA
Work Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Retail Associate (TRA) who will be responsible for handling walk-in customers at the Cars24 yard, understanding their requirements, conducting basic vehicle inspections, and assisting customers in selling their cars through Cars24.

The ideal candidate should have good technical knowledge of cars, strong customer-handling and negotiation skills, and a valid driving license.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle and assist walk-in customers at the Cars24 yard.
* Conduct basic inspection and evaluation of customer vehicles.
* Explain the vehicle inspection process and provide relevant information to customers.
* Pitch and convince customers to sell their cars through Cars24.
* Explain and sell the Car Health Report to customers.
* Build strong relationships with customers and ensure a smooth customer experience.
* Handle customer queries, objections, and concerns professionally.
* Negotiate with customers and work towards successful deal closure.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth processing of vehicle sales.
* Maintain accurate customer and vehicle-related information in the system.
* Achieve assigned sales, conversion, and business targets.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Good technical knowledge of cars and basic automobile understanding.
* Strong communication and customer-handling skills.
* Good negotiation and convincing skills.
* Ability to pitch products/services and convert leads into successful transactions.
* Valid Driving License is mandatory.
* Comfortable working in a yard-based and customer-facing environment.
* Willingness to handle calling and follow-ups with customers.
* Prior experience in automobile sales, car inspection, vehicle evaluation, retail sales, or customer-facing roles will be preferred.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be:

* Customer-focused and confident.
* Good at communication and negotiation.
* Comfortable with calling and face-to-face customer interaction.
* Passionate about automobiles and knowledgeable about cars.
* Target-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Note: Saturday and Sunday will be working days. Your weekly off will be provided on any one day between Monday and Friday, based on the business requirements and roster.Role & responsibilities

Ways of Working - Mandate 3 : Employees to be located in their place of posting / respective office base location.
About Swiggy: 
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city.
You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants - learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement.
This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success.
You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
-Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
-Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
-Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
-Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
-Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
-Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
-Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
-Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
-80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
-0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
-Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
-Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
-Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
-Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Summary:
Prospects and develops new opportunities to grow the business. Develops/Executes account plans with coaching support. Achieves sales goals within the assigned sales territory, market segment or channel partners.
Key Responsibilities:
Develops opportunities to increase sales by identifying, researching and contacting prospective customers. Develops and executes account plans for top prospects and conducts agreed upon face to face sales calls. Builds positive customer relationships that enable identification of a customer s needs, business model and buying process. Uses understanding of customer needs and priorities to identify and offer Cummins solutions. Gains agreement on the differential advantage of Cummins solutions by helping the customer understand and evaluate existing data and information and the value proposition. Conducts negotiations according to company guidelines, including payment terms. Assists with collection of accounts receivables. Maintains acceptable level of past due accounts. Collaborates with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve delinquent payments. Drives sales, achieving sales targets and ensuring customer satisfaction. Maintains and strengthens customer relationships to generate future sales and repeat business. Responds to customer concerns in a timely fashion. Consistently uses the Cummins Sales Process as well as Cummins tools, processes, and initiatives that support sales, customer satisfaction, and customer value, e. g. Customer Relationship Management and special projects. Reports activity via the Customer Relationship Management tool per management direction. Maintains Sales forecasts and tracks progress and accuracy against forecast As applicable, works with internal stakeholders and customers to balance inventory, service, and delivery capabilities with customer expectations.
Handling key mining accounts in Jharkhand, Railways account in Bihar.
Driving retail sales in Bihar and Jharkhand.
Competencies:
Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Persuades - Using compelling arguments to gain the support and commitment of others.

Articulating Value Proposition - Interprets internal and external customer needs based on relevant application; explains and demonstrates products, solutions, and services to distinguish strengths and weaknesses to meet customers specific needs to differentiate against competition.

Channel Awareness - Explains and contextualizes industry structure, dynamics, and path to market in order to advance organizational goals.

Pricing Strategy - Develops prices by aligning and building consensus with key stakeholders across functions to achieve business targets.

Negotiations Excellence - Utilizes tools and methods in negotiations to achieve Cummins stakeholder objectives and achieve a mutually agreed upon all contract terms between all parties.

Account Planning - Identifies objectives to drive execution of business and/or account strategy by reviewing the status relative to where it needs to be and enabling tracking of progress against targets.

Adapts to target audience - Explains complex topics (significant technical data, subject matter expertise, etc. ) in such a way that the target audience (e. g. sales professionals, customers, training vendors, etc. ) can understand, retain, and use the information

Integrates Customer Perspective - Incorporates an understanding of the customers perspective on our products and sales efforts to develop sales content that improves our ability to meet their needs and increase revenue.

Sales Forecasting - Collects and assesses customer data from internal and external sources; compares against historical data to determine useful inputs and create a forecast of future consumption patterns.

Sales Pipeline Management - Plans proactively for successful execution of account/territory-level sales strategies and plans based on current pipeline; evaluates pipeline health (size, contents, progress); adjusts sales strategy, plans, or high impact activities accordingly; as applicable coaches sellers in order to achieve sales objectives.

Sense Making - Through a series of diagnostic and probing questions and research, develops and/or supports an intimate understanding of the customer needs, behaviors, and/or their buying journey. Synthesizes complex information from internal and external resources to deliver tailored solutions for the internal or external customer.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
Required: College, university, or equivalent degree in Marketing, Sales or a related subject, or acceptable sales related work experience, or an acceptable combination of education and experience.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Basic relevant work experience preferred.

Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick[1] up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
