About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Following the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority .

Driving Innovation: Join Us as a Retail Associate (Field Role) at Cars24!
Apply Now
Contact Person: Kavita Dangwal
Team: People & Culture | CARS24

Email: kavita.dangwal@cars24.com

What will you drive?
As a Retail Associate, your primary responsibility will be to build strong relationships with New Car Dealerships (NCDs)and generate high-quality leads for customers looking to sell or exchange their cars.
Your day will revolve around visiting 3-5 NCD outlets daily, engaging with dealer partners, and identifying customers interested in selling their old vehicles or opting for exchange deals. You will act as the face of CARS24 on the ground ensuring that every potential lead is captured, nurtured, and converted through our platform.
This role is not just about visits its about consistent follow-ups, relationship management, and closing deals. Strong coordination with dealers and timely follow-ups on leads will be critical to your success.
You will work towards monthly targets, where your performance will be measured based on lead generation, conversions, and dealer engagement quality. Your persuasion and negotiation skills will play a key role in turning opportunities into successful transactions.
To set you up for success, you will go through 715 days of structured training(classroom + on-field), equipping you with the right product knowledge, sales techniques, and tools.
Expect a high-performance environment with attractive incentives tied to your achievements because at CARS24, we celebrate results and reward top performers.

Key Responsibilities
Visit4-6 Dealerships daily to generate leads
Identify customers interested in selling or exchanging their cars
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealer partners
Ensure consistent follow-ups with NCDs for lead flow
Convert leads into successful transactions via CARS24
Maintain accurate records of visits, leads, and conversions
Achieve monthly sales and conversion targets

Working Days
6 days a week
Week off during weekdays

Who are we looking for?
Strong field sales mindset with willingness to travel daily
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
Ability to follow up persistently and close deals
Self-driven, target-oriented, and highly energetic
Prior experience in automobile, dealership, or field sales is a plus

Description:
Job Description for Sales Associate at Manipal Hospitals:

As a Sales Associate at Manipal Hospitals, you will play a key role in promoting and selling our healthcare services to potential patients and clients. Your primary responsibilities will include identifying sales opportunities, maintaining relationships with existing clients, and providing exceptional customer service. You will work closely with the healthcare team to understand our offerings and effectively communicate the benefits of our services to customers.

Key Responsibilities:
- Engage with potential patients and provide them with detailed information about healthcare services offered by Manipal Hospitals.
- Conduct market research to identify prospective clients and generate leads.
- Develop and maintain relationships with referral sources, such as physicians and community organizations.
- Collaborate with the marketing team to create promotional materials and campaigns that highlight our services.
- Meet and exceed sales targets and objectives.
- Maintain accurate records of sales activities and client interactions in the CRM system.
- Attend industry events and health fairs to represent Manipal Hospitals and connect with potential clients.
- Provide feedback to the management team on market trends and customer needs.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Excellent negotiation and persuasive abilities.
- Customer-focused attitude with a commitment to providing exceptional service.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Proficiency in using CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
- Previous experience in sales, preferably in healthcare or a related field, is a plus.
- Knowledge of healthcare services and an understanding of the sales process.

Roles and Responsibilities
About the Role:
The Sales Associate at Manipal Hospitals will focus on building and maintaining strong relationships with clients and stakeholders. This role is critical in promoting our healthcare services and driving patient engagement. The Sales Associate will collaborate closely with various teams to enhance service delivery and ensure customer satisfaction.

About the Team:
You will be part of a dynamic sales team dedicated to expanding Manipal Hospitals' reach in the healthcare market. The team comprises skilled professionals who are passionate about providing exceptional service and support to patients. Collaboration and a customer-centric approach are key values within the team.

You are Responsible for:
Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within the healthcare sector.
Achieving sales targets and contributing to the overall growth of Manipal Hospitals.
Building and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals, patients, and other stakeholders.
Conducting market research to understand customer needs and competitive landscape.
Participating in promotional events and activities to raise awareness about the services offered.

To succeed in this role – you should have the following:
A strong background in sales, preferably in the healthcare industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with clients.
Strong analytical skills to assess market trends and customer needs.
Proven ability to meet sales targets and work in a fast-paced environment.
A proactive and positive attitude, along with a passion for healthcare service.

A Builder- Car Advisor (Sales Associate) at Cars24 assists customers in buying and selling vehicles by providing expert guidance, evaluating car conditions, and ensuring a smooth and transparent transaction process.

What will you drive?
Customer Interaction: Greet and engage with customers, understanding their needs and preferences to recommend suitable pre-owned vehicles.
Sales Process: Manage the entire sales process from initial contact to closing the sale, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for customers.
Product Knowledge: Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the pre-owned car inventory, including features, pricing, and competitive comparisons.
Test Drives: Arrange and accompany customers on test drives, providing detailed explanations and answering any questions they may have.
Finance: Pitching Customer financing options, ensuring fair deals.
Documentation: Assist customers with the completion of sales contracts, financing applications, and other required documentation.
Follow-Up: Conduct follow-up calls with potential and previous customers to maintain relationships and encourage repeat business.
Customer Service: Address any customer concerns or issues promptly and professionally, striving to resolve them to the customer's satisfaction.
Team Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team and other departments to ensure a coordinated and efficient sales process.

Proven experience in automotive sales or a similar customer-facing role.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong negotiation and closing skills.
Ability to build rapport and trust with customers.
In-depth knowledge of pre-owned cars and the automotive market.
Valid driver's license and a clean driving record.

Why Join Us?
Drive key business initiatives and growth.
Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
Competitive compensation and career.

How to apply?

Fast-track your career to the next level by sending your resume to: deepanshi.1@cars24.com

Job Title: Field Sales Executive

We're looking for energetic and customer-focused Sales Executives to visit customers' homes, conduct eye tests, and sell Lenskart spectacles. As a Sales Executive, you'll:
Visit customers' homes based on scheduled appointments
Conduct eye tests using specialized equipment
Sell Lenskart spectacles and provide exceptional customer service
Carry a 18-20 kg bag with eye check equipment and eyewears
Meet sales targets and earn attractive commissions
Variable compensation based on sales performance


Training:
45-day comprehensive training in Whitefield, Bangalore on eye checkups and sales techniques


Requirements:
Graduate
Must own a bike (two-wheeler)
Fresher/Experienced
Excellent communication and interpersonal skill
Ability to lift and carry equipment (18 -20 kg)
Willingness to travel and work flexible hours
Must possess a valid driving license


What We Offer:
Opportunity to work with India's leading eyewear brand
Competitive compensation and incentives
Comprehensive training and support
Chance to make a difference in customers' lives through vision care

Description:
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their
respective base locations.
About the Team -
Swiggy Dineout is building Indias largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its
partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to
augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore
restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and
offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a
mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the
experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!
Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant
partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using
the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.
Role Summary -
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned
Responsibilities -
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with
internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is
correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for
month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc.
to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers
and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance
metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable
conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,
conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.



Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and
explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations
(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads
RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise
transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
Desired Skills -
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing
channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people
at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic
protected by the law."

Data & AI Strategy Portfolio Lead

Location: Bangalore, India
Work Arrangement: Remote with travel as and when to HQ

What We Do at Weir
We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably.
Our planet s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. That is why we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we are driving the shift to smarter, more efficient, and sustainable mining.

Make Your Impact
You ll play a key role in solving real-world challenges. Using your expertise, you will help deliver results that matter, whether through technology, planning, innovation, or collaboration. You ll work with purpose, learn continuously, and contribute to a more sustainable future.

What Youll Do
Portfolio Ownership & Roadmap Delivery: Own the enterprise Data & AI BAU portfolio and prioritisation cycles, maintaining a rolling roadmap aligned with enterprise objectives and S4+ programme constraints. Lead demand intake, triage, and prioritisation processes, ensuring transparent decision-making and preventing duplication or divergence from target data standards and architecture.
Delivery Accountability : Take accountability for Data, Analytics, and AI delivery outcomes. Establish outcome-focused governance, including objectives, acceptance criteria, and definitions of success. Monitor delivery performance, dependencies, and risks, escalating issues that may impact programme milestones or enterprise standards.
AI Enablement & Adoption: Lead the adoption of AI across BAU activities by managing an AI use-case pipeline supported by value hypotheses, adoption plans, and benefit tracking. Make pragmatic decisions on whether initiatives should continue, evolve, or stop based on measurable value, risk, sustainability, and alignment to the future-state vision.
Governance & Partner Management : Oversee Data & AI governance and external partner performance to ensure adherence to enterprise standards, governance requirements, and risk appetite. Balance business value delivery against the potential for technical debt and future rework.
Transformation Alignment & BAU Absorption: Maintain business-as-usual momentum throughout the S4+ transformation programme while preparing BAU teams to adopt and sustain the new data foundations post-go-live. Collaborate closely with programme leaders to align standards, controls, and operating practices.
Safety First: Demonstrate a commitment to Weir s zero-harm culture and actively support the development of world-class safety behaviours and practices.

What Youll Bring
Essential Experience
Proven experience leading and delivering Data, Analytics, or AI portfolios in a BAU environment.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across complex, matrixed organisations.
Deep expertise in portfolio prioritisation, roadmap management, and balancing value delivery against technical debt.
Comprehensive understanding of enterprise data platforms, analytics ecosystems, AI adoption approaches, and governance frameworks.

Desirable Experience.
Technical background in data architecture, software development, or transformation delivery.
Experience delivering Data & AI programmes within multinational organisations.
Experience supporting organisational change associated with automation and AI adoption.
Knowledge of portfolio management methodologies or value realisation frameworks.

Why Join Weir
At Weir, our values guide everything we do. We put safety first, do the right thing, respect one another, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate success together.
We are passionate about helping deliver the natural resources essential for building a better future. By combining deep customer insights, world-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation, we create innovative end-to-end solutions powered by our industry-leading technologies.
We believe every voice matters. We are committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels they belong and can do their best work. Through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives, you will have the opportunity to help shape our future culture.

Benefits
Competitive salary and rewards package.
Career development opportunities and ongoing learning support.
Access to global inclusion networks and communities.
Regional and team-specific benefits.
Sharebuilder scheme.
Health and wellness support for you and your family.
Opportunities to collaborate with global teams and experts.
Study assistance and professional development support.

Advises on proper food handling practices and provides food hygiene training for all new hires and trainees.
Identifies key areas of risk in various food operations and takes preemptive remedial action.
Provides technical advice on product labeling issues for fulfilling government requriements.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major.
Preferred:
Environmental Health Degree or Culinary Degree
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Hygience and Food Safety Operations
- Verifies compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA) requriements of Marriott International throughout the operations.
- Advises and monitors food handlers on the proper good handling practices and verifies their observance.
- Identifies key areas of risk in various food operations and takes preemptive remedial action.

- Provides technical advice on product labeling issues for fulfilling government requirements.
- Provides in-house food hygiene training for all good handlers, (eg new hires and trainees).
- Handles complaints or enquiries from customers and local food sategey and health departments on food hygiene matters.
- Conducts and records daily kitchen inspections on the personal, environmental and food hygiene condictions and provides corrective action plans as necessary.
- Conducts regular vendor inspections in partnership with purchasing and culinary leadership.
- Conducts regular internal BSA inspections with culinary leadership and kitchen cleaning staff.
- Conducts regular inspections on the kitchen of kitchen equipment and verifies defects and non-conformities are remedied by the appropriate parties.
- Coordinates cleaning program in all F&B areas (eg, General clean), identifying trends and making recommendation for improvements.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees.
- Liases with pest control company for any pest issues and monitors pest control performance.
- Maintains and makes improvements to hygiene standards.
- Regularly reviews and refreshes the food safety standards of all food handlers withing the property.
- Maintains documentation on all hygiene and food safety stadards throughout the operation.

n) Skill map / certifications of all FG quality professional

Additional knowledge of QMS, IMS, Change Management,  Six Sigma, Shanin, DOE will be preferred

Job Description: Sales & Marketing Executive (Fresher)
Company Name: Sojatia Jewellers
Department: Sales & Marketing
Job Type: Full-Time
Experience: Fresher
Industry: Jewellery / Retail
Job Location: As per showroom location
Job Overview
Sojatia Jewellers is looking for enthusiastic, confident, and customer-oriented freshers to join its Sales & Marketing team. The selected candidates will be responsible for assisting customers, promoting jewellery products, supporting showroom sales, and ensuring an excellent customer experience. This is a great opportunity for freshers who want to build their careers in retail sales, customer service, and marketing.
Key Responsibilities
Welcome customers to the showroom and understand their jewellery requirements, preferences, and budget.
Explain the features, designs, quality, and pricing of gold, silver, diamond, and other jewellery products, as applicable.
Assist customers in selecting suitable jewellery for weddings, festivals, gifting, and other occasions.
Support the sales process by explaining product options, handling customer queries, and helping convert enquiries into sales.
Build and maintain positive relationships with customers to encourage repeat visits and referrals.
Follow up with prospective customers regarding their enquiries, product preferences, and purchase decisions.
Support promotional activities, festive campaigns, and showroom marketing initiatives.
Assist in maintaining customer records and updating sales enquiries in the company's system, where applicable.
Coordinate with the showroom team to ensure proper product display, presentation, and availability.
Stay updated on jewellery designs, trends, new collections, and ongoing offers.
Maintain professional behaviour and ensure a welcoming, organised, and customer-friendly showroom environment.
Work towards achieving individual and team sales targets.
Eligibility Criteria
Freshers are welcome to apply.
Candidates with a graduation degree or an undergraduate qualification may apply, as per company requirements.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and a customer-first approach.
Basic computer knowledge is preferred.
Interest in sales, marketing, retail, and the jewellery industry.
Candidates with prior retail or customer-handling experience may also apply.
Required Skills
Customer handling and relationship management
Verbal communication and convincing skills
Sales negotiation and product presentation
Basic marketing and promotional skills
Teamwork and coordination
Learning ability and adaptability
Professional grooming and a positive attitude
Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be energetic, presentable, polite, and confident while interacting with customers. Candidates who enjoy meeting new people, understanding customer needs, and working in a target-oriented environment will be preferred.
Career Opportunity
This role offers freshers an opportunity to gain practical experience in jewellery retail, customer relationship management, sales techniques, and showroom marketing, with scope for professional growth based on performance.

Description:
Job Description

Any Graduate
Proven experience (1-3 years) in providing IT support, preferably in a warehouse or logistics setting.
Strong knowledge of computer hardware, operating systems, and software applications, Basic network systems.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Customer-focused with outstanding communication and interpersonal abilities.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Detail-oriented and well-organized.
Willingness to work in shifts or extended hours, if required.

1. Help Desk Support:
- Act as the first point of contact for warehouse staff seeking technical assistance, both in person and remotely.
- Provide prompt and efficient resolution of hardware, software, and network-related issues.
2. Troubleshooting and Problem Resolution:
- Diagnose and resolve technical issues reported by warehouse personnel related to computers, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment.
- Escalate complex problems to the IT team or vendors when necessary and follow up to ensure timely resolution.
3. Inventory Management:
- Maintain an accurate inventory of IT hardware, software licenses, and related equipment used in the warehouse.
- Assist in the procurement and deployment of new IT assets as needed.
4. Data Security and Backup:
- Ensure data security measures are followed, including regular backups of critical systems and data.
- Assist in implementing security protocols to protect sensitive information.
5. User Training and Documentation:
- Conduct training sessions for warehouse personnel on IT procedures, best practices, and software usage.
- Maintain documentation for IT processes, troubleshooting guides, and user manuals.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Summary
As a Customer Service Associate at Marks and Spencer, your main role is to assist customers, maintain store standards, and learn the basics of store operations.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Manager Finance Accounts
Company: JSW JFE Electrical Steel Private Limited
Division: Joint Venture between JSW Steel and JFE
Location: Vijayanagar
Reporting To: CFO / GM Finance Accounts
Position Status: New Position
Number of Positions: 1
Hiring Priority: Urgent / Immediate


1. Purpose of the Role
The Senior Manager Finance Accounts will oversee day-to-day Finance Accounts operations, financial reporting, Management Information Systems (MIS), statutory and internal audits, and compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements. The role will ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Schedule III, strengthen internal financial controls, and support management decision-making through financial analysis and reporting.
The position will also coordinate with the JV partner, JFE, and internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective financial governance, audit readiness, budgetary control, and timely submission of financial information.


2. Key Result Areas and Responsibilities
KRA 1: Financial Reporting, Accounting and MIS
Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing and reporting activities.
Prepare and review financial statements in accordance with Ind AS and Schedule III requirements.
Ensure timely preparation of MIS reports, financial analysis, and management reporting.
Coordinate with JFE and relevant internal stakeholders for financial information, reporting, and reconciliation.
Support impairment testing, financial modelling, and Annual Business Plan (ABP) preparation.
Prepare and submit standalone and consolidated financial statements to JSW Steel for consolidation, as applicable.
KRA 2: Statutory Audits, Internal Audits and Compliance
Coordinate statutory, quarterly, internal, tax, and other applicable audits.
Facilitate the timely completion of audits by reviewing supporting documentation and responding to auditor queries.
Monitor Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR) and support the strengthening of internal controls.
Ensure timely submission of audited financial results and other required financial information.
Coordinate with tax, legal, secretarial, and other relevant teams to ensure compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.
KRA 3: Budgetary Control and Financial Planning
Monitor and control capital expenditure (Capex) against approved budgets.
Analyse budget variances and provide insights to management for corrective action.
Support the preparation and review of the Annual Business Plan (ABP) and financial models.
Track project-related expenditure and support financial monitoring of the Greenfield manufacturing facility.
Contribute to the implementation and optimisation of SAP and related financial processes.
KRA 4: Corporate Governance, Board Reporting and JV Coordination
Prepare related-party transaction (RPT) information, results-page inputs, and financial data required for Board meetings.
Coordinate with the Secretarial and Legal teams for Board agenda items, minutes, disclosures, and applicable compliance requirements.
Ensure timely sharing of financial reports and information with JSW Steel and JFE.
Support corporate governance requirements and address finance-related legal and regulatory matters, wherever applicable.


3. Reporting Structure and Key Interfaces
Reports to: CFO / GM Finance Accounts
Peer Positions:
Manager Treasury
Manager FPA / Controlling
Manager Tax
Positions Reporting to the Role:
Executive / Manager Finance Accounts


4. Educational Qualifications and Experience
Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost Accountant (ICWA/CMA).
1015 years of relevant post-qualification or professional experience in Finance Accounts, financial reporting, audit, and compliance.
Strong knowledge of Ind AS, Schedule III, statutory and internal audits, financial controls, and regulatory reporting.
Experience in budgetary control, financial modelling, MIS, and capital expenditure monitoring.
Working knowledge of SAP and financial reporting systems is preferred.
Experience in a manufacturing organisation or a joint venture environment would be an advantage.


5. Key Competencies
Strong functional knowledge of Finance Accounts.
Analytical thinking and financial problem-solving.
Financial reporting and audit management.
Planning, budgeting, and cost control.
Stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination.
Team management and collaboration.
Effective written and verbal communication.
Attention to detail, integrity, and a strong governance orientation.


6. Key Stakeholders
Internal:
Corporate Finance Accounts team
Plant and Project teams
Tax team
IT team
Secretarial and Legal teams
JV partner representatives
External:
Statutory and internal auditors
Tax authorities
Other relevant regulatory and professional stakeholders


7. Key Success Factors
Timely and accurate preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
Completion of statutory, internal, and tax audits within prescribed timelines.
Compliance with Ind AS, Schedule III, and applicable direct and indirect tax laws.
Effective monitoring of Capex budgets and financial plans.
Accurate and timely submission of financial information to JSW Steel and JFE.
Strong internal financial controls and audit readiness.
Timely preparation of Board-related financial information and RPT disclosures.
Successful support for SAP implementation and process improvements.


8. Business Context
JSW JFE Electrical Steel Private Limited (J2ES-V) is a joint venture between JSW Steel and JFE to establish a Greenfield Cold Rolled Grain Oriented (CRGO) electrical steel manufacturing facility at Vijayanagar, with a proposed annual capacity of 100,000 MT and an estimated project cost of 7,102 crore.
The Senior Manager Finance Accounts will play a critical role in establishing robust financial reporting, governance, compliance, and control processes to support the company's project execution and operational requirements.

Description:
DBS Bank India Limited
DBS Bank has been present in India for 30 years, opening its first office in Mumbai in 1994. DBS Bank India Limited is the first among the large foreign banks in India to start operating as a wholly owned, locally incorporated subsidiary of a leading global bank. As a trusted partner, DBS provides a range of banking services for large, medium, and small enterprises and individual consumers in India, focusing on a seamless customer experience that helps them Live more, Bank less’. In November 2020, Lakshmi Vilas Bank was merged with DBS Bank India Limited. DBS Bank India is now present in ~350 locations in 19 Indian states.
Position Title

Branch Relationship Manager - Growth

Department

CBG - NDS
Rank

Officer/Senior Officer/Analyst

Reports To

Branch Manager
Job Purpose

To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance with a primary focus on acquiring new-to-bank (NTB) DBS clients having an AUM INR 1 million through a “need-based approach,” while also engaging and growing existing clients.
To drive sustained acquisition momentum through active sourcing, local market penetration, and network building, and ensure client coverage and product penetration via cross-sell and up-sell of DBS products and services.
To manage & maintain the highest customer satisfaction and service levels through proactive client engagement & relationship management, coordinating internally with DBS Service, Distribution, and Product teams.
Key Accountabilities

Primary ownership of NTB acquisition: Consistently acquire and upgrade quality clients in the branch catchment with a strong focus on sourcing new affluent clients into the Treasures segment.
Build and execute a robust acquisition pipeline through self-sourcing, referrals, branch walk-ins, local area prospecting, corporate and community engagement.
Engage with existing customers to deepen the wallet share through retention and growth of AUM.
Accountable for achieving monthly & annual volume and revenue objective, as agreed.
Ensure activation of e-Channels (I-Banking / M-Banking/ Online MF/Debit Card) and Savings Book growth for both newly acquired and existing clients.
Ensure proper implementation & execution of product strategies through effective relationship management.
Develop the client trust and loyalty for entrenched relationship with DBS through lifestyle and beyond banking propositions
Ensure optimum product mix and new- to- product clients aimed at customer level profitability and enhancing client coverage.
Drive and deliver exemplary customer service in the local market and uphold DBS service standards.
Ensure internal and regulatory compliance through strict adherence to DBS sales process, timely risk reviews and exercising due diligence while on-boarding.
Ensure exemplary service delivery of these clients by building appropriate workflows and processes incl. doorstep banking etc.
Establish DBS as the primary banker for newly acquired clients and strengthen its position as a prominent banking provider through consistent acquisition and superior service delivery.
Job Duties & responsibilities

Establish, manage and grow the AUM of mapped Client segment by acquiring and nurturing the client having AUM => INR 1 M
Ensure complete knowledge of all products & services through continuous skill and knowledge improvement.
Resolve customer queries and complaints within the agreed TAT as per the DBS customer service policy.
Coordinate and work closely with CBG colleagues, Service teams, Product specialist to ensure that team objectives are met through an environment that nurtures harmony and collaboration through teamwork
Work closely with the Line Manager and City / Cluster Head to ensure achievement of common team and Branch objectives.
Ensure internal and regulatory compliance and address operational risks if any, e.g. Health & Safety standards, security of premises, AML / KYC and ongoing risk reviews.
To exercise appropriate due diligence while on-boarding and engaging with clients.
Establish DBS as a primary banker for clients and as a prominent banking provider in India.
Required Experience

Minimum 2 years of experience in a reputed bank and proficient in banking products.
Education / Preferred Qualifications

Preferably MBA (not mandatory)
Mandatory - Graduate (10+2+3 years of education)
AMFI / IRDAI / FEDAI certified candidates with BCSBI certification would be an added advantage
Core Competencies

Strong Relationship Management and influencing skills
Strong service orientation, customer-centric behavior
Effective probing and listening skills.
Self-driven and ambitious.
Good written and verbal communication skills
Results-orientated & the ability to deliver results under pressure
In-depth knowledge of local market and competition.
Understanding of competitive positioning
Focused on developing image and goodwill of the brand
Creative, inquisitive mind with problem solving abilities
Ability to deliver results within tight timelines
Attention to details, analyzing abilities
Technical Competencies

Understanding of HNI Sales/ wealth management product suite, platforms and operational procedures
Understanding of banking and para-banking guidelines issued by RBI (local regulations in India) and local laws and regulations that impact businesses in general.
Understanding of KYC requirements & Anti-money Laundering Policies.
Knowledge of financial markets and products to assist in meaningful engagement with client
Work Relationship

Management of clients and prospects for acquisition and deepening of wallet share
Close interaction with Branch Manager, BOSH, CSO, CH, RH, Treasures RM’s and Treasures Elite Team Leader
Operations team to ensure consistent delivery of volume and revenue targets.
Close and regular interaction with Branch Product specialists for effective skill / knowledge
Development of self and explore potential in existing books through joint engagement with clients
DBS India - Culture & Behaviors

Performance through Value Based Propositions
Ensure customer focus by delighting customers & reducing complaints
Build pride and passion to protect, maintain and enhance DBS’ image and reputation
Enhance knowledge base, build skill sets & develop competencies
Execute at speed while maintaining error free operations
Maintain the highest standards of honesty and integrity

n) Skill map / certifications of all factory quality professional

Job Title: Quantity Surveyor (EPC Projects)
Role Summary
The Quantity Surveyor is responsible for managing all cost-related aspects of EPC projects, from estimation and budgeting to contract administration and cost control. The role ensures that projects are completed within the approved budget while maintaining compliance with contractual and commercial requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Cost Estimation & Budgeting
Prepare detailed cost estimates and BOQs (Bill of Quantities) based on drawings and specifications.
Support project budgeting and validate cost assumptions.
Conduct rate analysis for materials, labor, and equipment.
2. Quantity Take-offs & Measurement
Perform accurate quantity take-offs from drawings.
Verify quantities executed at site and certify measurements.
Maintain measurement records and reconciliation with BOQ.
3. Cost Control & Monitoring
Track project costs vs. budget and analyze variances.
Provide regular updates on cost performance and highlight risks.
Assist in implementing cost control measures to prevent overruns.
4. Contract & Commercial Management
Review and administer contracts, subcontracts, and purchase orders.
Ensure compliance with contractual terms and conditions.
Manage variations, change orders, and claims (both client and subcontractor).
5. Billing & Payment Certification
Prepare and verify client invoices (RA bills) based on work progress.
Assess and certify subcontractor/vendor bills.
Ensure alignment of billing with contractual milestones and site progress.
6. Procurement Support
Assist procurement team with tender evaluation and vendor selection.
Provide cost inputs and benchmarking for procurement decisions.
7. Cash Flow & Financial Coordination
Support project cash flow planning by tracking inflows and outflows.
Coordinate with finance for invoicing, payments, and financial reporting.
8. Reporting & Documentation
Prepare periodic reports including:
Cost reports
Quantity reconciliation statements
Variation and claims status
Maintain proper documentation for audits and contractual compliance.
9. Stakeholder Coordination
Work closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Finance, and Procurement teams.
Act as a key commercial interface between site and corporate teams.
Key Skills & Competencies
Strong knowledge of quantity surveying principles and BOQ preparation
Expertise in cost estimation, rate analysis, and contract management
Familiarity with EPC contracts (FIDIC or similar frameworks)
Proficiency in Excel, ERP systems, and estimation software
Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
Attention to detail and commercial acumen
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor s degree in Civil Engineering / Quantity Surveying / Construction Management
5-10 years of experience in EPC, infrastructure, or construction projects

Description:
Job Title: Quantity Surveyor (EPC Projects)
Role Summary
The Quantity Surveyor is responsible for managing all cost-related aspects of EPC projects, from estimation and budgeting to contract administration and cost control. The role ensures that projects are completed within the approved budget while maintaining compliance with contractual and commercial requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Cost Estimation & Budgeting
Prepare detailed cost estimates and BOQs (Bill of Quantities) based on drawings and specifications.
Support project budgeting and validate cost assumptions.
Conduct rate analysis for materials, labor, and equipment.
2. Quantity Take-offs & Measurement
Perform accurate quantity take-offs from drawings.
Verify quantities executed at site and certify measurements.
Maintain measurement records and reconciliation with BOQ.
3. Cost Control & Monitoring
Track project costs vs. budget and analyze variances.
Provide regular updates on cost performance and highlight risks.
Assist in implementing cost control measures to prevent overruns.
4. Contract & Commercial Management
Review and administer contracts, subcontracts, and purchase orders.
Ensure compliance with contractual terms and conditions.
Manage variations, change orders, and claims (both client and subcontractor).
5. Billing & Payment Certification
Prepare and verify client invoices (RA bills) based on work progress.
Assess and certify subcontractor/vendor bills.
Ensure alignment of billing with contractual milestones and site progress.
6. Procurement Support
Assist procurement team with tender evaluation and vendor selection.
Provide cost inputs and benchmarking for procurement decisions.
7. Cash Flow & Financial Coordination
Support project cash flow planning by tracking inflows and outflows.
Coordinate with finance for invoicing, payments, and financial reporting.
8. Reporting & Documentation
Prepare periodic reports including:
Cost reports
Quantity reconciliation statements
Variation and claims status
Maintain proper documentation for audits and contractual compliance.
9. Stakeholder Coordination
Work closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Finance, and Procurement teams.
Act as a key commercial interface between site and corporate teams.
Key Skills & Competencies
Strong knowledge of quantity surveying principles and BOQ preparation
Expertise in cost estimation, rate analysis, and contract management
Familiarity with EPC contracts (FIDIC or similar frameworks)
Proficiency in Excel, ERP systems, and estimation software
Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills

Role Summary
The Quantity Surveyor is responsible for managing all cost-related aspects of EPC projects, from estimation and budgeting to contract administration and cost control. The role ensures that projects are completed within the approved budget while maintaining compliance with contractual and commercial requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Cost Estimation & Budgeting
Prepare detailed cost estimates and BOQs (Bill of Quantities) based on drawings and specifications.
Support project budgeting and validate cost assumptions.
Conduct rate analysis for materials, labor, and equipment.
2. Quantity Take-offs & Measurement
Perform accurate quantity take-offs from drawings.
Verify quantities executed at site and certify measurements.
Maintain measurement records and reconciliation with BOQ.
3. Cost Control & Monitoring
Track project costs vs. budget and analyze variances.
Provide regular updates on cost performance and highlight risks.
Assist in implementing cost control measures to prevent overruns.
4. Contract & Commercial Management
Review and administer contracts, subcontracts, and purchase orders.
Ensure compliance with contractual terms and conditions.
Manage variations, change orders, and claims (both client and subcontractor).
5. Billing & Payment Certification
Prepare and verify client invoices (RA bills) based on work progress.
Assess and certify subcontractor/vendor bills.
Ensure alignment of billing with contractual milestones and site progress.
6. Procurement Support
Assist procurement team with tender evaluation and vendor selection.
Provide cost inputs and benchmarking for procurement decisions.
7. Cash Flow & Financial Coordination
Support project cash flow planning by tracking inflows and outflows.
Coordinate with finance for invoicing, payments, and financial reporting.
8. Reporting & Documentation
Prepare periodic reports including:
Cost reports
Quantity reconciliation statements
Variation and claims status
Maintain proper documentation for audits and contractual compliance.
9. Stakeholder Coordination
Work closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Finance, and Procurement teams.
Act as a key commercial interface between site and corporate teams.

Description:
Job description
Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive Operations
Location: Multiple Locations Andhra Pradesh & Telangana
Department: Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and customer-focused Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive and Manager to join our Operations team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurate gold appraisal, processing gold loan applications, maintaining branch records, and delivering excellent customer service while ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Evaluate and appraise gold ornaments using standard valuation methods and approved equipment.

2. Verify the purity, weight, and quality of pledged gold.

3. Process gold loan applications and complete all operational formalities.

4. Verify customer KYC and loan documentation.

5. Maintain loan files, operational registers, and branch records accurately.

6. Handle documentation, books of accounts, and operational records.

7. Ensure safe custody of pledged gold and related documents.

8. Follow up with customers for loan renewals, repayments, and closures.

9. Provide prompt and professional customer service.

10. Ensure compliance with company policies, audit standards, and regulatory guidelines.

11. Support daily branch operations and maintain operational efficiency.

Eligibility:
1. Any Graduate
2. Knowledge of gold appraisal or willingness to learn.
3. Good communication and customer handling skills.
4. Basic computer knowledge.
5. Attention to detail and strong ethical standards.

Preferred Skills:
1. Gold valuation and appraisal.
2. Gold loan operations.
3. Documentation and record management.
4. Customer relationship management.
5. KYC verification.
6. Operational compliance.
7. Communication and interpersonal skills.
8. MS Office and basic computer operations.

Salary: Best in the Industry + Performance Incentives.
AboutCompany: Keertana is a fast growing Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC) operating in JLG , Gold & MSME Loans Lending. As part of the business activities, the company is predominantly focused into Asset Financing and Lending business.

# Job Description (JD) CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator
### Stainless Steel Fabrication / Sheet Metal Manufacturing Industry

**Job Title:** CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator
**Department:** Engineering, Fabrication & Operations
**Location:** [Location]
**Reporting To:** Operations Manager / Production Manager

---

## Job Summary

The CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator is responsible for developing CNC programs for laser cutting, punching, and bending machines while coordinating daily production activities across design, stores, fabrication, machining, and dispatch departments. The role ensures efficient machine utilization, material optimization, production scheduling, and on-time project execution.

---

## Key Responsibilities

### CNC Programming

- Create CNC programs for Laser Cutting, CNC Punching, and CNC Press Brake machines.
- Prepare nesting layouts to maximize sheet utilization and reduce scrap.
- Generate machine programs from CAD drawings and engineering designs.
- Optimize cutting paths and machine cycle times.
- Verify programs before production release.
- Maintain CNC program libraries and revision records.
- Support operators during program setup and troubleshooting.

### Technical & Engineering Support

- Interpret fabrication drawings, CAD files, and customer specifications.
- Coordinate with design engineers to resolve technical issues.
- Prepare production drawings and job files.
- Ensure manufacturability of designs before production release.
- Support design modifications and engineering changes.

### Operations Coordination

- Coordinate daily production schedules with fabrication and machining teams.
- Monitor work orders and production progress.
- Ensure timely availability of materials, tools, and programs.
- Coordinate between Stores, Production, Quality, and Dispatch.
- Track and expedite priority jobs to meet delivery commitments.
- Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.

### Production Planning & Monitoring

- Prepare daily and weekly production plans.
- Track machine loading and capacity utilization.
- Monitor production output against targets.
- Generate production status reports for management.
- Ensure adherence to delivery schedules.

### Material Optimization

- Optimize sheet utilization through efficient nesting.
- Minimize raw material wastage and scrap generation.
- Review cutting plans for cost effectiveness.
- Coordinate material requirements with stores and purchase departments.

### Quality Control Support

- Ensure programmed dimensions conform to approved drawings.
- Support first article inspection (FAI).
- Assist in resolving dimensional and fabrication issues.
- Coordinate corrective actions for production non-conformities.

### ERP & Documentation

- Update production data in ERP systems.
- Maintain CNC program records and revision control.
- Generate production reports and machine utilization reports.
- Maintain job tracking sheets and production schedules.

### Safety & Compliance

- Follow company safety procedures and machine operating standards.
- Support implementation of 5S and lean manufacturing initiatives.
- Ensure compliance with quality management systems and SOPs.

---

## Educational Qualification

- Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or Industrial Engineering.
- Certification in CNC Programming, CAD/CAM, or Nesting Software preferred.

---

## Experience

### Junior CNC Programmer
- 2-4 years experience

### CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator
- 4-8 years experience in sheet metal fabrication and CNC programming

### Preferred Industry Experience
- Stainless Steel Fabrication
- Sheet Metal Manufacturing
- Electrical Enclosure Manufacturing
- Pharma Equipment Manufacturing
- Food Processing Equipment Manufacturing
- Industrial Fabrication

---

## Technical Skills

### Software
- AutoCAD
- SolidWorks
- SigmaNEST
- TruTops
- Metalix
- RADAN
- NC Express
- ERP Software
- Microsoft Excel

### Machinery
- Laser Cutting Machines
- CNC Punching Machines
- CNC Press Brake Machines
- Bending Tools & Die Selection

### Technical Knowledge
- Sheet Metal Manufacturing
- Nesting Optimization
- Fabrication Drawings
- Production Planning
- Material Requirement Planning (MRP)
- Quality Control Processes

---

## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

| KPI | Target |
|------|---------|
| Production Schedule Adherence | 95% |
| Sheet Utilization Efficiency | 95% |
| CNC Program Accuracy | 98% |
| On-Time Job Release | 95% |
| Machine Utilization | 85% |
| Rework Due to Programming Errors | 1% |
| Delivery Schedule Compliance | 95% |
| ERP/Data Accuracy | 99% |

---

## Key Deliverables

- Error-free CNC programs.
- Maximum sheet utilization and reduced scrap.
- Timely release of jobs to production.
- Smooth coordination between departments.
- High machine productivity and on-time delivery.
- Accurate production tracking and reporting.

## Career Progression

**CNC Operator CNC Programmer CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator Team Lead Operations Operations Manager Plant Manager**

Description:
Serves as the property Manager on Duty and oversees all property operations, ensuring that the highest levels of hospitality and service are provided.
Represents property management in resolving any guest or property related situation.
Manages the flow of questions and directs guests within the lobby.
Serves as Guest Relations Manager and handles the tracking of service issues.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Property Operations and Guest Relations Needs
- Maintains a strong working relationship with all departments to support property operations and goals and to expedite the resolution of any problems that may arise through the general operation of the property.
- Communicates any variations to the established norms to the appropriate department in a timely manner.
- Sends copy of MOD report to all departments on a daily basis.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Supporting Profitability Goals
- Understands and complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Reviews ficial statements, sales and activity reports, and other performance data to measure productivity and goal achievement and to determine areas needing cost reduction and program improvement.
Managing the Guest Experience
- Intervenes in any guest/employee situation as needed to insure the integrity of the property is maintained, guest satisfaction is achieved, and employee well being is preserved.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Provides immediate assistance to guests as requested.
- Serves as a leader in displaying outstanding hospitality skills.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with customers on a regular basis throughout the property to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans to improve guest satisfaction.
- Records guest issues in the guest response tracking system.
Assisting Human Resources Activities
- Participates as needed in the investigation of employee and guest accidents.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and providing feedback to individuals.
- Conducts regular inspection tours of the entire facility for appearance, safety, staffing, security, and maintece.
- Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.
- Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successfully daily operations.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPS) and support the Peer Review Process.
- Understands and, if necessary, implements all emergency plans including accident, death, elevator, thefts, vicious crimes, bombs, fire, etc

Description:
Manages all engineering/maintece operations, including maintaining the building, grounds and physical plant with particular attention towards safety, security and asset protection.
Accountable for managing the budget, capital expenditure projects, preventative maintece and energy conservation.
Responsible for maintaining regulatory requirements.
Assists in leading the emergency response team for all facility issues.
Helps to increase guest and employee satisfaction through effective communications and training.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the engineering and maintece or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Building and Construction, Engineering, Mechanics, or related major; 2 years experience in the engineering and maintece or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Engineering Operations and Budgets
- Manages the physical plant including equipment, refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment and electrical systems.
- Ensures regulatory compliance to facility regulations and safety standards.
- Manages and controls heat, light and power and recommends current best methods for energy conservation and economical facility operations.
- Develops specifications and requirements for service contracts and administers such contracts to support building needs.
- Distributes preventive maintece and repair work orders and monitors timeliness and quality of completion.
- Oversees and directs the maintece of grounds, guestrooms, public space, restaurants, property vehicles and recreational facilities.
- Develops a long term plan for preventative maintece and asset protection and overseeing execution of plan.
- Develops project plans in accordance with renovation or new construction needs.
- Contacts contractors for bids and supervising construction to ensure timely completion of projects within budgetary guidelines.
- Builds positive relationships with external customers such as city building/zoning department, fire prevention bureau and vendors.
- Ensures fire crew has complete understanding of all procedures, equipment and alarms.
- Performs monthly property inspection to ensure buildings and grounds are maintained in excellent condition.
- Conducts guest room and common area inspection to ensure guest satisfaction.
- Inspects and evaluates the physical condition of facilities in order to determine the type of work required.
- Recommends or arranges for additional services such as painting, repair work, renovations, and the replacement of furnishings and equipment.
- Selects and orders or purchasing new equipment, supplies, and furnishings.
- Manages parts and equipment inventory.
Maintaining Property Standards
- Ensures building and equipment licenses and certifications are current.
- Maintains property life safety systems (fire fighting equipment, sprinkler systems and alarm systems).
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifying excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Shares plans with property leadership and ensuring corrective action is taken to continuously improve guest satisfaction.
- Strives to improve service performance.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Helps train employees in safety procedures.
- Assists in training other department employees in fire protection, safety and evacuation procedures.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Assists in performing operational activities as necessary.

We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Managed Services Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EYs global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
Key Requirements
As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on implementation experience (desirable)
Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines

Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software such as Prophet / Axis / MG Alpha. Advanced level experience in one of these softwares will be valuable
Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
Good experience of preparing PPT decks
In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
iduals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
Skills and attributes for success
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have
Good actuarial exam progress
Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

The role focuses on end-to-end report production, data validation, reconciliations, controls, issue management, and regulatory change across U.S. and global reporting obligations. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, onshore teams, technology teams, and operations stakeholders to strengthen reporting accuracy, improve governance, support automation, and build scalable processes aligned with evolving products, entities, and regulatory requirements.
Your Key Responsibilities
Regulatory Production & Submissions: Lead regulatory reporting workstreams, including end-to-end preparation, review, and timely submission of U.S. and global filings such as MTL reporting, transaction reporting, financial condition reporting, and capital calculations.
Broader Banking Regulatory Reporting Exposure: Apply relevant exposure to banking regulatory returns, including capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, ICAAP reporting, balance sheet reporting, and regulatory disclosures, where applicable to the clients operating model.
Regulatory Change, Awareness & Reporting Logic: Monitor relevant regulatory developments, interpret reporting instructions, assess data and process impacts, and coordinate timely updates to reporting logic, templates, procedures, controls, and technology workflows.
Data Sourcing & Analytical Reviews: Perform complex data extraction, validation, variance analysis, and root-cause exception investigations across large datasets to ensure data completeness and integrity.
Control Governance & Audit Readiness: Embed rigorous quality controlsincluding maker-checker reviews, clear audit trails, evidence retention, and sign-off protocols—across all reporting cycles.
Automation & Process Improvement: Identify reporting process inefficiencies and support automation initiatives using tools such as SQL, Python, and modern data platforms to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
Analytics & Responsible AI Awareness: Apply awareness of responsible AI and analytics use cases to support anomaly detection, exception analysis, reporting commentary, and workflow monitoring.
Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment: Provide technical coaching and review support to junior team members while coordinating seamlessly across cross-functional partners and U.S.-based stakeholders.
Time-Zone Flexibility: Willingness to operate during late/extended hours to ensure seamless hand-offs with U.S.-based stakeholders and meet strict global submission deadlines.
Al fluency - Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, you’ll also have
4–6 years of relevant experience, including 2–6 years in a senior role within regulatory reporting or financial services.
Hands-on experience with U.S. regulatory filings, financial condition reporting, customer liability reporting, permissible investments, transaction reporting, and Money Transmitter License (MTL) submissions.
Hands-on experience in FFIEC 031 , FRY 9C , FRY 15 , FFIEC 041/051 , FR 2062a , Basel & Liquidity reporting , COREP/FINREP , Money Transmission reporting .
Master’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field is preferred; CA, CPA, CFA, MBA, or an equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
Strong end-to-end understanding of regulatory reporting production cycles, data validation, reconciliations, variance analysis, workpaper preparation, and review controls.
Solid working knowledge of financial statement analysis, regulatory capital concepts, ICAAP reporting, and applicable regulatory compliance frameworks.
Exposure to banking regulatory reporting frameworks, including capital adequacy, ICAAP reporting, liquidity risk reporting, balance sheet schedules, and regulatory disclosures, would be beneficial.
Proven ability to translate complex regulatory mandates into business requirements.
Knowledge of reporting platforms and data tools, along with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, Snowflake, or Looker, would be an added advantage.
Awareness of Generative AI tools and workflow automation to support data extraction, exception analysis, and reporting efficiency would be an advantage.
Strong control mindset, including practical experience with maker-checker reviews, robust audit trails, evidence retention, issue management, and key risk/control testing.
Advanced data analytics skills, with the ability to query large datasets, perform root-cause analysis on exceptions, and communicate structured findings clearly.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of effectively managing relationships across onshore/offshore teams, product managers, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating strong ownership, continuous improvement, and agility in adapting to evolving regulatory landscapes.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is required. U.S. visa readiness or international travel willingness is preferred but not mandatory.

Client Advisor Job Description
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBroker’s plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.

- Navigating complex situations to build meaningful client relationships and deliver quality outcomes

 tasks diligently
 Knowledge of basic accounting and book-keeping,
