Description:
Job Summary
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance - Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
We re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, you ll also have
Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
The role involves converting 3D CAD models and engineering data into high-quality 2D illustrations, exploded views, assembly illustrations, installation/removal procedures, and procedural graphics.

The illustrations must comply with applicable technical documentation standards and support the development of Interactive Electronic Technical Publications (IETP), Repair Parts and Illustrations List (RPIL), Illustrated Parts Data (IPD), and Component Maintenance Publications (CMP).

Qualifications and Experience
B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or an equivalent discipline.
3-5 years of relevant experience in technical illustration and engineering documentation.
Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, CATIA, or equivalent tools.
Strong understanding of technical drawing and documentation standards, including ATA iSpec 2200 and S1000D.
Proven experience in creating technical illustrations compliant with S1000D standards.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent technical illustration tools.
Experience in Illustration Content Number (ICN) management and associated technical publication workflows.
Experience with RPIL, Repair Parts Support (RPS) development, and IPD illustrations is highly advantageous.
Familiarity with IETP standards and Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) deliverables is highly desirable.
Experience working with engineering databases and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools such as Teamcenter, SAP, Agile PLM, Windchill, or 3D Via.
Proficiency in workflow and work-tracking tools such as JIRA.

Key Responsibilities
Create accurate 2D technical illustrations from 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, and technical references.
Develop detailed illustrations, including exploded views, assembly views, section views, detail views, and installation/removal procedures.
Produce procedural graphics and illustrations for technical manuals, maintenance manuals, service manuals, assembly instructions, and parts documentation.
Develop illustrations for IETP, RPIL, IPD, and CMP deliverables.
Use Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent software to create high-quality, vector-based technical illustrations.
Interpret CATIA 3D models to understand product structures, components, assemblies, and engineering designs.
Ensure accuracy in geometry, orientation, proportions, and component relationships.
Apply appropriate line weights, colour shading, hatching, callouts, symbols, arrows, and graphical conventions in accordance with applicable standards.
Analyse complex engineering data, including drawings, specifications, CAD models, bills of materials (BOMs), schematics, wiring diagrams, and Service Bulletins, to develop technically accurate illustrations.
Collaborate with engineers, technical authors, designers, subject-matter experts, and the wider Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) team to clarify technical information and validate content.

Job Summary Consultant-Oracle with HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional), HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional), and HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) experience, responsible for delivering functional solutions and support across Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor and related workforce scheduling processes.
Candidate must have relevant experience of 5 to 9 Years.

Qualifications and Skills
Relevant degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, HR, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Hands-on functional experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional).
Practical experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional), including writing, testing, and troubleshooting formulas.- Functional experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) or similar workforce scheduling tools.
Familiarity with end-to-end HCM processes, including core HR, absence, and payroll interactions with Time and Labor.
Ability to document requirements, configurations, and test scenarios clearly and concisely.
Strong analytical skills and ability to translate business requirements into Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud configurations.

Key Responsibilities
Work as a functional Consultant-Oracle for HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional), ensuring accurate time capture, approvals, and integrations with payroll and absence management.
Configure, validate, and optimize HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional) to support complex business rules, calculations, and eligibility criteria across HCM modules.
Implement and support HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) to manage workforce scheduling, shift planning, and resource allocation.- Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, map them to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud capabilities, and design functional solutions for Time and Labor and workforce scheduling.
Perform end-to-end functional testing for OTL, Fast Formula, and Mastek EWS configurations, including regression testing for new releases and patches.
Support production incidents and service requests related to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor, Fast Formula, and workforce scheduling, ensuring timely resolution and root cause analysis.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, and user guides for Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud modules in scope.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions for HR, payroll, and operations teams on OTL, Fast Formula, and Mastek EWS functionalities.
Coordinate with technical teams for integrations, reports, and extensions related to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor and scheduling solutions.
Ensure adherence to best practices, governance, and compliance requirements in all Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud configurations and deployments.

Other Capabilities
Strong understanding of Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor processes, including time entry, approval workflows, and time valuation rules.
Ability to interpret and design complex Fast Formulas to support business-specific rules and calculations.
Experience working with workforce scheduling concepts such as shifts, rosters, rotation patterns, and resource optimization in Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler).- Good stakeholder management and communication skills to work with HR, payroll, operations, and IT teams.
Capability to work in a consulting environment, managing multiple assignments and priorities with minimal supervision.
Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail in configuration and testing activities.

Job Title: SAP Basis-Senior

At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY GDS CONSULTING SAP BASIS SENIOR

At EY, were all in to shape your future with confidence.
Well help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The Opportunity
As a Senior SAP BASIS Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing our SAP BASIS infrastructure and operations. This senior role offers you the opportunity to ensure system stability, security, and high performance across complex SAP landscapes.
You will work closely with IT teams, functional consultants, and business stakeholders to implement best practices, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and support system upgrades, patches, and migrations. Your expertise will be essential in maintaining system health, ensuring compliance with IT policies, and supporting disaster recovery and business continuity efforts.
In this role, you will also provide guidance and mentorship to junior BASIS team members, fostering knowledge sharing and professional growth. You will be part of a collaborative team that values technical excellence and innovation, delivering reliable SAP BASIS services to support business operations
Your Key Responsibilities
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Performance monitoring & tuning, Problem analysis & resolution, and other activities required to maintain system integrity SAP administration on UNIX & Windows
System /System copy
ABAP + Java-dual stack
Add-on and Support Pack application and troubleshooting
Kernel Upgrade
Client copies and export-import
TMS administration and configuration and troubleshooting Transport errors
SAP system monitoring and thorough analysis of issues
SAP parameter change, operation mode setup, Logon group setup
SAP Role based Authorization knowledge - Role creation and modification
Spool administration and troubleshooting spool/printer issues
OSS Note application
Experience in Single -Sign On, Web Dispatcher
Experience in working SAP on public cloud and private cloud.
Experience in working with cloud service providers like AWS, Azure and GCP.
SAP Solution Manager experience with basic and advanced configuration.
Hands-on experience with SAP user provisioning, authorization troubleshooting, and role assignments.
Basic knowledge of OS/DB migration processes.
Familiarity with Web Dispatcher, Gateway, and SAP integration components.
Skills and attributes for success
Should have 4 to 7 years of experience in SAP Basis domain.
Solid hands-on experience in SAP system administration, including installation, configuration, upgrades, and performance optimization.
Should understand SAP architecture, transport management, kernel updates, and system refresh processes.
Proficient in administering SAP HANA (monitoring, tuning, backup/recoveries, basic troubleshooting).
Experience supporting landscapes like S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, PO/PI, Fiori, Solution Manager, etc.
Strong SAP BTP knowledge, including key services, integration patterns, and administration fundamentals.
Strong working experience with RISE with SAP environments and operational activities.
Strong documentation skills for system delivery, ensuring clear, structured, and auditready technical documentation.
Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with clients and stakeholders.

About the Role:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional to support the Payment Gateway Sales team across pre-sales activities, client solutioning and sales operations. Track merchant onboarding, integration and operational issues, identify bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
Prepare MIS, reports and dashboards covering leads, onboarding, integrations and operational metrics.
Support Sales with operational activities, documentation, approvals and internal coordination.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, prospect research, reporting and operational efficiency.
Identify process gaps and drive improvements in TAT, operational efficiency and merchant experience.

Qualifications & Skills:
2+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Sales Support, Merchant Operations or similar roles.
Strong experience in B2B/Enterprise lead generation, cold calling and lead qualification.
Prior experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking or Technology preferred.
Exposure to merchant onboarding, payment integration or merchant support is an added advantage.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with prospects, merchants and internal teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and execution skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/reporting tools.
Hands-on experience with AI tools to improve prospecting, research, reporting, productivity and day-to-day execution is mandatory.
Strong ownership, customer focus and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed:
Proven ability in cold calling, lead generation & lead qualification
Strong B2B/Enterprise sales orientation
Excellent stakeholder management & coordination
Customer-centric approach with strong problem-solving skills
Good analytical and reporting skills
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
Strong ownership, follow-through and execution mindset
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM tools

Noida | Mumbai | Bengaluru

At Paytm Payments Services, you'll work on one of India's largest digital payment platforms, solving complex business challenges for leading enterprises. Description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Graph Data Engineer with strong expertise in enterprise graph data modeling, knowledge graphs, semantic technologies, graph databases, and large-scale data engineering.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing and implementing graph-based data solutions, developing ETL/ELT pipelines, integrating heterogeneous data sources, and building scalable distributed data platforms. Experience with graph query languages, Python development, cloud platforms, and modern lakehouse architectures is highly desirable.

Primary Skills Must Have

Enterprise Graph Data Modeling: Property Graphs (LPG), RDF, ontologies, and semantic modeling.
Graph Databases: Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Dydra, or equivalent graph database technologies.
Graph Query Languages: Cypher, SPARQL, and Gremlin.
Python Development: Strong programming and data processing skills.
ETL/ELT Development: Design, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines.
Big Data Technologies: Apache Spark, Databricks, Airflow, or similar platforms.
Data Integration & Engineering: Integration of data from multiple enterprise sources.
Data Modeling: Relational, analytical, graph, and lakehouse data modeling.
Distributed Data Platforms: Experience designing and working with scalable data processing systems.
DevOps & Automation: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and deployment automation.
Enterprise Data Architecture: Designing robust, scalable, and maintainable enterprise data solutions.

Secondary Skills Good to Have

Databricks Lakehouse Platform
Delta Lake and Unity Catalog
AWS services: S3, Neptune, Glue, Athena, IAM, and Lambda
Graph Analytics and Graph Data Science
Graph-based Machine Learning
Semantic Search and Knowledge Graphs
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions
Recommendation Systems
Data visualization tools such as Dash, Shiny, Grafana, Splunk, and Databricks Visualization

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement enterprise-scale graph data models using LPG, RDF, ontologies, and semantic modeling techniques.
Develop and optimize graph database solutions using Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Dydra, or equivalent platforms.
Build and optimize graph queries using Cypher, SPARQL, and Gremlin.
Develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, Apache Spark, Databricks, Airflow, or similar technologies.
Integrate structured and semi-structured data from multiple enterprise systems.
Design and implement graph-based data architectures that support analytics, semantic search, and knowledge discovery.
Collaborate with enterprise architects, data scientists, and engineering teams to deliver scalable data solutions.
Implement data quality, governance, security, and performance optimization practices.
Establish CI/CD processes and Infrastructure-as-Code practices for reliable deployments.
Evaluate emerging graph technologies and identify opportunities to improve data connectivity, analytics, and business outcomes.

Candidate Profile

10+ years of overall experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related technical roles.
Strong hands-on expertise in graph data modeling, graph databases, and graph query languages.
Proven experience developing production-grade Python applications and ETL/ELT pipelines.
Experience with distributed data processing and modern data platforms.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Ability to work with enterprise stakeholders and deliver solutions in a client-facing environment.
Willingness to work in a hybrid model from the client location in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Noida.

Description:
Join our Team
About this opportunity
Join our team as an Architect - AI and DevOps, helping define and deliver secure, scalable and cost-effective AI solutions for enterprise environments. You will shape architectural standards and guide the adoption of Generative AI, large language models, intelligent agents and automation across technology platforms and delivery processes.
Working with engineering, product, security and platform teams, you will connect strategic goals with practical solutions that are reliable, maintainable and ready for production.

What you will do
Define end-to-end AI and machine learning architectures that meet requirements for performance, availability, security, scalability and cost.
Design enterprise solutions using large language models, prompt engineering, model tuning, efficient model deployment and secure integration.
Consulting & Business Generation: Work with Customer Units to propose Automation and AI Solutions & capabilities in the Telecom Service Domain. Contribute to creation of End to end solution, presales estimates and work on Statement of Work and compliance document.
Architect knowledge solutions using Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector databases and semantic search.
Design intelligent agents, tool integrations and workflow orchestration using APIs and the Model Context Protocol.
Establish standards for automated delivery pipelines covering source control, testing, security checks, artifact management, deployment and validation.
Design cloud-native solutions using AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes and microservices.
Guide infrastructure automation, configuration management and Infrastructure as Code using Ansible and related tools.
Embed privacy, access control, security, compliance and responsible AI practices, including human approval where appropriate.
Promote effective monitoring, logging, performance improvement and production troubleshooting.
Communicate architectural decisions clearly and support teams in delivering consistent, high-quality solutions.

You will bring
Experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, machine learning, cloud or DevOps solutions.
Strong understanding of AI and machine learning architecture, deep learning, large language models and modern AI applications.
Proficiency in Python and practical experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Experience with prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector databases, model integration and performance optimization.
Knowledge of AI agent frameworks, workflow orchestration, tool calling, API integration and the Model Context Protocol.
Hands-on experience with Git, Ansible, CI/CD design, Python or Bash scripting, JSON and YAML. GitLab experience is an advantage.
Familiarity with code quality and security tools, artifact repositories and container registries.
Experience with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, networking and identity management.
Knowledge of Ubuntu and Red Hat Enterprise Linux environments, monitoring, logging, observability and production support.
Strong communication, collaboration and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work across technical and business teams.
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.

Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLM, RAG, GraphRAG, AI Agents, LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, Python, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Vector Database, MLOps, LLMOps, Databricks, NLP, Cloud Computing, AI Governance.

Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Engineer (P4-II) to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in machine learning, large language models (LLMs), AI application engineering, cloud-native architectures, and MLOps practices.
This role requires hands-on technical leadership, the ability to drive projects independently, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable AI solutions.
Key Responsibilities
AI Solution Development
Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
Build and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) applications.
Develop Agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent.
Create scalable AI APIs and microservices using Python and modern backend frameworks.
Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms and business applications.
Machine Learning & Data Science
Develop and deploy predictive models using supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
Perform feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and optimization.
Build NLP, classification, recommendation, forecasting, and anomaly detection solutions.
Implement model monitoring and performance measurement frameworks.
Generative AI & LLM Engineering
Work with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Llama, and other foundation models.
Design prompt engineering strategies and evaluation frameworks.
Implement advanced RAG, GraphRAG, memory systems, and agent collaboration patterns.
Fine-tune models when applicable and evaluate model quality, safety, and performance.
Drive Responsible AI practices and governance requirements.
Platform Engineering & MLOps
Design AI deployment pipelines using CI/CD best practices.
Implement MLOps and LLMOps frameworks for model lifecycle management.
Build observability, logging, tracing, and performance monitoring capabilities.
Optimize model costs and infrastructure utilization.
Work with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native deployments.
Technical Leadership
Mentor junior AI engineers and data scientists.
Establish engineering standards, code quality practices, and reusable AI components.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, and business stakeholders.

Zydus MedTech is the WOS of Zydus Lifesciences, focused on transforming healthcare through innovative medical technologies. With a legacy of over 70 years, Zydus group has established its presence in more than 85 countries.
At Zydus MedTech, our manufacturing is built on precision, quality, and sustainability. Our state-of-the-art facilities, ISO 13485-certified and equipped with advanced automation, ensure seamless production of next-generation medical technologies. Within our clean rooms where the highest sterility standards prevail-every product is forged with integrity, safeguarding patient safety and redefining reliability.
Zydus Lifesciences Limited (Formerly known as Cadila Healthcare Limited), a leading Indian Pharmaceutical company is a fully integrated, global healthcare provider. With in-depth domain expertise in the field of healthcare, it has strong capabilities across the spectrum of the pharmaceutical value chain. In 1995, the group was restructured and thus was formed Cadila Healthcare under the aegis of the Zydus group. From a humble turnover Rs. 250 crores in 1995 the group witnessed a significant financial growth and registered a turnover of over Rs. 17,000 crores in FY-21.
Adhering to its brand promise of being dedicated to life in all its dimensions, Zydus continues to innovate with an unswerving focus to address the unmet healthcare needs. Simultaneously it rededicates itself to its mission of creating healthier, happier communities across the globe.

Job Summary
Position: Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment
Location: Shimla, Himachal Pardesh
Reporting To: National Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment
Based at: State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM) State Programme Management Unit (SPMU) office
Project Duration: 3 Years (annual contract, renewable based on performance and availability of funds)
Background
HelpAge India, in partnership with DAY-NRLM and participating SRLMs, is implementing a multi-state pilot to integrate elderly care, active ageing, and community-based caregiving within the Food, Nutrition, Health, and Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (FNHW) framework. The initiative aims to build scalable, community-led elderly inclusion systems through SHG-VO-CLF platforms, strengthen government convergence, and develop caregiving cadres and care economy approaches. To support state-level implementation, a Project Manager- Elderly Inclusion Empowerment will be positioned within the respective SRLM SPMU.
Purpose
The State Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment will provide state-level technical, operational, and coordination support for implementing the Operational Framework under the MoU between HelpAge India and the respective SRLM. The role includes integrating elderly-focused interventions within SRLM systems, strengthening implementation across pilot districts and blocks, facilitating government convergence, and supporting institutionalisation within DAY-NRLM, while guiding district/block teams, community institutions, and caregiving cadres to deliver agreed programme outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
Programme Coordination and Implementation: Lead coordination and implementation of the Operational Framework across pilot districts and blocks, ensuring alignment with state plans and the HelpAge India-SRLM MoU.
Coordination Engagement: Act as the key liaison between HelpAge India and SRLM, coordinating across state, district, and block levels, and driving convergence with relevant departments.
Technical Support Capacity Building: Develop and deliver guidelines, tools, and trainings; strengthen elderly inclusion, caregiving systems, and integration of ESHGs within NRLM platforms.
Monitoring Reporting: Track progress, conduct field visits, and lead reporting, evaluations, and documentation of programme outcomes.
Community Systems Convergence: Strengthen Elders Self Help Groups (ESHGs), community caregiving systems and enable elderly access to entitlements, health, social protection, and livelihoods through stakeholder convergence.
Disclaimer: The Job Description above is not an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, and responsibilities associated with the position.
Requirements
Desired Qualifications, Competencies Experience
Masters degree in Social Work, Rural Development, Development Studies, Public Health or related disciplines.
Minimum 4 - 6 years of relevant experience in rural livelihoods, SHG promotion, social inclusion, public health or community development programmes.
Prior experience of working with SRLMs, NRLM institutional platforms or large-scale government programmes will be preferred.
Experience in programme coordination, capacity building and stakeholder engagement.
Understanding of elderly inclusion, social protection, community caregiving or FNHW-related programmes will be an added advantage.
Strong communication, coordination and documentation skills.
Willingness to travel extensively within the state.
Strong programme coordination and facilitation skills.
Ability to work with government systems and community institutions.
Good training and mentoring abilities.
Strong analytical, reporting and documentation skills.
Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multi-stakeholder implementation processes.

Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International
Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You assist in planning, developing and execution of capital projects, technical development, feasibility perspectives of engineering-related activities in the supply chain and capital-expense project execution to support growth, world-class manufacturing and productivity with the highest level of quality, safety and environmental requirements. You help ensure sure that Mondel z business and innovation processes in project management and Mondel z standards in execution are followed.
How you will contribute
The role supports capital project execution, and you will be accountable for the quality of the results and execution of capital projects using Mondel z standards, and business and innovation processes in project management. You will help define and deliver the capital and technical agenda during the development phase of capital investments with stakeholders so that accurate budgets, plans and fit-for-purpose technical solutions are provided and develop the capital budget according to the contract and forecast cash flow. You will also help ensure that applicable engineering developments and standards are properly implemented, and support the development and implementation of state-of-the-art processes and equipment strategies to optimize resources, harmonize assets and rollout best practices.
What you will bring
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
Engineering or operations
Working effectively and under pressure to meet deadlines
Analysis
Project management
More about this role
Lead the electrical and automation engineering project a the site, ensuring reliable, safe, and efficient execution of all electrical systems and automation system for new capacity expansion.

What you need to know about this position:
Experience
5-6 years of progressive experience in electrical and automation engineering within a manufacturing environment (FMCG/food beverage preferred).
PLC / SCADA
Strong knowledge of PLC programming (Rockwell / Siemens), SCADA/HMI design, industrial networking (Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus TCPIP), and instrumentation. Shall have sound knowledge of batch processes and Pack-ML Standards.
Electrical
Solid understanding of power distribution, motor control, and electrical protection systems. MCC panels and Drives.
Instrumentation
Good knowledge of instruments, selection, and Calibration processes, including legal meteorology.
Digital and Cybersecurity
Digital mindset, familiar with Digital applications for factory operations.
OT infrastructure - Networks, Network management, Server, Virtual Environment, Cybersecurity tools and Secure Remote access tools.
Process and Equipment Safety.
Hands-on knowledge of Process Safety and Equipment Safety Standards (SIL and PL). To design and validate the safety of the equipment and processes.
Leadership
Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams in a fast-paced operational setting.
Project Mgmt
Experience managing capital projects (>$500K electrical/automation scope).
Communication
Ability to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders; strong written and verbal English.

Education / Certifications:
Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.

Job specific requirements:
Electrical Systems
Own the design, BOQ preparation, installation, commissioning, all electrical systems across for new capacity expansion Plant projects.
Ensure compliance with local electrical codes, MDLZ engineering standards, and relevant safety regulations (e.g., NFPA 70E, IEC, local statutory requirements).
Automation for plant projects
Design and implementation of automation and control systems, including PLCs (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, etc.), SCADA/HMI, VFDs, servo drives, instrumentation, and industrial networks for new capacity expansion.
Support in plant digital manufacturing roadmaps.
Project Delivery
Lead electrical and automation scope for capital projects - from concept and design through FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning, and handover.
Manage external contractors, system integrators, and OEMs to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to specification.
Prepare and manage project budgets, schedules, and risk registers for the EA scope.
People Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop a team of electrical and automation technicians/engineers.
Build technical capability through structured training, mentoring, and skills-gap assessments.
Foster a culture of safety, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
Coordinate with Site Automation team, SSAL and the Electrical Maintenance team for project shutdown and integration planning.
Safety Compliance
Champion electrical safety practices, including lockout/tagout (LOTO), arc-flash risk assessments, and safe work permits.
Ensure all electrical and automation work complies with MDLZ Global Engineering Standards, local regulations, and insurance requirements.
Maintain up-to-date electrical single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and automation documentation.

Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.
Mondel z International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Responsible to use through knowledge of Water System Operation and Maintenance of all Utilities Equipments i.e. including Pre Treatment (MGF Softener), UF, RO, EDI, Purified Water supply and distribution, system and maintaining respective documentation (Whenever applicable).

To carry out improvements in system for better efficient operations.
Responsible for accurate parts inventory and equipment specific usage control.
Implementation of cost improvement maintenance.
To perform any other work as and when assigned by Head of department

Job Description
Head Maintenance & Utility - Baddi Plant

Internally, the role is designated as Site Maintenance and Utilities Lead responsible for driving plant maintenance excellence, equipment reliability, preventive and predictive maintenance, utilities management, and the Progressive Maintenance (PM) pillar under our IL6S framework.

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

ROLE PURPOSE
As a member of the Plant Leadership Team (PLT), the Progressive Maintenance & Utilities Lead will lead the Progressive Maintenance (PM) Pillar within the Integrated Lean Six Sigma (IL6S) framework and drive the plants journey towards a Zero Breakdown Culture.

This role is responsible for building maintenance capability, improving equipment reliability, strengthening utilities performance, driving energy efficiency, and embedding world-class maintenance practices across the plant .

The role is focused on coaching, capability building, and technical leadership rather than day-to-day maintenance execution.

Your goal will be to ensure that the site manufacturing & support activities, without interruption, without any facilities shortages and/or any issues thereof. You will achieve 100% compliance to Local legal regulations, Quality, Health Safety & Environment management systems and standards. You are responsible for the management and maintenance of site facilities, buildings and equipment(s) (hardware & software).

How you will contribute

You will:
Works cross functionally to develop and implement a strategic Facilities road-map and annual operating plan which is a competitive advantage to Mondel z. Partner with internal & external stakeholders and service providers to define and meet Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Sustainability, Engagement goals. Establish a strong governance to review & control Operational performance and continuous Improvement plan to deliver against best in class both internally and externally.
Lead and be accountable that Building Maintenance program, Facilities maintenance program capabilities, including maintenance repairs & overall operations are in place. Accountable to insure adherence to business continuity plan, manufacturing standards government regulations are understood by all employees/services providers at the site, regularly reviewed and monitored for effective implementation.
Provide leadership, coaching to Facilities team towards implementation of IL6S-Integrated Lean 6 sigma ways of working: delivering zero breakdowns via preventive/predictive maintenance strategies and technical mastery of maintenance and operation teams; PM (Progressive Maintenance) Pillar, and CBM (condition based monitoring), Visual controls & tools Mgmt., Lubrication mgmt. & Calibration of equipment(s) etc.
Role model Values and principles through effective coaching, mentoring and builds skills capability across the Plant technical/engineering team to engage with latest modern practices. Have a clear people succession and resource plan, for the asset & technology population , identifying and implementing critical levers to attract, retain and develop critical talent
Interface with key stakeholders internally and externally to develop and maintain effective relationships, align priorities in order to deliver the company objectives, and goals.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

Strong operational & manufacturing leadership experience in CPG industry with experience in TPM-Total productive maintenance, 5s, LEAN, 6 sigma tools and concepts, Safety & GMP standards
An Engineer with a strong financial & business acumen, project management skills and Knowledge of industrial maintenance and manufacturing equipment, PM (Progressive Maintenance) expertise, Spare parts management, SAP PM module end user knowledge, Technology & Engineering automation basics.
Excellent communication (verbal & written), coaching, and leadership skills in a team-based environment. Demonstrated abilities in Analytics, problem solving and team building


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Progressive Maintenance Leadership
Lead the Progressive Maintenance Pillar and drive equipment reliability across the plant.
Establish and sustain preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance practices.
Drive breakdown elimination and continuous improvement initiatives.

Capability Building
Develop maintenance capability across engineering and operations teams.
Coach technical leaders and strengthen organizational expertise in reliability and maintenance excellence.
Support capability transfer through Autonomous Maintenance initiatives.

Reliability & Operational Excellence
Improve equipment availability, maintenance effectiveness, and operational performance.
Lead root cause analysis and drive sustainable corrective actions.
Improve key reliability metrics including OEE, MTBF, and MTTR.

Plant Leadership
Own maintenance and infrastructure budgets.
Support capital projects, plant expansions, and equipment investments.
Provide technical expertise to improve future plant design and asset reliability

Technical & Utilities Governance
Provide leadership across maintenance, utilities, electrical, instrumentation, and automation functions.
Ensure reliable and efficient operation of critical plant infrastructure and utility systems.
Support modernization, automation, and reliability improvement initiatives.

Safety, Compliance & Sustainability
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and environmental requirements.
Drive energy optimization and sustainability initiatives across the site.
Champion safe maintenance practices and technical governance

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Reduced equipment breakdowns and downtime.
Improved reliability, maintenance effectiveness, and plant performance.
Strong PM Pillar maturity within the IL6S framework.
Improved utility reliability and energy efficiency.
Enhanced technical capability across the organization.
Best-in-class safety and compliance performance
IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
Bachelors Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Electronics, or Industrial Engineering.
10+ years of experience in Maintenance, Reliability, Engineering, or Plant Technical Operations.
Strong hands-on maintenance foundation with progression into maintenance leadership roles.
Experience working within Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), Integrated Lean Six Sigma (IL6S), or similar operational excellence frameworks.
Proven track record of driving reliability improvements, capability building, and maintenance excellence in highly automated manufacturing environments. Strong leadership, coaching, stakeholder management, and systems-thinking capabilities.

WHY JOIN
This is a high-impact Plant Leadership Team role offering the opportunity to shape maintenance strategy , influence plant-wide performance, build technical capability , and drive world-class reliability and operational excellence

Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You will be responsible for coordinating and enabling the Site Asset & Technology Leader in driving asset reliability, maintenance, infrastructure and facilities performance to support the delivery of site SQCDSM targets.

The role will focus on ensuring reliable plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure and facilities, while driving effective MRO management, maintenance planning, budget utilization, inventory management and productivity initiatives. You will also ensure uninterrupted site operations through compliance with local legal regulations, Quality, Health, Safety & Environment standards and Mondel z manufacturing requirements.

How You Will Contribute
You will:
Asset, Maintenance & Infrastructure Management
Coordinate the execution of preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance activities for plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure, buildings and facilities.
Drive maintenance of site infrastructure and facilities, ensuring timely execution of preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective actions.
Support asset reliability and loss prevention initiatives to minimize breakdowns, downtime and equipment-related losses.
Implement and sustain IL6S/TPM ways of working, including Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, Condition-Based Monitoring (CBM), lubrication management, calibration, visual controls and loss elimination.
Partner with the PM and operations teams to identify maintenance requirements, validate priorities and ensure timely closure of actions.
MRO & Inventory Management
Manage and track MRO requirements, consumption, availability and inventory, ensuring the right materials are available to support maintenance activities.
Review and validate MRO requirements raised by maintenance/PM teams based on business need, equipment criticality and inventory availability.
Participate in DMS (Daily Management System) routines and translate identified maintenance requirements into appropriate procurement actions.
Coordinate the PR/PO process for MRO requirements, including requirement validation, purchase order creation and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.
Monitor MRO spend, consumption and inventory levels to improve cost effectiveness and avoid excess/obsolete inventory.
Coordinate with suppliers/OEMs and service providers to ensure timely delivery of materials and services in line with agreed SLAs.
Budget & Cost Management
Support annual maintenance, MRO, infrastructure and facilities budget planning, including allocation and tracking of spend across various requirements.
Monitor OPEX/M&R and maintenance-related expenditure against budget and identify potential deviations and corrective actions.
Support prioritization of maintenance and infrastructure requirements based on business impact, asset criticality and available budget.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and productivity improvement through effective MRO management, maintenance practices and supplier management.
Productivity & Continuous Improvement
Drive and support MRO productivity projects and cost-saving initiatives focused on reducing maintenance losses, improving asset reliability and optimizing MRO spend.
Identify opportunities for loss elimination and improve maintenance effectiveness through data-driven analysis and structured problem solving.
Apply PDCA, TPM/IL6S and other continuous improvement methodologies to address recurring equipment and maintenance issues.
Capability Building & Stakeholder Management
Coach and support operating and maintenance teams on routine maintenance, equipment care, breakdown prevention and CIL (Cleaning, Inspection & Lubrication) practices.
Support development of technical capability within operating teams and work process owners.
Interface with internal stakeholders including Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, Quality, HSE and Supply Chain, as well as external service providers and OEMs.
Ensure adherence to manufacturing standards, governance, compliance requirements and applicable legal regulations.
What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career, along with the following experience and knowledge:
Experience in plant maintenance, asset management, engineering, facilities, infrastructure or MRO management, preferably within a manufacturing/FMCG environment.
Good understanding of preventive and predictive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, asset reliability and maintenance planning.
Knowledge of MRO management, inventory management, procurement processes and supplier/OEM coordination.
Experience in budget planning, cost tracking and OPEX/M&R management.
Understanding of TPM/IL6S, Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, CBM, loss elimination and PDCA-based problem solving.
Ability to evaluate and validate maintenance/MRO requirements and coordinate the DMS requirement validation PR/PO execution cycle.
Experience in driving or supporting productivity, cost-saving or continuous improvement projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and track performance.
Computer proficiency, including MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with experience in ERP systems such as SAP or similar platforms.
Strong communication, collaboration, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Ability to coordinate multiple priorities across maintenance, MRO, infrastructure, facilities, inventory and budget management.
Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research & Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.
Mondel z International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Job Description Senior Manager (Civil)

Business Unit: Auro Textiles Fabric Division
Grade: Senior Manager, M3
Reporting To: Unit Head
Place of Posting: Baddi, Himachal Pradesh

1. Primary Role

To oversee civil maintenance and infrastructure management across all Fabric Division units, including factory buildings, residential colonies, utilities, and other civil structures. The role also involves planning and execution of Greenfield and Brownfield projects, ensuring timely completion, cost control, quality standards, structural integrity, and compliance with safety procedures.

2. Roles and Responsibilities

1. Oversee repair and maintenance of factory buildings, residential facilities, roads, drainage systems, water supply lines, sewerage systems, and other civil infrastructure.
2. Conduct periodic inspections of civil structures, roofs, flooring, plaster, ceilings, and other building components to ensure structural stability and timely maintenance.
3. Assess the feasibility of new buildings, machine foundations, and modifications to existing structures, including preparation of drawings, proposals, cost estimates, and BOQs.
4. Prepare annual revenue and capital budgets, monitor expenditure, control costs, and ensure effective utilisation of resources.
5. Review material requirements, verify quantities, and approve purchase indents as per organisational procedures.
6. Monitor construction projects for progress, budget, quality, and adherence to approved specifications and timelines.
7. Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, contractors, and internal departments to resolve technical and site-related issues.
8. Verify job approvals, contractor bills, work measurements, and supporting documents in accordance with organisational SOPs.
9. Ensure compliance with safety standards and prescribed procedures during civil maintenance and construction activities.
10. Maintain records of drawings, estimates, BOQs, approvals, completed jobs, and associated costs.
11. Lead and guide civil officers, supervisors, and supporting staff, while addressing team grievances and ensuring effective service delivery.
12. Provide land, building, and infrastructure-related information to internal departments, CPPD, and the Estate Office as required.

3. Essential Qualifications and Experience

- Relevant qualification in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
- Proven experience in industrial infrastructure, including Greenfield and Brownfield projects and civil maintenance.
- Hands-on experience in project execution, budgeting, BOQ preparation, cost estimation, and contractor management.
- Knowledge of construction quality standards, safety practices, and infrastructure maintenance.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Excellent project management and communication skills.

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc .

Description:
Direct Reportees: Store Managers
Interactions: Internal and External Stakeholders.
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:
- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Job Summary


The opportunity
Assistant Manager-Operations-HR-CBS - TAL - Enablement - Mumbai / NCR / Chennai / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Pune


CBS - TAL - Enablement
At Talent team, we empower you to have a sense of purpose and opportunities that add value to your overall career experience at EY. The team works together across functions and service lines to build strategic solutions that support our strategy and employer value proposition (EVP).
The team partners effectively with the business leaders, providing strategic talent advice to work in an integrated manner, leveraging solutions and best practices. The teams are responsible for enabling the business, driving the engagement of our people locally and bringing our strategy and EVP to life.
The team includes workstreams like, Business Partnering, Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, Mobility, Compensation and benefit and enabling functions like HR systems, Operations, People Data Reporting and Analytics. They also leverage our global strength and scalability to drive HR-related technology, projects and processes that allow EY to deliver against the changing requirements to enable success. The core focus of the team is to ensure an exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.


Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence
Manage employee relations cases, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
Collaborate with Service Line HR BPs on ER initiatives and projects.
Conduct thorough investigations into employee grievances and complaints.
Prepare detailed reports and documentation related to investigations and case management.
Facilitate conflict resolution between employees and management.
Assist in the development and implementation of ER policies and procedures.
Maintain accurate records of all ER cases and initiatives.


To qualify for the role you must have

Qualification
Master in Business Administration


Experience
Employee Relations (6+ years)


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
