Description:
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.

Atkinsrealis is one of the largest engineering and design consultancy in the UK, the largest multidisciplinary consultancy in Europe and one of the largest design firms in the world.
This key post will be based out of Bangalore/Mumbai office and will offer a challenging and rewarding opportunity to apply knowledge, experience and problem-solving skills whilst providing good opportunities.
We are seeking a motivated Landscape Irrigation Design Engineer to support the design and development of irrigation/ wet utility team. To perform this role successfully, the candidate will be responsible for but not limited to the following:
Your role
2-4 years of experience in the Landscape Irrigation.
Experience of working in the Irrigation / water Industry.
Positive Attitude and eagerness to learn and use new irrigation/ water related design software s, tools and processes for automation and digital efficiency as per the project and business requirement.

Good understanding of various design standards and its application in the Landscape and Irrigation industry.
Bachelor s degree/Masters degree in Engineering from an institute of repute.
Clear knowledge of work procedures, and ability to brief project team on them.
Good written and verbal English language communication skills.
Ability to work effectively with colleagues, seniors, team members and clients.
Experience of major Infrastructure projects at feasibility and detailed design stages.
A team player and work in collaboration.
About you
Perform flow calculations and water demand analysis for landscape irrigation systems.
Assist in preparing design reports and technical documentation.
Assist and develop irrigation specifications based on project requirements and standards.
Prepare and maintain valve schedules.
Support the creation and validation of hydraulic models for irrigation networks.
Plan and design irrigation network routing, including pipelines, valves, and control systems.
Coordinate with BIM team for design integration.
Ensure designs comply with local regulations, standards, and sustainability practices.
Develop Concept, Preliminary, Detailed design, related calculations and drawings.
Involve in clash analysis, resolution and work on federated 3Dmodels
Able to perform good self-checks. And support in team development, skill enhancement.
Apply Atkins Quality, Safety Environmental (QSE) standards and Business Management System (BMS).

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.

Comprehensive life insurance coverage.

Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Description:
ROLE: HR BUSINESS PARTNER
YEARS OF EXPERIENCE: 4years
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

As a HR business partner, the person would be responsible for driving execution of HR strategies and plans, process and policies related to recruitment, employee relations, and the associated learning and development requirements. The responsibilities also include driving efficiencies through productivity, enhanced employee engagement /experience and by institutionalizing processes as outlined by policies and by driving ownership within employee groups.
BRIEF JD

PLANNING AND BUDGETING
Prepare HR key imperatives for the year covering individual plans for relevant HR processes, business requirements and priorities. Review, analyze and incorporate metrics on factors like employee engagement, attrition, headcounts, vendor costs, investments required. Review and provide inputs for corporate budget and HR budget based on these metrics, key business imperatives & market realities; Track and review the scores across various metrics; Review the finalization of budget & seek approvals; Track adherence to budget & take corrective actions in case of deviations. Provide inputs on policy changes required within business line to Corp HR .
CHANGE MANAGEMENT
Play a key role in driving change management strategies and plans that maximize employee adoption and usage and minimize resistance alongside, meet the budget and schedule objectives as outlined. Focus on the people side of change, including changes to business processes, systems and technology, job roles and organization structures. Drive faster adoption, higher utilization, and proficiency with the changes that impact employees
EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT, TALENT MANAGEMENT AND RETENTION
Develop and execute an effective employee engagement and talent management plan in line with key imperatives & long-term strategy that caters to present and future requirements of the unit. Advise leaders and managers on critical talent management and retention initiatives and actions. Engagement activities including one-one / skips to be regularly conducted. Virtual events, Fun on the floor and key celebrations events to happen periodically.
MANDATORY SKILLS

• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Adept at using HR technologies and tools for data analytics and solutioning
• Ability to learn in a mature but complex organization with varied People Policies & Practices
• Self-sufficient, capable of identifying key issues and priorities and focusing on these to deliver required results with minimal direction and supervision.
• Understanding of business flow and ability to work closely with critical and senior stakeholders

WORK FROM OFFICE JOB ONLY

ONLINE INTERVIEWS

Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance

Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager

The Associate Agency Development Manager will be responsible for the recruitment, training, and management of a team of agents to achieve sales targets and enhance the growth of the insurance business. The role involves identifying potential agents, conducting training sessions, and guiding them in their sales activities. The selected candidate will be expected to establish and maintain strong relationships with agents and provide ongoing support to ensure their success in selling life insurance products.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and develop a team of insurance agents.
- Conduct training sessions for new agents on products, sales techniques, and compliance procedures.
- Monitor and evaluate the performance of the team, providing guidance and motivation to meet sales targets.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with agents to support their professional growth.
- Implement marketing strategies to promote new insurance products.
- Ensure adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements in all activities.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively manage and support agents.
- Leadership qualities to motivate and develop a team.
- Sales and negotiation skills with a focus on achieving targets.
- Analytical skills for tracking team performance and sales metrics.
- Proficiency in using CRM software and other sales management tools.
- Knowledge of life insurance products and relevant industry regulations.
- Ability to conduct training effectively and adapt to diverse learning styles.

This role offers an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to grow their careers in the insurance industry while contributing to the success of a dynamic organization.

Experience with CRM tools and sales tracking software is a plus.
